description:
KaroStartup · Bengaluru · On\-ground \+ office · Duration: 3–6 months

ABOUT KAROSTARTUP

KaroStartup began in 2020 as a college Instagram page. Today it's a startup media platform with a 1M\+ community and 100M\+ cumulative views, built on telling real Indian business stories with real numbers.

We publish across LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube and podcasts, and we also produce content for founders and brands we work with.

BEFORE YOU APPLY

Two things this role requires that most editing roles don't: you must be based in Bengaluru and able to travel across the city, and you must own your own camera and shooting equipment. If either isn't true for you, this isn't the right role.

Please also apply with a showreel or drive link of work you have both shot and edited yourself.

WHY THIS ROLE EXISTS

A lot of our best content is shot outside the office — at a founder's office, at their factory, at their first store. Someone has to actually be in the room with the camera.

That's this role. You come with us to the founder's office, shoot the interview or the podcast or the short video, and then take the footage back and produce the finished piece yourself. One person, end to end — shoot to publish.

WHAT YOU'LL DO — ON THE SHOOT

Travel with the team to founder offices, stores, factories and events across Bengaluru – Shoot founder interviews, podcast episodes, short videos and on\-ground content – Set up the frame, lighting and audio yourself — often in a small cabin or a noisy office, not a studio – Capture B\-roll while you're there: the office, the product, the team, the details that make the story feel real. The edit is only as good as what you brought back. – Get it right the first time. A founder gives us an hour, and there is no second shoot.

WHAT YOU'LL DO — BACK AT THE DESK

Edit everything you shoot — full podcast episodes, reels, shorts, explainers and founder features – Cut long conversations down to the moments worth publishing, and turn each one into short\-form – Own the first three seconds. Hooks, text\-on\-screen, pattern breaks. Retention is the metric that matters here. – Subtitles, sound design, transitions, basic motion graphics — the finishing layer that separates a decent edit from a good one – Use AI video tools to speed up the boring parts — transcription, auto\-cuts, silence removal, voice cleanup, upscaling – Keep our fonts, colours, caption style and pacing consistent across every video without anyone having to check – Manage and back up footage properly. Clean file structure, findable six months later. – Look at the analytics afterwards — where people dropped off, which hook held — and change the next edit accordingly

EQUIPMENT

This is a run\-and\-gun setup, not a film set. We are not looking for a Bollywood\-scale production — we're looking for someone who can walk into an office with a bag and come out with usable footage.

You should own and be comfortable operating:

MUST HAVE

Based in Bengaluru and able to travel across the city for shoots – Your own camera and shooting kit, as above – Practical shooting ability — framing, lighting and audio in real, imperfect locations – Adobe Premiere Pro, or an equivalent suite, with a strong working command – CapCut, or similar, for fast short\-form turnaround – Ability to handle both long\-form and short\-form edits — these are different crafts and we need both – Good sense of pacing, rhythm and music selection, and clean audio work – Comfortable with AI\-assisted editing tools, and curious about new ones – Ownership — you close the loop and hit deadlines without being chased

GOOD TO HAVE

– Multicam podcast experience — sync, angles, cutting between speakers – After Effects for motion graphics and animated text – Photoshop or Canva for thumbnails and covers – Basic colour grading – Understanding of what performs on Instagram and YouTube specifically — they are not the same platform – Comfortable talking to founders on set and making them relax on camera

YOU'LL PROBABLY BE GOOD AT THIS IF

You watch a reel and instantly notice the framing, the cut, the caption timing, the sound design – You can walk into an unfamiliar room and figure out where to put the camera in two minutes – You can take a rough brief and come back with something better than what was described – You want to build a body of work, not just clear a task list

THE HONEST PART

You are the crew. There is no separate camera person, sound person and editor — on most shoots it's you and your bag, and then it's you at the timeline. That's the point of the role, and it is also the hard part of it.

Shoot days move around. Founders reschedule. Bengaluru traffic is real, and some weeks will have a podcast episode, a founder shoot and several reels in the same pipeline. Speed matters, and so does not letting quality slip when the queue is full.

You'll get feedback constantly, sometimes on individual frames and cuts. If you take that as collaboration rather than criticism, you'll grow fast here.

WHAT YOU GET OUT OF IT

You'll be in the room with founders — not researching them from a laptop, but sitting across from them while they talk – Real ownership of video going out to a 1M\+ audience, with your work published, not shelved – A portfolio of podcast episodes, founder features and reels that actually performed — shot and edited by you – Hands\-on training in hooks, retention, storytelling and platform strategy, not just software – Certificate and letter of recommendation on completion – Strong performers are considered for a full\-time role as the video team is built out

We are not looking for someone who only shoots, or someone who only edits. We are looking for one person who can walk into a founder's office with a camera and walk out with a story we can publish.

Pay: ₹30,000\.00 \- ₹50,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Commuter assistance
* Flexible schedule
* Work from home

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Bengaluru, Karnataka 560061

**Your opportunity**
--------------------

  

At Charles Schwab, our purpose is simple: we champion client’s goals with passion and integrity. Guided by honesty, mutual respect and a commitment to doing what’s right, we bring innovation, education, and service together to help shape financial futures. Our people are the foundation of our success – they approach their work with curiosity and collaboration, coming together to create solutions that make a meaningful impact for clients and communities. Our Hyderabad location is central to Schwab’s growth, bringing together talented people and technology to drive innovation, scale and efficiency. Here, you will work alongside teams who create solutions that support millions of clients every day. The work you do is more than daily operations – it’s a chance to experiment, learn, and build within a values\-driven, supportive environment. This is a unique opportunity to be part of our early growth phase and shape something new, backed by the stability and strength of a Fortune 500 company. Your impact begins on day one, and your contributions will help define our future in the region
**What you have**
-----------------

 **Role Description**  

  

The role based in Schwab India, part of our Global Capability Center in Hyderabad, will be part of Schwab Asset Management Technology, which is part of Schwab Technology Services. Schwab Asset Management Technology is aligned to support the technology needs of Schwab Asset Management and the broader Schwab organization. As part of the Charles Schwab organization, we champion the needs of investors and seek to enhance the financial lives of our clients in all we do. Operating our business through clients’ eyes and putting them at the center of our decisions, we aim to deliver exceptional experiences to investors and the financial professionals who serve them.  

SAM Tech enables SAM to deliver investment solutions at scale — powering the full lifecycle comprising trading, portfolio management, research and operations across SAM Funds, ETFs, and Managed Accounts Solutions. The suite of platforms delivers scalable front, middle and back\-office capabilities across Advisor Services and Investor Services, including Alternatives and third\-party Insurance and Annuities.  

The Data and Distribution Practice Leader will serve as a key leadership point of contact for the India\-based Data and Distribution capability, partnering closely with U.S. and India leadership to build local talent, strengthen engineering leadership, and drive a consistent global execution model. This role is less focused on ownership of a single technology stack or platform and more focused on building a scalable practice: developing local leaders, establishing delivery discipline, enabling execution oversight, and advancing delivery excellence across teams. The leader will help shape how work is planned, staffed, executed, measured, and continuously improved across the Data and Distribution domain.
  

  

**Key Roles \& Responsibilities**  

Provide people, practice, and execution leadership for the Data and Distribution capability in Schwab India, partnering with global leaders to establish a strong India\-based leadership presence and delivery model.  

  

Serve as the local practice leader and primary point of contact for Data and Distribution leadership needs, ensuring alignment across business priorities, technology strategy, delivery commitments, staffing, and execution health.  

  

Build, mentor, and develop local talent and emerging leaders across engineering, quality, analysis, and delivery roles, creating a sustainable leadership pipeline for the Data and Distribution practice.  

  

Drive a consistent global execution model across India and U.S. teams, including operating rhythms, communication practices, delivery planning, dependency management, escalation paths, and execution transparency.  

  

Provide execution oversight across Data and Distribution initiatives, helping teams manage scope, risks, dependencies, quality, and delivery outcomes in partnership with product, technology, and business stakeholders.  

  

Champion delivery excellence by promoting disciplined Agile execution, continuous improvement, engineering accountability, operational readiness, and measurable delivery outcomes.  

  

Partner with domain and platform leaders to ensure India teams are effectively integrated into global operating models, with clear ownership, strong collaboration, and a shared focus on business outcomes.  

  

Foster a culture of inclusion, accountability, collaboration, and continuous learning, ensuring teams are empowered to deliver high\-quality solutions and grow as part of Schwab’s broader technology organization. **Required Qualifications**
 Proven leadership experience building, scaling, and leading technology teams in a global delivery environment.  

* Demonstrated success as a Practice or Capability Leader with responsibility for talent development, delivery oversight, governance, and business outcomes.
* Strong strategic thinking and business acumen with the ability to align execution to organizational priorities and long\-term objectives.
* Experience partnering with senior technology, product, business, and operations leaders across global organizations.
* Strong understanding of enterprise technology delivery, including Agile execution, program management, risk management, governance, and operational excellence.
* Proven track record of driving delivery excellence through accountability, execution transparency, continuous improvement, and measurable outcomes.
* Experience coaching and developing managers, technical leaders, and high\-potential talent to build a sustainable leadership pipeline.
* Ability to establish scalable operating models and execution frameworks across globally distributed teams.
* Strong influencing, communication, and stakeholder management skills with the ability to drive alignment across multiple organizations.
* Functional knowledge of Asset Management, including investment management, trading, research, operations, performance measurement, client reporting, and compliance.
* Understanding of Front Office, Middle Office, Data \& Distribution capabilities and the end\-to\-end investment lifecycle.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Finance, or a related field; advanced degree or relevant certifications preferred.
 **Preffered Qualification**  

 Experience leading teams within a Global Capability Center (GCC) or similar global delivery model.  

* Experience building and scaling practices, capabilities, or leadership organizations through periods of growth and transformation.
* Demonstrated success driving transformation across people, process, technology, and operating models.
* Ability to establish a compelling vision, inspire teams, and influence change across matrixed organizations.
* Experience creating diverse, inclusive, and high\-performing team cultures.
* Deep understanding of Asset Management data domains, including security master, holdings, performance, benchmark, market, pricing, and client reporting data.
* Familiarity with investment distribution capabilities supporting Advisor Services, Investor Services, institutional channels, and client reporting.
* Experience supporting Asset Management functions such as Portfolio Management, Trading, Investment Operations, Distribution, Product Management, and Client Reporting.
* Strong executive presence with excellent communication, presentation, and relationship\-management skills.
* Experience leading globally distributed teams and establishing effective partnership models across U.S. and India organizations.
* Commitment to high ethical standards, integrity, accountability, inclusion, and a client\-first culture.
  

**What’s in it for you**
------------------------

 Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn and pursue outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say Hello to SimCorp!
   

  

 At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values — Caring, Customer success\-driven, Collaborative, Curious, and Courageous. **WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US**
 We are looking for an experienced Lead Automation Test Engineer to join our Data Platform Teams in Noida, acting as the go\-to quality and test automation expert across the platform. You will build and drive automated testing for UI, APIs, and data — including platforms such as Snowflake and SQL\-based stores — and make testing a natural, built\-in part of how we deliver, rather than an afterthought bolted on at the end. You will enable other engineers to test effectively, create transparency into quality and coverage across the data platform, and help embed testing into our CI/CD pipelines so issues are caught early and consistently. You will work in an agile environment, partnering closely with data engineers, while also being comfortable owning initiatives on your own.
   

  

**What You Will Be Responsible For**
* Lead the design, build, and optimization of automated test suites across UI, API, and data layers, including data validation and reconciliation testing against Snowflake and other SQL\-based platforms
* Define and drive the test automation strategy for the data platform, setting shared standards and best practices adopted across multiple teams
* Embed automated testing into CI/CD pipelines so quality gates run consistently as part of every build, release, and deployment
* Collaborate with the team and stakeholders to define testing requirements and ensure alignment with business
* Create transparency around test coverage, quality metrics, and known risks — through dashboards, reporting, and clear communication to technical and non\-technical stakeholders
* Enable and mentor other engineers to write and maintain their own automated tests, raising the overall quality bar across teams rather than being the sole tester
* Collaborate closely with developers, data engineers, and architects to identify testing gaps and design testable systems from the outset
* Troubleshoot test failures and flaky tests, and continuously improve the reliability and speed of automated test suites
* Contribute to documentation, best practices, and knowledge sharing on testing and quality across the data platform organization


**Key Skills And Requirements**
* 8\+ years of practical experience setting up testing frameworks and writing automated tests for UI (e.g. SpecFlow) and API (e.g. REST Assured or similar)
* Solid SQL skills and practical experience testing data platforms such as Snowflake, including data validation, reconciliation, and pipeline testing
* Experience embedding automated tests into CI/CD pipelines (e.g. Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions) so testing runs as a natural part of build and release
* Demonstrated ability to work with minimal supervision and lead test strategy across multiple teams, while also collaborating effectively with developers, data engineers, and stakeholders
* Clear communication skills — able to explain testing strategy, coverage, and risk clearly to both technical and non\-technical audiences
* Experience mentoring or enabling other engineers to adopt good testing practices
* Programming/scripting skills (e.g. Python, Java, C\#) to build and maintain test frameworks and tooling


 Desirable:
   

  

* Experience with test reporting and quality dashboards
* Finance or investment management domain knowledge
* Genuine interest in AI, with practical experience using AI tools to speed up test creation and maintenance


**What We Value**
* Enablement over gatekeeping \- you help other teams test well rather than being the sole quality checkpoint
* Transparency \- you make quality and test coverage visible and easy to understand for everyone
* Ownership \& continuous improvement \- you take end\-to\-end responsibility for test quality and constantly look to automate and simplify
* Clear communication \- you explain your reasoning and findings to technical and non\-technical stakeholders alike


**Other Requirements**
* Flexibility in working hours
* Hybrid working arrangements (at least 2x a week in the office)


**Benefits**
* Global hybrid work policy \- We ask you to work 2 days a week from the office. If you choose you can work remotely the other days. Of course, you are welcome at the office if that is your preference.
* Culture – Inclusive and diverse company culture.
* Work\-life balance – We believe that an equilibrium between professional responsibilities makes us all the best version of ourselves, both in private life and as colleagues in the workplace.
* Empowerment – We believe that all voices are valuable and must be heard. You will be involved in shaping our work processes.
* Career \& Growth – Simcorp does offer opportunities for professional development: there is never just only one route \- we offer an individual approach to professional development to support the direction you want to take.


**NEXT STEPS**
 Please send us your application in English via our career site as soon as possible, we process incoming applications continually. Please note that only applications sent through our system will be processed. At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur in the recruitment process. To uphold fairness and equal opportunities for all applicants, we kindly ask you to exclude personal data such as photos, age, or any non\-professional information from your application. Thank you for aiding us in our endeavor to mitigate biases in our recruitment process.
   

  

 If you are interested in being a part of SimCorp but are not sure this role is suitable, submit your CV anyway. SimCorp is on an exciting growth journey, and our Talent Acquisition Team is ready to assist you discover the right role for you. The approximate time to consider your CV is three weeks.
   

  

 We are eager to continually improve our talent acquisition process and make everyone’s experience positive and valuable. Therefore, during the process we will ask you to provide your feedback, which is highly appreciated.
   

  

**WHO WE ARE?**
 For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become the world’s leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are 3,000\+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, education, professional experiences, ages, and backgrounds.
   

  

 SimCorp is an independent subsidiary of the Deutsche Börse Group. Following the recent merger with Axioma, we leverage the combined strength of our brands to provide an industry\-leading, full, front\-to\-back offering for our clients.

We are committed to building a culture where diverse perspectives and expertise are integrated into our everyday work. We believe in the continual growth and development of our employees, so that we can provide best\-in\-class solutions to our clients.

 A new regulatory change lands somewhere in the world every six minutes, and agentic AI is outpacing most teams' ability to govern it. At Archer, we help the enterprises powering the global economy turn that pressure into an advantage.

 Siemens Digital Industries Software is a leading provider of solutions for the design, simulation, and manufacture of products across many different industries. Formula 1 cars, skyscrapers, ships, space exploration vehicles, and many of the objects we see in our daily lives are being conceived and manufactured using our software.
   

  

 We are looking for an experienced Software QA Engineer with strong expertise in test automation, API testing, and modern quality engineering practices to help ensure the reliability and quality of our software products.
   

  

 In this role, you will design and implement automated testing solutions across functional, regression, integration, API, and end\-to\-end scenarios. You will work closely with Product Management, Software Development, Quality Engineering, and other stakeholders to define effective test strategies and integrate automated testing into CI/CD pipelines.
   

  

 The role also provides an opportunity to work with AI\-agent\-driven workflows, LLM\-based applications, knowledge graph technologies, and modern test automation approaches.
   

  

 The ideal candidate combines strong programming and automation skills with analytical thinking, problem\-solving ability, curiosity, and a strong quality mindset.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Design and develop test automation: Build, maintain, and enhance automated test frameworks and scripts for functional, regression, integration, and end\-to\-end testing using appropriate tools and programming languages.
* Drive end\-to\-end quality: Partner with Product Managers, Developers, Quality Engineers, and business stakeholders to understand workflows, define test strategies, identify risks, and ensure comprehensive test coverage for new features and releases.
* Automate continuous testing: Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines to provide continuous feedback, accelerate defect detection, and improve release confidence.

* Test AI and agentic workflows: Develop testing approaches for AI\-agent\-driven workflows and LLM\-based applications, evaluating functional behavior, workflow reliability, accuracy, and expected outcomes.
* Investigate and communicate quality issues: Execute automated tests, analyze results, identify root causes, document defects, and collaborate with development teams to drive timely resolution.
* Continuously improve automation: Enhance existing frameworks, expand automation coverage, improve maintainability and execution efficiency, and maintain clear documentation for test assets, results, and processes.


**Qualifications**

description:
**Job Description**
**Ciklum** 
 is looking for a
 **Senior Automation QA JavaScript Engineer** 
 to join our team full\-time in India.
   

  

 We are a custom product engineering company that supports both multinational organizations and scaling startups to solve their most complex business challenges. With a global team of over 4,000 highly skilled developers, consultants, analysts and product owners, we engineer technology that redefines industries and shapes the way people live.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As a Senior Automation QA JavaScript Engineer to join the project, an ambitious initiative to build an enterprise\-grade Agent Development Platform (ADP) that our client will commercialize to their own customers. This is quality engineering for a system that is non\-deterministic by nature, where "expected output" is a statistical claim rather than a string match, and where the platform's reliability guarantees no lost workflow runs, strict tenant isolation, graceful degradation under provider outages are contractual commitments, not aspirations. You will build the automation that proves those guarantees hold, release after release.
   

  

 You will own the test automation that spans the whole platform: the Frontend and Backend that agent developers depend on, the long\-running Temporal workflows that must survive worker crashes and provider failures, the multi\-tenant isolation boundaries that protect one customer's data from another, and the performance and concurrency targets defined in the platform's NFRs. Much of your craft is adversarial and failure\-first injecting worker kills, retry storms, and malformed documents to verify the system recovers exactly as specified, and negative\-testing disallowed tool calls and egress paths to confirm the sandbox holds. Where agent behavior must be judged rather than asserted, you will partner closely with the evaluation function, contributing the test infrastructure, synthetic\-data pipelines, and CI integration that make quality measurable and repeatable.
   

  

 This is a high\-visibility role where we establish the production\-ready foundation the rest of the program is built on. Your automated suites become release gates, and the evidence they produce feeds directly into client milestone sign\-offs so your work must be reproducible, trustworthy, and defensible to a sophisticated client. As the platform scales toward an "agent\-a\-month" delivery cadence, you will build the reusable test scaffolds and harnesses that let quality keep pace with delivery, ensuring that month twelve ships as safely as month one. You will work shoulder\-to\-shoulder with AI engineers, platform engineers, and the evaluation team, embedding quality from the design stage rather than inspecting for it at the end.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Platform \& Agent Test Automation
+ Design, build, and maintain automated test suites for the platform, Frontend and Backend, including contract tests that protect the agent developer experience as the SDK evolves
+ Build automated tests for long\-running Temporal workflows including failure injection (worker kill, provider outage, retry storms) to verify durable\-execution guarantees such as zero lost runs and correct compensation/saga behavior
+ Automate multi\-tenant isolation verification cross\-tenant data access, configuration bleed, and cost\-attribution correctness executed per release as a platform acceptance criterion
+ Verify agent execution sandboxing and egress controls through negative testing of disallowed tool calls and network destinations

* AI\-Specific \& Non\-Deterministic Testing
+ Design test strategies for LLM\-driven behavior: statistical assertions over repeated runs (pass consistency), semantic\-similarity scoring, confidence\-threshold validation, and flakiness quarantine that distinguishes model variance from genuine regression
+ Build and continuously extend adversarial test corpora document\-borne prompt injection in lease PDFs, tool\-call hijack, and data\-exfiltration probes aligned to OWASP LLM Top 10 and recognized red\-team taxonomies
+ Verify Human\-in\-the\-Loop (HITL) escalation behavior confidence thresholds fire correctly and no gated/irreversible action completes without authorization
+ Partner with the evaluation function on golden\-dataset\-driven checks, contributing test infrastructure, synthetic\-data (synthetic lease) pipelines, and CI integration that make agent quality measurable and repeatable

* Performance, Reliability \& NFR Verification
+ Automate verification of platform NFRs invocation overhead (p95\), concurrency targets, queue backpressure behavior, and LLM provider failover time and surface trends per release
+ Use tracing data (Langfuse / OpenTelemetry spans) as a first\-class test asset: assert on trace completeness, token/cost\-accounting accuracy, and alerting behavior for anomalous runs

* Process, Evidence \& Collaboration
+ Wire test suites into CI/CD as hard release gates with automated, per\-metric regression flagging on pull requests
+ Produce auditable, reproducible test\-evidence packs that feed directly into client milestone sign\-off
+ Embed with AI and platform engineers from the design stage making acceptance criteria, testability, and observability inputs to architecture, not afterthoughts
+ Maintain test environments, mocked LLM/provider layers, and synthetic data generators that keep test runs fast, deterministic where possible, and affordable
+ Mentor mid\-level QA engineers, codify AI testing patterns into reusable internal frameworks, and contribute to Ciklum's quality engineering practice and AI Academy


**Requirements**
* 8\+ years of test automation with API testing, and building test frameworks other engineers adopt, not just test cases
* Hands\-on experience testing LLM\-powered or other non\-deterministic systems statistical assertions, semantic scoring, and managing model variance (this is the differentiator; cite real examples)
* Experience testing asynchronous, event\-driven systems failure injection, idempotency verification, eventual\-consistency assertions; Temporal or a similar workflow engine a strong plus
* Strong CI/CD integration skills (GitHub Actions or equivalent) and the discipline to design release gates
* Solid SQL and data\-validation skills; comfort building synthetic test\-data pipelines and measuring dataset quality
* A security\-testing and adversarial mindset; familiarity with prompt\-injection techniques or a strong AppSec testing background with willingness to specialize fast
* Demonstrated judgment on what "tested enough" means under milestone pressure, and the ability to defend quality evidence to non\-engineering stakeholders
* Strong proficiency in Playwright and TypeScript is mandatory for building automated test suites
* QA Automation Core: Extensive experience in building automated test frameworks (Playwright/Typescript\-based) and integrating them into high\-security CI/CD pipelines
* AI/LLM Literacy: Deep understanding of Large Language Model behaviors, prompt sensitivity, and the common failure modes of RAG (Retrieval\-Augmented Generation) systems
* Analytical Mindset: Strong capability in statistical analysis to interpret evaluation scores and provide actionable feedback to AI Engineers for prompt tuning


**Desirable**
* Performance/load tooling (k6, Locust) for concurrency and latency NFR verification
* Prior testing of multi\-tenant SaaS isolation
* Exposure to eval/observability stacks (Langfuse, LangSmith, Promptfoo, DeepEval, Arize Phoenix)
* Compliance evidence experience (SOC 2, GDPR) or accessibility testing (Section 508 / WCAG)
* Familiarity with Commercial Real Estate workflows (lease accounting, CAM reconciliation) or document\-extraction systems (OCR, layout parsing)
* Experience using LLMs to generate test cases, adversarial payloads, or synthetic documents
* Performance Testing: Experience testing high\-concurrency background processing within agentic systems
* Experience with qTest for test management


**What’s in it for you?**
* Strong community: Work alongside top professionals in a friendly, open\-door environment
* Growth focus: Take on large\-scale projects with a global impact and expand your expertise
* Tailored learning: Boost your skills with internal events (meetups, conferences, workshops), Udemy access, language courses, and company\-paid certifications
* Endless opportunities: Explore diverse domains through internal mobility, finding the best fit to gain hands\-on experience with cutting\-edge technologies
* Care: We’ve got you covered with company\-paid medical insurance, mental health support, and financial \& legal consultations


**About Us**
 At Ciklum, we are always exploring innovations, empowering each other to achieve more, and engineering solutions that matter. With us, you’ll work with cutting\-edge technologies, contribute to impactful projects, and be part of a One Team culture that values collaboration and progress.
   

  

 India is a strategic innovation hub for Ciklum, with growing teams in Chennai and Pune leading advancements in EdgeTech, AR/VR, IoT, and beyond. Join us to collaborate on game\-changing solutions and take your career to the next level.
   

  

**Explore, empower, engineer with Ciklum!**
 Interested already? We would love to get to know you! Submit your application. We can’t wait to see you at Ciklum.

Align diverse perspectives and drive consensus to create feasible solutions.

 US Deloitte Technology Product Engineering has modernized software and product delivery, creating a scalable, cost\-effective model that focuses on value/outcomes that leverages a progressive and responsive talent structure. We develop and deploy cutting\-edge internal and go\-to\-market solutions that help Deloitte operate effectively and lead in the market. Our reputation is built on a tradition of delivering with excellence.

* Excellent interpersonal and organizational skills, with the ability to handle diverse situations, complex projects, and changing priorities, behaving with passion, empathy, and care.


**Required Qualifications:**
* A bachelor’s degree in computer science, software engineering, data science, machine learning, or related discipline. Experience is the most relevant factor.


 Hands On experience with Performance Engineering is important.

* 1\+ years of experience establishing engineering standards and golden paths, including actively leading, mentoring, and guiding team members in the adoption and continuous improvement of these standards, treating the platform as a product.

* Work alongside AI agents as co\-workers within our AI\-SDLC framework — using Anthropic Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, and AWS Bedrock throughout design, development, testing, deployment, and maintenance cycles

* Surface and mitigate quality risks before they escalate — proactively communicating test coverage gaps, flagging scope concerns during planning, and helping keep the team's quality commitments on track
* Own the test strategy and automation architecture with data quality as the primary focus — spanning ETL/ELT pipeline validation, source\-to\-target reconciliation, functional, end\-to\-end (Playwright), BDD, and performance (JMeter) layers
* Build and maintain robust Python\-based test frameworks and BDD feature suites — including reusable SQL and pandas/PySpark assertion libraries for data comparison, profiling, and reconciliation — that align test coverage to biopharma business requirements
* Design and govern JMeter performance test plans covering both application and data layers — pipeline throughput, load\-window adherence, and large\-volume query response; analyse results and drive remediation with development teams
* Own end\-to\-end data quality across the platform's ingestion and transformation pipelines — designing and automating validation of raw, staged, and curated layers in Snowflake and PostgreSQL
* Write and own the complex SQL that proves business logic independently of the pipeline code — reconciling source, staging, and curated layers rather than trusting transformation output at face value
* Build automated reconciliation suites covering row counts, control totals, referential integrity, deduplication, late\-arriving data, slowly changing dimension handling, and idempotency on pipeline reruns
* Design and maintain reusable test data — synthetic and masked production\-like datasets that exercise edge cases, nulls, boundary values, historical restatements, and malformed or out of\-spec source files

* Define, automate, and report on data quality rules and SLAs — completeness, accuracy, timeliness, uniqueness, and conformity — making data quality visible to the team and to stakeholders
* Serve as the go\-to QA engineer for the harder test challenges — the person the team relies on when data complexity, regulatory risk, or system ambiguity is highest

* Incorporate pharma manufacturer client needs and regulatory requirements into test coverage decisions; participate actively in incident responses and quality reviews that have direct client impact
* Apply strong analytical and problem\-solving skills to trace data defects back to root cause through the pipeline — distinguishing source data issues from transformation logic defects and orchestration failures — anticipating failure modes and designing coverage for them proactively rather than reactively; evaluate quality trade\-offs and drive decisions with appropriate rigour
* Demonstrate full accountability for your own work and the team's quality output — holding yourself answerable to team\-level quality outcomes, not just individual test deliverables; proactively managing risks, communicating progress, and owning quality end\-to\-end
* Lift the overall quality output of the team — through proactive test design collaboration, knowledge sharing, unblocking, and consistently raising the bar on what the team ships
* Stay current with the team's evolving test toolset — including AI\-augmented testing practices, Playwright updates, BDD patterns, and biopharma regulatory developments — and actively bring relevant updates into team practices
* Partner effectively across backend developers, UI/UX developers, product analysts, and domain stakeholders — communicating clearly within a geographically distributed team
* Mentor junior QA engineers and champion quality best practices across the team
* Evaluate and integrate AI\-powered testing tools into the QA workflow


**Qualifications**
* 7\+ years in software quality engineering, with the majority of that time spent on data\-centric testing — ETL/ELT pipelines, data warehouses, and reporting/consumption layers.  Amazon Payments supports multiple payment options and processes millions of transactions every day across numerous countries and payment methods. Over 100 million customers and merchants send tens of billions of dollars moving at light\-speed through our systems annually, and use our products on and off Amazon.
   

  

 We build systems that provide various payments features and process payments at an unprecedented scale, with accuracy, speed, and mission\-critical availability. We innovate to improve customer experience across the globe, with support for currency choice, pay using installments, pay with reward points, in\-store payments, pay on delivery, credit and debit payments, seller disbursements, gift cards, and many new exciting and challenging ideas are in the works.

 The Senior Security Automation Engineer designs, builds, and operates the automation that lets Clearwater's security operations scale without scaling headcount at the same rate. This role owns the full lifecycle of automation development — from mapping a manual security workflow, to building the integration and logic that automates it, to monitoring that automation in production — across phishing triage, host isolation, user offboarding, alert enrichment, and ticket handling.
   

  

 This is a builder role for someone who thinks like both a security practitioner and a software engineer: comfortable reasoning about incident\-response logic and comfortable writing production\-quality code that other engineers can maintain. The Senior Security Automation Engineer partners closely with SOC, Incident Response, and IT teams to find automation opportunities, and is expected to bring judgment about where automation — including AI\-driven automation — helps versus where it introduces risk.
   

  

**Specific Job Responsibilities**
* 
+ Workflow Orchestration: Design automated playbooks for common security scenarios (e.g., phishing triage, host isolation, user offboarding) using code or logic flows.
+ API Integration: Build custom connectors to link disparate systems (e.g., SIEM, EDR, Ticketing Systems) via REST/gRPC APIs.
+ ChatOps: Develop bots for internal collaboration platforms (e.g., Slack/Teams) to enable self\-service security tasks.

title: Test Architect
description:
**Our Mission**
**SPAN is enabling electrification for all ⚡**
 We are a mission\-driven company designing, building, and deploying products that electrify the built environment, reduce carbon emissions, and slow the effects of climate change.
   

  

* Decarbonization is the process to reduce or remove greenhouse gas emissions, especially carbon dioxide, from entering our atmosphere.
* Electrification is the process of replacing fossil fuel appliances that run on gas or oil with all\-electric upgrades for a cleaner way to power our lives.


**At SPAN, We Believe In**
* Enabling homes and vehicles powered by clean energy
* Making electrification upgrades possible
* Building more resilient homes with reliable backup
* Designing a flexible and distributed electrical grid


**The Role**
 Test Architect (Energy Systems \& Grid Integration)
   

  

 Role Summary
   

  

 The Test Architect is a senior individual contributor who defines and owns the end\-to\-end validation strategy for SPAN's intelligent energy products — spanning hardware, firmware, cloud, and mobile. This role requires deep expertise in power/energy systems testing, HIL/HITL architecture, CI/CD integration, and cross\-functional collaboration across India and US teams. The hire will directly raise release confidence, reduce field defects, and scale SPAN's global quality infrastructure.
   

  

**Step 1\. Job Description**
 As a Test Architect at SPAN, you will define and drive the end\-to\-end test strategy and architecture for SPAN's intelligent energy systems — including SPAN Panels, SPAN Drive, battery integrations, EV charging, and grid interactions. You will ensure system reliability, safety, and scalability across hardware, firmware, cloud, and mobile applications.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Define end\-to\-end validation strategy across SPAN Panel (Gen2/Gen3\), SPAN Drive, battery systems (e.g., Powerwall, Franklin), and grid/load interactions.
* Build system\-level test architecture covering App ↔ Cloud ↔ Hardware ↔ Grid; mix manual, automation, HIL/SIL.
* Apply risk\-based testing for safety\-critical power systems; ensure coverage for corner cases and failure modes.
* Lead validation of energy flows, outages, failover, backup scenarios, interoperability with inverters, batteries, and EVSEs.
* Partner closely with teams on third\-party integrations to validate end\-to\-end behaviours.
* Architect scalable HIL/HIL environments with simulators and emulators.
* Standardize lab procedures and fixtures; ensure India and US labs are aligned and interchangeable.
* Integrate suites into CI/CD (Buildkite, Jenkins, GitHub Actions); enforce quality gates and build health signals.
* Define and track coverage (feature/system/integration), defect leakage/escape rate, pass rate, MTTR, and MTTD.
* Standardize dashboards in JIRA, TestRail; ensure traceability requirements → test cases → defects.
* Collaborate with Product, Firmware, Software, and DevOps to align on release risk and validation scope.


**Required Skills \& Experience**
 Core Expertise
   

  

* Test Architecture for system\-level products across hardware, firmware, and cloud/mobile.
* Automation frameworks (Python, JS, Robot/System frameworks), design patterns, reliability engineering mindset.
* CI/CD and release pipelines; artifact versioning; environment orchestration; test data management.


 Domain Knowledge (Critical for SPAN)
   

  

* Power/energy systems, EV, renewables; grid behavior (voltage, frequency, phase, outages).
* Battery systems, inverters, EVSE; protocols CAN, Modbus, MQTT, REST APIs.
* Hands\-on with oscilloscope, power analyzers, grid simulators, and electrical safety practices.


 Tools \& Technologies
   

  

* CI/CD: Buildkite, Jenkins, GitHub Actions; OTA: Mender; Test tools: TestRail, JIRA, Jama; Embedded/Linux (Yocto).


 Nice to Have
   

  

* UL/IEC compliance exposure; grid codes and safety standards; multi\-region power systems experience.


 Key Traits \& Impact
   

  

* Analytical, system\-level thinking; superb debugging; clear communication and stakeholder management.
* Ownership and bias for action; collaborative across US and India teams.
* Impact: higher release confidence, scalable global testing, fewer field defects, faster time\-to\-market.


**Life at SPAN**
 Our
 **Bengaluru** 
 team plays a pivotal role in SPAN’s continued growth and expansion. Together, we’re driving
 **engineering** 
 ,
 **product development** 
 , and
 **operational excellence** 
 to shape the future of home energy solutions.
   

  

 As part of our team in India, you’ll have the opportunity to collaborate closely with our teams in the US and across the globe. This international collaboration fosters innovation, learning, and growth, while helping us achieve our bold mission of electrifying homes and advancing clean energy solutions worldwide.
   

  

 Our in\-office culture offers the chance for dynamic interactions and hands\-on teamwork, making SPAN a truly collaborative environment where every team member’s contribution matters.
   

  

 Our climate\-focused culture is driven by a team of forward\-thinkers, engineers, and problem\-solvers who push boundaries every day.
   

  

* Do mission\-driven work: Every role at SPAN directly advances clean energy adoption.
* Bring powerful ideas to life: We encourage diverse ideas and perspectives to drive stronger products.
* Nurture an innovation\-first mindset: We encourage big thinking and bold action.
* Deliver exceptional customer value: We value hard work, and the ability to deliver exceptional customer value.


**Benefits At SPAN India**
 ⚡

**⚡Comprehensive** 
**Insurance \& Health Benefits**

title: Head of Execution Technology
description:
**Who We Are**
 Optiver is a global market maker founded in Amsterdam, with offices in London, Chicago, Austin, New York, Sydney, Shanghai, Hong Kong, Singapore, Taipei and Mumbai. Established in 1986, today we are a leading liquidity provider, with close to 2,000 employees in offices around the world, united in our commitment to improve the market through competitive pricing, execution and risk management. By providing liquidity on multiple exchanges across the world in various financial instruments we participate in the safeguarding of healthy and efficient markets. We provide liquidity to financial markets using our own capital, at our own risk, trading a wide range of products: listed derivatives, cash equities, ETFs, bonds and foreign currencies.
   

  

 In Asia Pacific, Optiver was one of the first global market makers to establish a presence in the region, with the incorporation our Sydney office in 1996\. Since then, we have expanded our footprint by establishing offices in Taipei (2005\), Hong Kong (2007\), Shanghai (2012\) and Singapore (2021\). The business in Mumbai is newly established and deemed to be an integral part of the APAC strategy, with an anticipation of significant growth over the coming years.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
 We are looking for an experienced Software Development Team Lead (C\+\+ \& FPGA) to lead our India Execution Team, focused on building Optiver’s next\-generation ultra\-low latency trading systems.
   

  

 In this role, you will lead a hybrid team of C\+\+ software engineers and FPGA developers, driving the design and delivery of systems that achieve best\-in\-market trade execution across Indian exchanges (NSE, BSE, MCX). You’ll work at the intersection of software and hardware, shaping how system architecture is split across software and the FPGA to optimise latency, throughput, and reliability.
   

  

 You won’t be doing this in isolation \- you’ll collaborate closely with established execution and FPGA teams in Sydney and Shanghai, while contributing to Optiver’s broader execution strategy across APAC.
   

  

 As a leader, you’ll partner with trading, risk, compliance, and research teams locally in Mumbai to define and execute the vision for our execution platform. You’ll join an already established team with strong talent, focusing on scaling the team and maintaining a high\-performance engineering culture, while remaining hands\-on in system design across C\+\+ and FPGA and contributing directly to C\+\+ development.
   

  

 Our engineers own problems end\-to\-end—from understanding trading challenges to designing, implementing, testing, and deploying solutions into live markets. Development is fast\-paced and impactful, with features often reaching production within days.
   

  

**Your responsibilities will include:**
* Lead and grow a high\-performance team of C\+\+ and FPGA engineers, including hiring, mentoring, and performance management.
* Define and evolve the architecture of our ultra\-low latency trading stack, balancing software and hardware design decisions.
* Design and implement high\-performance C\+\+ systems for order management, exchange connectivity, and risk controls.
* Guide the development of FPGA components and hybrid FPGA/software systems for latency\-critical paths.
* Partner with trading and research teams to improve execution performance and ensure Optiver is \#1 in execution for Indian markets.
* Contribute to the strategy and vision for Optiver’s Asia Pacific execution capability.
* Drive robustness and quality through strong engineering practices, including code reviews, testing, and production monitoring.
* Own and improve automated trading risk controls within our execution systems.
* Collaborate across global teams to share knowledge and influence broader system design.


**Who You Are**
 We’re looking for a technically strong and people\-focused leader with a background in building high\-performance systems and a passion for developing teams. You should have:
   

  

  

* 5\+ years of experience as a Software Engineer, with strong C\+\+ experience building backend systems, client\-server architectures, or distributed systems.
* 3\+ years of demonstrated formal leadership experience.
* Experience developing or maintaining exchange connectivity systems or other high\-reliability, latency\-sensitive systems.
* Proven ability to solve technically challenging problems, with a pragmatic and results\-driven mindset.
* Experience owning work across the full software development lifecycle \- from requirements gathering through design, implementation, testing, and production delivery.
* Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with trading, research, and other business teams.
* Experience leading projects as a technical owner, driving delivery and influencing design decisions.
* Interest in working across software and hardware boundaries in hybrid C\+\+/FPGA systems.


 If you have any of these, we’re even more excited to hear from you:
   

  

  

* Experience working with FPGAs or embedded systems, or exposure to hardware/software co\-design.
* Background in low latency systems within a similar trading firm.
* Experience directly leading a team.


**What You'll Get**
* A performance\-based bonus structure unmatched anywhere in the industry. We combine our profits across desks, teams and offices into a global profit pool, fostering a truly collaborative environment.
* The chance to work alongside diverse and intelligent peers in a rewarding environment.
* Continuous learning, development and upskilling opportunities.
* Daily breakfast, lunch, and an in\-house barista.
* Gym/Club membership, plus weekly massages.
* Corporate health insurance
* Uber business for daily commute
* Regular social events, including a company trip every two years.

title: Quality Assurance Automation Engineer
description:
**Location** 





 Onsite \- Noida, India
 




  





**Employment Type** 





 Full\-time
 




  





**Reporting To** 





 Founder
 




  





**Experience Required** 





 2\-4 years 
 




  





**Qualifications** 





 Graduate (B.Tech in IT or Computer Science preferred)
 




  





**About the role** 





 We are looking for a Quality Assurance Engineer (Playwright or Selenium) who will be responsible for ensuring that all our digital products\- Mobile applications (Android, Flutter), websites (NEXT.js, React), and backend systems, meet the highest standards of quality and performance.
 





 The ideal candidate is detail\-oriented, logical, and organized, with a strong technical understanding of both automation and manual testing processes. You will work closely with developers to write, maintain, and optimize test cases, ensuring every deployment is smooth, bug\-free, and reliable.
 




  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Ensure end\-to\-end product quality across Android applications, NEXT.js and React websites, and backend systems.
* Write, execute, and maintain test cases for all applications and ensure they are updated as systems evolve.
* Ensure proper documentation and organization of all test cases and testing processes.
* Collaborate with developers to identify and fix bugs quickly, ensuring high\-quality releases.
* Use Playwright, Selenium, and Postman for automation and API testing.
* Analyze bugs, log issues, and track them through resolution using project management tools.
* Contribute to continuous improvement of QA processes, test automation frameworks, and standards.
* Proficiency with testing frameworks, automation tools (e.g., Playwright, Selenium, Cypress), and API testing.
* Solid understanding of Agile methodologies and the software development life cycle (SDLC).
* Excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills with a keen eye for detail.



  





**Skills \& Competencies** 



* Proficiency in Python/Node.js for writing test scripts.
* Strong understanding of programming languages: Node, Java, Dart, JavaScript.
* Database familiarity: Firebase, PostgreSQL, MySQL.
* Experience with Postman, Playwright, and Selenium.
* Working knowledge of REST API testing (Postman/Newman, curl, or pytest requests).
* Excellent test case organization and documentation abilities.
* Strong logical thinking, analytical mindset, and problem\-solving orientation.
* Ability to communicate effectively with developers and stakeholders.



  





**Success Metrics / KPIs** 



* Bug\-Free Deployments: Measured reduction in critical post\-deployment issues.
* Number of Deployments: Increased volume of stable and verified releases.
* Speed of Testing: Reduced turnaround time between builds and QA sign\-off.
* Test Coverage: Comprehensive test case coverage across all modules and products.



  





**What We’re Looking For** 



* Highly logical and analytical thinker with a structured approach to problem\-solving.
* Meticulous and organized in handling documentation and multiple test scenarios.
* Collaborative mindset, working effectively with developers and product teams.
* Passionate about quality assurance, automation, and continuous improvement.
* Self\-driven and reliable, with a strong sense of accountability and ownership for product quality.



  





**About the Company** 





 SayaCare is a fast\-growing e\-health company dedicated to making healthcare and wellness simple, accessible, and personalized. Founded in 2021, we combine technology, care, and innovation to deliver reliable health solutions to our community. At Sayacare, we value collaboration, learning, and human\-focused solutions, and we are building a team that’s passionate, creative, and committed to improving lives.

title: Senior Tech Lead (SDET) - Tieto Caretech (m/f/d)
description:
**Job Description**
 At Tieto Caretech you’ll get a chance to provide patients and end users with product offerings that help them in their life, reinventing the world for good. If that sounds interesting, please keep on reading.
   

  

**About Us**
 Tieto Caretech is modernizing the Nordic health and social care sector with modular, open, and interoperable software. We develop and deliver high\-quality software solutions and services that enable healthcare and welfare professionals to do their work even better and with higher efficiency \- have more time to care.
   

  

 We are a global team of professionals working on providing products and services to different sectors from intensive care to laboratory and social care. In addition to working closely with our customers, we also have our own products that we build and develop for various fields in society. From enabling healthcare professionals to spend more valuable time with their patients to providing data for professional athletes to achieve even better results, we make all that possible. With us you can build technology for the good of society and make your mark on the health and wellbeing of people in need.
   

  

**About The Role**
 A Senior Technical Lead – SDET is responsible for driving end\-to\-end quality engineering, test strategy, and delivery excellence for complex software systems. This role combines test leadership, hands\-on technical expertise, and stakeholder collaboration, ensuring that products meet high quality, reliability, and performance standards.
   

  

 The role expects strong technical depth, owning test planning, execution, automation strategy, and continuous improvement, while proactively collaborating with cross\-functional stakeholders and customers.
   

  

**Technical Skills\-**
* Strong expertise in Automation Testing and QA processes
* UI Automation: Selenium / Playwright with C\#
* Automation Framework Development
* API Testing using C\# or relevant frameworks
* Performance Testing using JMeter
* Experience with test management and defect tracking tools
* Strong database knowledge (SQL Server or equivalent)
* Understanding of CI/CD pipelines and continuous testing


**With us you will be responsible for**
* Define and drive test strategy, test approach, and quality assurance processes for multiple products
* Lead test planning, estimation, scheduling, and execution across system testing, UAT, and releases
* Ensure comprehensive test coverage using risk\-based and data\-driven testing approaches
* Own test artifacts including test plans, test cases, test data, and test reports


**Quality Engineering \& Automation**
* Design and implement scalable test automation frameworks and solutions
* Drive AI\-first and automation\-first approach across UI, API, and performance testing
* Guide team in test design, reusable assets, and best engineering practices
* Continuously improve test efficiency, coverage, and defect detection capability


**Stakeholder Collaboration \& Customer Focus**
* Collaborate proactively with product owners, developers, architects, and customers
* Provide clear communication on quality status, risks, and mitigation plans
* Understand customer business needs and propose effective testing approaches
* Support pre\-sales activities by contributing to solutioning and test strategy proposals for PRF’s.


**Team Leadership \& Mentoring**
* Lead and mentor a team of QA engineers and SDETs
* Guide team members in automation and manual testing practices
* Build capability through coaching, knowledge sharing, and continuous feedback
* Ensure effective team organization, planning, and delivery ownership


**Defect Management \& Continuous Improvement**
* Analyze defects and guide teams in root cause analysis and prevention strategies
* Provide actionable feedback to development teams to improve product quality
* Drive process improvements and best practices in line with Agile and DevOps models
* Support reproduction and analysis of complex/rare defects


**We expect you to have**
* Minimum 10\+ years of experience in software testing / quality engineering
* At least 3–5 years of experience as Test Lead / Test Manager
* Proven experience in test design, execution, stakeholder collaboration, and team leadership
* Strong ability to handle complex systems, demanding scenarios, and multi\-team coordination
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments


**What’s in it for you?**
 In addition, as a company we offer you professional growth, open and friendly culture. We believe that our organizational culture is an important part of enabling you to be successful. We provide a flexible hybrid work model as part of our culture and way of working.
   

  

 Finally, we also believe in curiosity and learning as a lifestyle. We want to encourage you to keep up that curiosity and deepen your knowledge on topics you’re interested in.
   

  

**Could you be our new colleague?**
 We look forward to hearing from you! We will fill the position as soon as we find the right person, so we encourage you to apply today.
   

  

 Additional Information
   

  

 At Tieto, we believe in the power of diversity, equity, and inclusion. We encourage applicants of all backgrounds, genders (m/f/d), and walks of life to join our team, as we believe that this fosters an inspiring workplace and fuels innovation. Our commitment to openness, trust, and diversity is at the heart of our mission to create digital futures that benefit businesses, societies, and humanity.

title: QA Automation Engineer - QA 2

 The primary focus of this role will be to design, develop, and maintain automated test frameworks and test suites for mobile and web platforms. You will work closely with developers, product managers, and designers to ensure that new features are delivered with high quality and minimal regressions.
   

  

 As an e\-commerce platform, our applications power critical user journeys such as product catalogue browsing, checkout flows, payments, and order lifecycle management, and this role will play a key part in ensuring these flows remain stable and reliable.
   

  

 To succeed in this role, you should have a strong understanding of automation frameworks, frontend testing strategies, test design techniques, and CI/CD integration. Experience in mobile and web test automation along with modern QA practices will be highly valuable.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Design, develop, and maintain automation frameworks and test suites for Android, iOS, and Web applications.
   

  

 Write automated test cases for functional, regression, and end\-to\-end testing of customer\-facing features.
   

  

 Collaborate closely with frontend engineers (Android, iOS, Web) to understand application architecture and ensure proper automation coverage.
   

  

 Validate critical e\-commerce user journeys including product discovery, checkout flows, payment flows, and order lifecycle.
   

  

 Design and execute test scenarios using strong test design techniques such as boundary value testing, equivalence partitioning, and risk\-based testing.
   

  

 Manage and track test cases, test execution, and defects using Jira and related test management practices.
   

  

 Work closely with product managers and designers to validate business requirements and ensure correct feature behavior.
   

  

 Perform API testing and validation to ensure reliability of frontend\-backend integrations.
   

  

 Build and maintain automation pipelines integrated with CI/CD systems to enable continuous testing.
   

  

 Identify defects, analyze root causes, and collaborate with developers to ensure faster resolution.
   

  

 Monitor automation results and improve stability, reliability, and execution efficiency of automation suites.
   

  

 Continuously evaluate new tools, frameworks, and best practices to improve the overall QA automation ecosystem.
   

  

 Participate in Agile ceremonies, sprint planning, and release readiness discussions.
   

  

 Ensure high standards for performance, reliability, and usability across devices and browsers.
   

  

**Skills \& Requirements**
 Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
   

  

 3–5 years of experience in QA Automation, preferably testing mobile and web applications.
   

  

 Experience working with test management tools such as Jira for test case management and defect tracking.
   

  

**Hands\-on Experience With Automation Tools Such As**
* Appium / Espresso / XCUITest for mobile automation
* Selenium / Playwright / Cypress for web automation


 Experience writing automation tests using Java, Kotlin, JavaScript, or Python.
   

  

**Strong Understanding Of Test Design Techniques Such As**
* Boundary value analysis
* Equivalence partitioning
* Risk\-based testing


 Experience with API testing tools and frameworks such as Postman, Rest Assured, or similar.
   

  

 Good understanding of mobile and web application architecture and frontend workflows.
   

  

 Experience integrating automation test suites with CI/CD pipelines such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or GitLab CI.
   

  

 Proficiency with Git or similar code versioning tools.
   

  

 Experience testing REST APIs and JSON\-based services.
   

  

 Strong analytical and debugging skills.
   

  

 Excellent communication, collaboration, and problem\-solving skills.
   

  

 Ability to work effectively in a fast\-paced Agile development environment.
   

  

**Good To Have**
 Experience with BDD frameworks such as Cucumber / Gherkin.
   

  

 Experience with performance testing tools such as JMeter or k6\.
   

  

 Experience with mobile device farms such as BrowserStack or Firebase Test Lab.
   

  

 Understanding of mobile deep linking, push notifications, and analytics validation.
   

  

 Experience with test reporting tools such as Allure or ReportPortal.
   

  

 Understanding of modern frontend technologies and mobile architectures.

title: Senior QA Automation Engineer
description:
**About the Role** 




 We are looking for a Senior QA Automation Engineer / Quality Engineering Lead who will own the transformation of QA engineering at RunLoyal.
 



 This role is suited for someone who goes beyond executing test cases and is comfortable designing automation frameworks, testing APIs and databases, debugging issues, performing root\-cause analysis, and integrating automated testing into CI/CD pipelines.
 



 The ideal candidate should be technically strong, curious, and capable of understanding a system end\-to\-end from requirements and user stories through development, testing, release, and production monitoring.
 



  





**QA Transformation \& Engineering Leadership** 



* Assess the current QA organization, automation maturity, testing processes, tools, and technical capabilities.
* Define and execute a roadmap to transform QA into an automation\-first Quality Engineering function.
* Establish standards for automation architecture, coding practices, test design, test data, environments, and reporting.
* Identify high\-risk manual testing areas and systematically convert them into reliable automated coverage.
* Establish a scalable automation strategy across UI, API, integration, mobile, and end\-to\-end workflows.
* Define quality gates and integrate automated testing into CI/CD.
* Establish engineering metrics to measure automation coverage, test reliability, escaped defects, regression execution time, and release quality.
* Mentor and upskill existing QA engineers in programming, automation, API testing, SQL, debugging, and system\-level testing.
* Identify technical capability gaps within the QA team and recommend training, tooling, process improvements, or additional hiring.
* Establish a culture of quality ownership rather than test execution.



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. Automation Testing** 



* Design, develop, maintain, and enhance automated test suites for web applications and APIs.
* Build scalable and maintainable automation using tools/frameworks such as Selenium, Playwright, Playwright MCP, Cypress, Appium, TestNG, Cucumber, or equivalent.
* Develop reusable automation components and frameworks rather than relying only on record\-and\-playback approaches.
* Maintain and optimize automated regression suites across product releases.
* Identify manual testing activities that can be automated and continuously improve test coverage.
* Analyze automation failures and distinguish between application defects, test defects, environment issues, and data issues.



**2\. Functional \& System Testing** 



* Understand product requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and functional specifications.
* Design comprehensive test scenarios, test cases, and test strategies for complex features.
* Perform functional, integration, regression, exploratory, and end\-to\-end testing.
* Validate complete business workflows across multiple services and components.
* Identify edge cases and potential failure scenarios before they reach production.
* Participate actively in sprint planning, refinement, retrospectives, and release activities.



**3\. API Testing** 



* Design and execute API test scenarios covering:
* Positive and negative cases
* Authentication and authorization
* Request/response validation
* Error handling
* Data integrity
* Integration scenarios
* Work with tools such as Postman, REST Assured, Swagger, or equivalent.
* Build automated API test suites where appropriate.
* Validate API behavior against database records and application behavior.



**4\. Database Testing** 



* Write and execute SQL queries to validate application data.
* Perform backend validation using databases such as MySQL/PostgreSQL or equivalent.
* Verify data consistency between UI, APIs, and backend systems.
* Identify data\-related defects and assist developers in troubleshooting them.



**5\. Debugging, Logs \& Root Cause Analysis** 



* Investigate defects beyond simply reproducing them.
* Analyze application logs, network logs, and monitoring information to identify the root cause of issues.
* Collaborate with developers to provide meaningful technical information for defect resolution.
* Perform RCA for production and pre\-production issues.
* Work with monitoring/logging tools such as CloudWatch, Grafana, New Relic, Splunk, or equivalent.



**6\. CI/CD \& Release Quality** 



* Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines.
* Work with tools such as Jenkins, GitLab, Maven, Gradle, Docker, or equivalent.
* Ensure automated regression suites run reliably as part of the development/release process.
* Analyze failed pipelines and automation failures.
* Support release validation and production deployment activities.



**7\. Defect Management** 



* Identify, document, prioritize, and track defects using tools such as JIRA or equivalent.
* Provide clear reproduction steps, expected vs. actual results, logs, screenshots, and supporting evidence.
* Work closely with developers and product teams to drive defects to resolution.
* Perform regression testing after fixes.
* Identify recurring defects and contribute to preventive quality improvements.



**8\. Quality Engineering \& Continuous Improvement** 



* Identify gaps in the existing QA process and recommend improvements.
* Improve automation coverage, reliability, execution time, and maintainability.
* Contribute to QA standards, test strategies, automation frameworks, and documentation.
* Continuously evaluate new testing approaches and tools that can improve engineering efficiency.
* Use AI\-assisted testing and automation tools such as Claude and other AI coding/testing assistants where appropriate to improve productivity.
* Explore and leverage Playwright MCP and AI\-enabled testing workflows to improve test creation, execution, debugging, and maintenance.



  





**Required Skills** 




**Must\-Have** 



* 5\-8 years of experience in software QA/testing, with a focus on Quality Engineering leadership and automation strategy (exceptional candidates with 4\-5 years of experience may be considered).
* Strong hands\-on experience in automation testing.
* Strong programming knowledge in Java, JavaScript, Python, or a similar language.
* Strong engineering fundamentals and the ability to design scalable, maintainable automation architectures over expertise in specific tools.
* Playwright
* Selenium
* Cypress
* Appium
* Strong understanding of API testing.
* Hands\-on experience with REST APIs and tools such as Postman or REST Assured.
* Good knowledge of SQL and database testing.
* Strong understanding of functional, regression, integration, and end\-to\-end testing.
* Experience creating and maintaining automation frameworks/test suites.
* Experience working with Git and CI/CD pipelines.
* Ability to analyze logs and perform debugging and root\-cause analysis.
* Experience working in an Agile/Scrum environment.
* Strong understanding of software testing methodologies and QA processes.
* Ability to test a system end\-to\-end rather than focusing only on individual UI screens.



  





**Good to Have** 



* Experience with TestNG, Cucumber, Page Object Model (POM).
* Experience with Playwright MCP or similar MCP\-based testing/automation workflows.
* Experience with mobile testing using Appium.
* Experience with performance/load testing tools such as JMeter or LoadRunner.
* Experience with Docker/Kubernetes.
* Exposure to AWS, Azure, or GCP.
* Experience with monitoring/logging tools such as CloudWatch, Grafana, Datadog, Splunk, or New Relic.
* Experience testing complex SaaS, enterprise, fintech, payments, or transactional systems.
* Exposure to security testing.
* Exposure to AI/LLM\-based applications and AI\-assisted testing.
* Hands\-on experience using Claude, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, or similar AI tools for test automation, debugging, code generation, test\-case creation, or productivity enhancement.



  





**What We Are Looking For** 




 The ideal candidate is someone who:
 


* Thinks like an engineer, not just a test executor.
* Can understand a complex system and identify how different components interact.
* Can independently build or extend an automation framework.
* Is comfortable going from UI → API → Database → Logs when investigating an issue.
* Can write code and debug automation failures independently.
* Can determine what should be automated and what should remain manual.
* Has strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Is comfortable challenging requirements and identifying gaps before development is completed.
* Takes ownership of quality rather than considering QA to be only the final stage before release.
* Can work effectively with developers, product managers, and other stakeholders.
* Is comfortable working on unfamiliar and technically complex systems.
* Is open to adopting AI\-assisted QA and modern automation approaches, including tools such as Claude and Playwright MCP.



  





**Technical Depth We Expect** 




 For this role,
 **automation is a core requirement, not an additional skill** 
 .
 



 A candidate should ideally be able to demonstrate that they can take a feature and independently:
 



 Understand requirement → identify test scenarios → design test strategy → create automation → test APIs → validate database → execute regression → investigate failures → analyze logs → raise defects → validate fixes → integrate testing into CI/CD.
 



 That is the level of ownership we expect from this role.
 



  





**Education** 



* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
* Equivalent practical experience may be considered.



  





**Certifications (Good to Have)** 




 Certifications in Selenium, Playwright, API testing, cloud, or QA are good to have but not mandatory.
 



 Hands\-on technical ability and demonstrated automation experience will be given significantly more importance than certifications.
