title: Engineering Lead
description:
**We’re looking for people to join the Access family, who share our passion for believing in better, and who will help us continue to grow.** 




  





 Love Work. Love Life. Be You. \- is central to our success and how we give our customers the freedom to do more of what's important to them.
 



  





**What does Access offer you?** 




  





 We offer a blended approach to office working, encouraging you to collaborate and connect in one of our thriving offices. We deliver on what we say, taking the development of our people seriously. We’ll work with you to progress your success plan and provide opportunities to accelerate your career.
 



  





**Position Summary** 




 The Lead Software Engineer is a ‘50:50’ role. Half the time you are in the code — shipping production software, holding the technical bar and setting the standard the team follows. The other half you are leading the people, the process and the architecture — running a high\-performing engineering stream and developing the engineers within it.
 



  





 You’ll be joining a small, value\-aligned structure: up to two streams of four engineers each, with Product cover per stream. QA is owned by engineering — there is no handoff to a separate team, and that is by design.
 



  





 AI augmentation is a pre\-requisite for this role, not an optional extra. Access has invested in cutting\-edge AI tooling and we expect every engineer and leader to use AI pervasively to accelerate outcomes, raise quality, and shorten feedback loops. Lead Software Engineers are expected to model this behaviour, embed it into team standards and hold the bar for AI adoption across their streams. If you are not already working this way, you will need to get there fast.
 



  





**Key Accountabilities and Responsibilities** 




**Technical Leadership** 



* Spend approximately half your time as a hands\-on engineer: writing, reviewing and shipping production code to the same standard you hold your team to.
* Own the technical direction of your stream — architecture decisions, technology choices, design patterns and code standards.
* Set and maintain the engineering quality bar: code review standards, test coverage expectations, CI/CD discipline, observability and security practice.
* Identify and address technical debt proactively, balancing pragmatism with the long\-term health of the codebase.
* Contribute to platform\-wide architectural decisions, feeding your stream’s experience and evidence back into broader engineering strategy.



  





**People Leadership** 



* Own the performance, development and wellbeing of up to eight engineers across your streams.
* Run regular 1:1s, set clear goals, and give direct, actionable feedback — both positive and developmental.
* Manage the full performance cycle for your engineers: goal setting, mid\-year reviews, end\-of\-year assessments and, where necessary, performance improvement plans.
* Identify growth opportunities for each engineer and actively create the conditions for them to progress.
* Hire well — contribute to recruitment, assess candidates rigorously, and take accountability for the quality of who joins your team.
* Model the behaviours and working practices you expect from the team, including AI adoption, communication standards and engineering discipline.



  





**Delivery \& Process** 



* Keep your streams delivering consistently — predictable throughput, low change failure rate, fast recovery when things go wrong.
* Own the engineering process within your streams: sprint ceremonies, planning quality, backlog health and cross\-team dependency management.
* Work closely with Product to balance feature delivery against technical investment, making the trade\-offs visible and explicit rather than absorbed silently.
* Remove blockers for your engineers — escalate where needed, resolve where you can, and protect the team’s ability to focus.
* Ensure incidents are handled well: fast triage, clear communication, thorough post\-mortems, and unique failures — the same class of incident should not recur.



  





**Key Performance Indicators** 




**Technical** 



* Software owned by your streams meets reliability, latency and availability targets in production.
* Lead time for change trends downwards; deployment frequency trends upwards across your streams.
* Change failure rate stays under 15%; MTTR trends downwards.
* Critical and high security vulnerabilities patched within agreed SLAs (1 day / 14 days).
* AI tooling is a demonstrable, routine part of your workflow and embedded visibly in team standards.



  





**People** 



* Engineers in your streams have clear goals, regular feedback and a development plan they understand.
* Regrettable attrition is low; engineers in your streams are growing and progressing.
* Performance issues are identified early and managed directly, without escalation becoming the default.
* New hires reach productive contribution within an agreed onboarding window.



  





**Delivery** 



* Your streams deliver predictably against commitments made to Product and stakeholders.
* Failures are unique — the same defect or incident class does not recur.
* Technical debt is visible, prioritised and moving in the right direction.



  





**Skills, Knowledge, Experience \& Qualifications** 




**How We Work** 




 Before the tech stack, this is what working in the F\&B engineering team looks like. As a Lead Software Engineer you are expected to model these standards, not just meet them.
 


* AI tooling is your default starting point, not a fallback — Copilot, Claude Code, Devin, Cursor or equivalent are open before you write the first line.
* You use AI pervasively across the full development lifecycle: generating and reviewing code, writing tests, producing documentation, triaging incidents and researching unfamiliar domains.
* You can prompt effectively — you know how to get useful output, iterate on it, and critically evaluate what comes back rather than accepting it at face value.
* You treat AI\-generated code with the same scrutiny as code from a colleague — it gets reviewed, tested and owned by you.
* You actively embed AI working practices into your team — through standards, playbooks, code review culture and leading by example.
* You improve your AI working practices continuously and bring the team with you; this field moves fast and standing still is falling behind.
* Expect your interview process to include assessment on how you work with AI tooling — not just what you know without it. Come prepared to demonstrate your workflow, not just talk about it.



  





**Technical Foundation** 




 The fundamentals are non\-negotiable — your technical credibility is what earns the trust of your engineers.
 


* Strong commercial software engineering background with a track record of shipping production systems end\-to\-end.
* Clean code, automated testing and CI/CD discipline — you set the standard, which means you have to embody it.
* Comfortable across the stack — backend, frontend or full\-stack — able to review and contribute across the breadth of what your streams own.
* Solid SQL and relational database skills; experience with cloud\-hosted databases in production.
* Experience designing and consuming RESTful APIs and/or event\-driven architectures.
* Familiarity with containerisation (Docker, Kubernetes or equivalent).
* Experience making and communicating architectural decisions, including the trade\-offs involved.



  





**Leadership \& People** 



* Proven experience leading a software engineering team — setting direction, managing performance and developing engineers.
* Direct, honest and constructive communicator — comfortable giving difficult feedback and having conversations that matter.
* Able to manage competing priorities across engineering and people responsibilities without dropping either.
* Experience running engineering process — agile delivery, planning, retrospectives, incident management.
* Comfortable working asynchronously across distributed teams (UK and India).



  





**Technologies** 




 Access F\&B runs a broad and evolving tech stack. We care far more about solid fundamentals and the ability to learn than exact technology match.
 


* C\# / .NET — backend services, APIs and platform components.
* TypeScript / React — frontend and web\-based ordering and management interfaces.
* Azure — our primary cloud platform; experience with Azure\-native services (App Service, Service Bus, SQL, AKS, Key Vault) is valuable.
* AWS — also present across parts of the F\&B portfolio.



  





**Security \& Compliance** 



* Working knowledge of security fundamentals: auth and authorisation patterns, secrets management, encryption at rest and in transit, and PII handling.
* Awareness of GDPR and UK GDPR as they apply to software systems handling guest and payment data.



  





**What are we all about?** 




  





 The Access Group is one of the largest UK\-headquartered business management software providers. It provides solutions that empower more than 160,000 small and mid\-sized organisations in commercial and non\-profit sectors across Europe, USA and APAC, giving every employee the freedom to do more of what's important. Its innovative cloud solutions and integrated AI software experience across multiple Access products transform how business technology is used.
 



  





 With
 **over 9,300 talented individuals driving innovation and customer excellence** 
 , we’re shaping the future of work. And we want you to be part of it. At Access,
 **people are at the heart of everything we do** 
 . We’re committed to creating an inclusive, high\-performing culture where everyone feels valued, respected, and empowered to thrive. If you’re excited about this role \- even if your experience doesn’t tick every box \- you might be exactly who we’re looking for.
 



  





 We believe in equality for all and the transformative power of diversity. So why not join our vibrant team, where you can love what you do, love how you live, and most importantly, be authentically you?
 



  





 Let’s make a difference together.
 



**Love Work. Love Life. Be You.**

 Collaborating effectively across teams to deliver extensibility capabilities customers can adopt with confidence.

 Reliability earns trust. * Act as a technical specialist in system performance analysis using logs, traces, and KPIs such as throughput, latency, resource utilization, and QoS/QoE indicators to identify systemic bottlenecks and drive product\-level improvements.

* Perform capacity and performance verification of RAN systems under high\-load traffic scenarios comprising Max supported UEs per cell/DU, throughput (DL/UL), control plane capacity and mobility under load.
* Establish verification methodologies and quality standards that represent live network scenarios and provide coverage for performance, capacity, Stability and customer experience.
* Provide technical direction, coaching, and mentorship to verification engineers and contribute to the development of organizational competence in modern (AI) system verification practices.
* Drive continuous improvement of products, verification frameworks, test coverage, automation, CI/CD pipelines, and AI\-assisted verification practices, improving efficiency, quality, and time to market.
* Lead collaboration across RAN development, integration/CI, product management and other stakeholders organization to resolve issues and secure high\-quality deliveries.
* Lead customer trials and field issue reproduction, move quickly from symptoms to root cause and provide clear defect reports with actionable next steps.

* 8 \- 12\+ years of hands‑on experience in system\-level verification, deployment, integration, and troubleshooting of LTE/5G NR baseband and radio systems, including demonstrated technical leadership.
* Strong understanding of wireless communication systems (LTE/5G NR), RAN architecture and protocol stack, and 5G NR air‑interface technologies.
* Demonstrated experience analyzing and troubleshooting performance issues at PHY/MAC layer, including link curve verification, channel\-quality assessment, and evaluation under diverse and adverse channel conditions.
* Deep expertise of system level KPIs (throughput, latency, resource load, QoS/QoE) and the ability to identify performance bottlenecks.
* Experience working with Channel emulators, fading technologies, traffic generation and test tools (for example UE simulators, Viavi, real UEs).
* Advanced Linux skills and solid knowledge of IP routing, switching, and networking.
* Demonstrated success in influencing product, architecture, and release decisions through data\-driven verification insights and technical judgment.
* Programming, automation, and scripting skills (for example Python, Bash, Java) and solid understanding of CI/CD concepts.
* Experience with configuration management and automation tools (for example Git, Gerrit, Jenkins) in a modern development and integration environment.
* Strong problem solving and troubleshooting skills with a focus on verification improvements and innovation.
* Demonstrated customer focus, including experience supporting customer trials, reproducing field issues and assessing risk.


 Nice to have:
   

  

* Exposure to Cloud\-Native RAN, O\-RAN Architecture.
* Experience with commercial UE chipset platform testing (Qualcomm, MediaTek etc) and end‑to‑end performance validation.
* Knowledge of cloud‑native principles, containerization, and microservices‑based architectures.
* Familiarity with AI/ML tooling for test analytics and anomaly detection.
* Software development skills, particularly in Java and Python.

title: Support AI Manager
description:
**About Ethos**
 Ethos is a leading life insurance technology company on a mission to protect families by democratizing access to life insurance and empowering agents at scale. With its robust three\-sided technology platform, Ethos is transforming the life insurance experience for consumers, agents, and carriers alike. Ethos offers instant, accessible products and a seamless online process that requires no medical exams and just a few health questions; it eliminates traditional barriers, making it easier than ever for everyone to protect their families. Ethos is redefining how life insurance is bought, sold, and underwritten.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We're looking for a Support AI Manager to lead the team that builds and safeguards the quality of our AI\-powered support bots. This role owns two connected functions: the bot building team (led day\-to\-day by a build Lead who designs ERDs and manages hands\-on development) and the bot monitoring team (with functions including bot functionality audits, bug handling, quality control, and support). You'll manage and scale both, while remaining hands\-on enough to personally evaluate bot builds against spec and catch issues before they reach customers.
   

  

 The what and how of the roadmap are owned by our CX AI Product Manager, who sets priorities and writes the PRDs. Your job is to make sure what gets built actually matches that spec, to define how we test and monitor bots on an ongoing basis, and to make sure quality issues make it back into the roadmap fast. This is a hands\-on technical leadership role, not a purely administrative one — you should be comfortable reviewing a build yourself, not just hearing about it secondhand.
   

  

**Duties And Responsibilities**
* Manage and grow the bot building team and the bot quality/monitoring team, including coaching the build Lead as they grow into managing a focused, subject matter expert team of builders.
* Personally review bot builds and version deploys against approved ERDs and PRDs, catching spec drift, gaps, or quality issues before launch.
* Define and own the testing cadence for the team — pre\-launch UAT, regression testing, and frequency and scope of live bot audits.
* Own the feedback loop between quality/monitoring findings and the roadmap, making sure issues surfaced by your team get back to the Product Manager and build Lead quickly and are prioritized appropriately.
* Consolidate all feedback into a clear, structured format, ensuring all items are accurately tracked and escalated where appropriate.
* Serve as the primary escalation point when a build doesn't match spec or a quality issue is found, working directly with the build and quality teams to resolve it.
* Partner closely with the CX AI Product Manager to keep the build and quality functions aligned with roadmap priorities and sequencing.
* Use bot performance metrics (deflection rate, true resolution rate, CSAT, error rates) to spot systemic quality issues and drive process improvements across build and monitoring.
* Build and evolve the team's testing/monitoring playbook as the bot portfolio grows.


**Qualifications And Skills**
* 4\+ years of experience managing a team, ideally across more than one function or workstream.
* Hands\-on experience with the design, build, or QA of AI\-driven voice, chat or email bots — enough technical depth to personally evaluate a build against an ERD or PRD.
* Experience working within a product pod or similar cross\-functional product team structure, partnering closely with a product manager.
* Strong process orientation — comfortable defining and owning a testing and monitoring cadence from scratch, not just following an existing one.
* Detail\-oriented, with strong problem\-solving instincts and a track record of leading a team through issue resolution.
* Excellent communicator, able to translate technical build or quality issues for both technical teams and product/business stakeholders.
* Experience with support bot platforms (e.g., Forethought, Ada, Sierra, Decagon) is a strong plus.


 Don’t meet every single requirement? If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. At Ethos we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace.
   

  

 We are an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. Pursuant to the SF Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider employment for qualified applicants with arrests and conviction records.
   

  

 To learn more about what information we collect and how it may be used, please refer to our California Candidate Privacy Notice.
   

  

***Recruitment Notice: Please be aware of recruitment scams. All legitimate communication from our team will only come from email addresses ending in @ethos.com or @getethos.com.***
***We will never ask for payment, banking details, or sensitive personal information during the hiring process. If you are contacted by someone claiming to represent us from a different email address, please treat it as fraudulent.***

title: Senior Firmware Engineer
description:
**Your Impact**
 You will be working on sophisticated, industrial, real\-time systems involving embedded firmware, Linux\-based platforms, industrial communications, and critical monitoring applications. This team of engineers develops innovative monitoring systems used for Grid Monitoring, Gas Insulated Switchgear (GIS), and Generation applications in electrical substations and power plants.
   

  

 As a Senior Firmware Engineer, you will play a key role in the design, development, and support of embedded firmware for mission\-critical monitoring and diagnostic products used throughout the electrical power industry. Working closely with Systems, Hardware, Test, and Product Management teams, you will develop software across bare\-metal, RTOS\-based, and embedded Linux environments, delivering solutions that meet demanding requirements for performance, reliability, cybersecurity, and maintainability. You will contribute across the complete product lifecycle, from requirements definition and architecture through implementation, integration, verification, release, and sustaining engineering. Leveraging modern software engineering practices, including AI\-assisted development, code analysis, debugging, and test automation tools where appropriate, you will help accelerate delivery while maintaining the high standards of quality, safety, and reliability expected of products deployed throughout the world's power generation, transmission, and distribution infrastructure.
   

  

****Here's Where You'll Demonstrate Your Proficiencies:****
* Design, develop, maintain, and debug embedded firmware for real\-time monitoring and diagnostic systems spanning bare\-metal, RTOS\-based, and embedded Linux platforms.
* Develop high\-quality software solutions using Embedded C/C\+\+ on microcontroller and microprocessor\-based systems.
* Develop low\-level firmware, Board Support Packages (BSPs), device drivers, bootloaders, and hardware abstraction layers for embedded products.
* Collaborate with Systems, Hardware, Software, and Test Engineers to deliver integrated product solutions.
* Implement and maintain communications interfaces and industrial protocols including IEC 61850, DNP3, Modbus, IEC 60870, and related technologies.
* Develop software for data acquisition, event processing, diagnostics, communications, and system control functions.
* Support firmware integration activities across embedded Linux, Windows, and real\-time operating environments.
* Perform root\-cause analysis, troubleshooting, and performance optimisation of complex embedded systems.
* Develop and execute unit, integration, and system\-level testing to ensure product quality and reliability.
* Support software configuration management, traceability, and product release activities.
* Contribute to compliance, cybersecurity, and regulatory requirements throughout the product lifecycle.
* Utilise modern AI\-assisted development, code review, debugging, and test generation tools to improve engineering productivity and software quality.
* Champion continuous improvement of software development processes through automation, AI\-enabled engineering practices, and data\-driven decision making.
* Support adoption of modern development practices including automated testing, static analysis, CI/CD, and AI\-assisted software lifecycle workflows.
* Work within Agile Scrum teams to support efficient product delivery and continuous innovation.


****Qualifications****
 The successful candidate will be able to demonstrate the following skills and experience:
   

  

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Electronic Engineering, or a related discipline.
* Minimum five years of industry experience in embedded firmware development, testing, debugging, and deployment.
* Strong experience developing firmware for microcontroller and microprocessor\-based systems, including bare\-metal and RTOS\-based applications.
* Expert\-level proficiency in Embedded C/C\+\+ development within real\-time and multi\-threaded environments.
* Strong understanding of embedded software design principles, software architecture, interrupt\-driven systems, memory management, and real\-time operating systems.
* Experience developing software for peripheral interfaces including UART, SPI, I²C, CAN, Ethernet, USB, and related technologies.
* Experience with low\-level hardware interfaces, board bring\-up, embedded debugging, and hardware\-software integration.
* Proven experience developing and supporting industrial communication protocols including IEC 61850, DNP3, Modbus, IEC 60870, or similar.
* Experience working with embedded Linux environments, device drivers, and system\-level software components.
* Experience using source control systems such as Git and modern software development workflows.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, interpersonal, and technical communication skills.
* Ability to work independently while contributing effectively within a cross\-functional engineering team.


****Preferred Skills****
* Experience developing products for the electrical power, utility, industrial automation, or critical infrastructure sectors.
* Experience with Digital Fault Recording (DFR), Power Quality (PQ), PMU, GIS monitoring, transformer monitoring, partial discharge monitoring, or related applications.
* Experience with bare\-metal firmware development on ARM Cortex\-M or similar embedded architectures.
* Experience with RTOS environments such as FreeRTOS, ThreadX, Zephyr, or similar real\-time operating systems.
* Experience developing Board Support Packages (BSPs), bootloaders, device drivers, and low\-level platform software.
* Experience with Ethernet networking, protocol analysers, managed switches, PTP, NTP, or time\-synchronised systems.
* Experience troubleshooting communications using packet capture and analysis tools such as Wireshark.
* Familiarity with JTAG, SWD, in\-circuit debuggers, logic analysers, and embedded software diagnostic tools.
* Knowledge of microcontroller peripherals including DMA, timers, ADCs, DACs, watchdogs, interrupt controllers, and clock management systems.
* Knowledge of software verification, automated testing, and unit testing frameworks.
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines, automated build systems, and software quality tools.
* Understanding of cybersecurity principles, secure communications, authentication mechanisms, and secure firmware development practices.
* Experience with FPGA integration or FPGA\-based embedded systems.
* Experience leveraging AI\-assisted software development tools and Large Language Model (LLM) technologies to improve software development, testing, documentation, and engineering efficiency.
* Experience with Python or other scripting languages for automation and test development.
* Exposure to C\#, JavaScript, or other software development languages would be advantageous.
* Experience using engineering collaboration tools such as JIRA and Confluence.
* Familiarity with Agile Scrum methodologies.

description:
Test Equipment and Automation Engineer Semiconductor Manufacturing

 Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India

 Onsite

 Full\-Time

 6 \-12 Years
 



  





**Industry:** 
 Semiconductor / ATMP / OSAT / Memory Testing
 



  





 Role Overview
 



  





 We are looking for a Test Equipment and Automation Engineer to support automated semiconductor test operations in a high\-volume ATMP/OSAT manufacturing environment. The role will be responsible for test\-equipment installation, qualification, maintenance, troubleshooting and performance improvement.
 



 The engineer will work with ATE systems, test handlers, automation controls and equipment interfaces to improve uptime, throughput, test yield and production stability. Strong experience in semiconductor test equipment, industrial automation and data\-driven problem\-solving is required.
 



 Key Responsibilities
 


* Install, configure, qualify and release semiconductor test equipment for production.

* Troubleshoot electrical, electronic, mechanical, pneumatic, control and software\-related equipment failures.

* Develop preventive, predictive and condition\-based maintenance procedures.
* Partner with test engineering to resolve test\-yield, correlation and hardware\-interface issues.
* Support equipment automation using PLCs, sensors, motion controls, robotics and machine\-vision systems.

* Train technicians and production teams on equipment operation and first\-level troubleshooting.

 Required Qualifications

* Experience in equipment installation, commissioning, qualification and production support.
* Strong troubleshooting ability across electrical, electronic, mechanical and automation systems.
* Working knowledge of PLCs, sensors, servo systems, motion controls and industrial communication.
* Experience improving OEE, MTBF, MTTR, uptime, throughput or equipment reliability.
* Ability to interpret electrical schematics, pneumatic diagrams, mechanical drawings and equipment manuals.
* Willingness to support production escalations and 24 7 manufacturing operations.

* Device contactors and test sockets

 Equipment Engineering

 Automation and Controls

 Factory Integration

 Reliability and Problem\-Solving

* Equipment FMEA
* Fault Tree Analysis

title: Senior QA Automation Engineer (Python & Playwright)
description:
Role Overview
   

  

 We are looking for a
 **Full Automation Testing QA Engineer** 
 who will take ownership of quality assurance through strong test automation practices. The role focuses on designing and maintaining automated test solutions across
 **API, UI, integration, regression, and performance testing** 
 , while working closely with product and engineering teams throughout the development lifecycle.
   

  

 Roles \& Responsibilities
   

  

 Test Strategy \& Planning
   

  

* Define and implement comprehensive automation‑first test strategies for API and UI applications
* Create detailed test plans covering functional, integration, regression, and performance testing
* Collaborate with product and engineering teams to define acceptance criteria, quality metrics, and release readiness
* Identify test scope, risks, and dependencies early in the development cycle
* Continuously improve QA processes, test coverage, and automation best practices


 API \[GI1] Automation Testing
   

  

* Design, develop, and execute automated test cases for RESTful APIs built using NodeJS \& Python frameworks ( FastAPI, Flask, Django, etc.)
* Validate request/response payloads, headers, status codes, and business logic
* Test API authentication, authorization, and security scenarios
* Cover negative scenarios, edge cases, and boundary conditions
* Use tools such as pytest, Postman, REST Assured, or similar frameworks for API automation


 Integration \& Regression Testing
   

  

* Build and maintain automated integration test suites across backend services and system components
* Develop robust regression automation to ensure existing functionality remains stable across releases
* Validate data flow between frontend, backend, databases, and third‑party systems
* Track, document, and communicate integration issues and system dependencies
* Manage test data requirements for integration and regression scenarios


 UI Automation Testing ( Backstage\[PN2] / React)
   

  

* Create and maintain automated UI test suites for React‑based web applications
* Automate UI tests using Playwright, Cypress, Jest, or React Testing Library
* Validate UI workflows, component behaviour, and user interactions
* Ensure cross‑browser compatibility and responsive behaviour
* Perform basic accessibility testing and validate WCAG compliance where applicable


 Performance Testing
   

  

* Design and execute performance and scalability testing strategies for APIs and UI components
* Define performance benchmarks and acceptance thresholds
* Conduct load, stress, and endurance testing
* Analyze results, identify bottlenecks, and collaborate with engineering teams on improvements
* Document performance test results and recommendations using tools like Locust, JMeter, or k6


 Automation Frameworks \& CI/CD Integration
   

  

* Build and maintain scalable automation frameworks using Python (pytest, unittest, etc.)
* Write clean, reusable, and maintainable automation code
* Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines for continuous test execution
* Generate automation reports and dashboards for test results and coverage
* Participate in test automation code reviews and follow coding best practices


**Requirements**
 Required Skills
   

  

 Core Technical Skills
   

  

* Strong experience in test automation using Python\[GI3] \& NodeJS
* Hands‑on expertise in API automation, UI automation, Selenium and integration testing
* Experience with:
+ API Testing: pytest, Postman, REST Assured
+ UI Testing: Playwright, Cypress, Jest, React Testing Library

* Solid understanding of:
+ Software testing principles (STLC)
+ REST APIs, HTTP protocols, JSON
+ Microservices‑based application testing

* Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines (tool‑agnostic)


 Nice to Have (Non‑Cloud)
   

  

* Experience with databases and SQL for test validation
* Familiarity with performance and reliability testing concepts
* Experience working in Agile / Scrum teams


 Soft Skills
   

  

* Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills
* Clear written and verbal communication
* Ability to work independently and collaborate across teams
* Strong ownership of quality and attention to detail


 Experience \& Education
   

  

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent experience
* 3\-6 years of experience in QA automation or software testing (adjustable as needed)

title: UiPath Automation Engineer
description:
**Roboyo AI is a category shaper in Applied AI and Agentic Automation.**

 We help leading enterprises move from automation projects and AI experiments into governed, production\-grade systems that execute real work across workflows, processes, products and services.
 

  
 





 Our heritage is in scaled enterprise automation; our future is Applied AI and Agentic Automation: autonomous agents, AI engineering squads, process orchestration, data and knowledge foundations, and human\-in\-the\-loop governance embedded deeply into how our clients operate.
 

  
 





 We are not here to sell AI theatre. We are here to turn AI into working systems, measurable outcomes and repeatable transformation programs.
 

  
 




  
 



**Job summary** 




 As an Automation Engineer, you will begin establishing your professional footprint within Roboyo’s consulting and automation delivery teams. In this role, you will support project workstreams, contribute to solution design, and assist in the successful delivery of intelligent automation initiatives for our clients.
 



 You will collaborate closely with project teams, subject‑matter experts, and business users to ensure high‑quality deliverables. You are expected to communicate clearly, manage your tasks independently, and proactively identify opportunities to add value. You will also interact with clients regularly, helping maintain strong working relationships while gaining exposure to client‑facing responsibilities.

* Stay up to date on industry trends and best practices and proactively grow your consulting skills

* Knowledgeable in at least one area of consulting, such as strategy, transformation, digitization, or technology.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to think strategically and creatively
* Excellent English communication skills

**Nice to have qualifications**

title: Staff Design Automation Engineer
description:
**.buttontext64844663f7da10cc a{ border:** 1px solid transparent; } .buttontext64844663f7da10cc a: focus{ border: 1px dashed \#3070a6 !important; outline: none !important; }
  
**Job Title:** Staff Design Automation Engineer
  
**Posting Start Date:** 7/20/26
  
**Job Location(s):** Bengaluru
  
  

If you are looking for a challenging and exciting career in the world of technology, then look no further. Skyworks is an innovator of high performance analog semiconductors whose solutions are powering the wireless networking revolution. At Skyworks, you will find a fast\-paced environment with a strong focus on global collaboration, minimal layers of management and the freedom to make meaningful contributions in a setting that encourages creativity and out\-of\-the\-box thinking. We are excited about the opportunity to work with you and glad you want to be part of a team of talented individuals who together can change the way the world communicates.
  
  

**Requisition ID:** 77974
  
  

**Job Description:**  

Description
  
  

The Packaging EDA group automates and standardizes the flows behind RF and AMS module packaging and the back\-end IC wafer flows that feed them—spanning design\-to\-die, wirebond/bump interconnect, substrate routing, EM\-aware layout, DRC/signoff, and the post\-tapeout data that drives manufacturing. We are expanding beyond our traditional Cadence Allegro/APD SKILL and DRC automation into modern software engineering: Python\-based tooling, database\-driven workflows, and web\-based enterprise platforms that manage data across the full IC lifecycle, from floorplanning to material\-in\-hand.
  
  

This is a hybrid role for a software developer who has worked in the Packaging/IC realm. Day to day, you may be asked to support active packaging and wafer\-flow activities while also designing and building the long\-term software solutions that will replace today's manual and spreadsheet\-based processes. The balance between hands\-on support and platform development will evolve over time, so we're looking for someone adaptable who is comfortable moving between immediate problem\-solving and longer\-term engineering.
  
  

The core technical need is Python, database, and web\-application expertise to modernize existing spreadsheet\- and VBA\-based wafer flows into maintainable, connected platforms. Packaging\-layout automation and tool experience (SKILL/APD) is a strong plus as design work will need to be supported by multiple members of our team, and we lean on AI\-assisted development to extend it. You'll partner closely with a domain expert who owns the IC wafer flows and deep process knowledge, translating that expertise into robust, scalable software.
  
  

Responsibilities
  
Design and build Python applications and web\-based enterprise platforms that support the packaging and wafer\-flow lifecycle, replacing spreadsheet/VBA solutions with maintainable, database\-connected systems.
  
Lead the conversion of an existing VBA solution into a web\-based platform that:
  
communicates with multiple databases,
  
provides UIs for pre\-tapeout (pre\-TO) inputs,
  
supports a "shopping cart"–style workflow for post\-TO interactions, and
  
runs automated triggers and DRCs throughout the IC lifecycle (floorplanning to material\-in\-hand).
  
Develop automation for post\-TO data gathering to support bump mask generation.
  
Generate mechanical data for wafer probing.
  
Support day\-to\-day packaging and wafer\-flow activities as needed, balancing immediate operational needs with long\-term development.
  
Build and maintain packaging DRC rule decks and custom checks for module substrates, interposers, and system\-in\-package structures.
  
Develop automation flows for AMS/RF module packaging (placement, routing, via strategies, stack\-up) and repetitive tasks such as pin assignment, fanout, shielding patterns, and BOM generation—using Python, SKILL, or Tcl as appropriate.
  
Manage code and collaboration through GitHub using a Gitflow\-style branching model (feature branches, pull requests, code review), and leverage AI\-assisted development (Cursor) to accelerate delivery.
  
Collaborate cross\-functionally with design, packaging, wafer\-flow, test, and manufacturing teams to bridge domain knowledge into reliable tooling.
  
Document flows, train users, and drive continuous improvement in cycle time, data integrity, and first\-pass success.
  
Required Experience and Skills
  
M.Tech/M.E./M.S. in EE/CE or equivalent from a reputed university.
  
3–5 years in IC/module packaging design, packaging CAD, RF substrate layout, or a similar role.
  
Strong software development proficiency in Python, including building tools and services that read from and write to databases.
  
Experience developing web\-based applications/platforms (front\-end UIs plus back\-end services and DB integration).
  
Working knowledge of relational databases and data modeling (schema design, queries, integration across multiple data sources).
  
Experience with source control and collaborative workflows in GitHub (branching, pull requests, code review; Gitflow or similar).
  
Ability to translate domain/process knowledge and legacy spreadsheet/VBA logic into structured, maintainable software.
  
Comfortable operating as a generalist—shifting between day\-to\-day support and long\-term development as priorities evolve.
  
Strong cross\-functional communication skills; detail\-oriented; thrives in a fast\-paced, dynamic environment.
  
Desired Experience and Skills
  
Experience modernizing VBA/Excel\-based workflows into web platforms with automated triggers and validation.
  
Familiarity with AI\-assisted development tools (e.g., Claude, Cursor) and integrating them into a team workflow.
  
Scripting/automation for IC or module packaging layout in SKILL, Python, or Tcl.
  
Hands\-on experience with Cadence Allegro Package Designer / APD or similar advanced packaging layout tools.
  
Experience with packaging DRC/LVS or DFM rule development and verification.
  
Understanding of back\-end wafer flows and post\-tapeout data (bump maps, mechanical/probe data, tapeout deliverables).
  
**Understanding of packaging technologies:** laminate substrates, wirebond, flip\-chip, WLP, and module\-level integration.
  
**Knowledge of RF packaging fundamentals:** controlled\-impedance routing, via transitions, ground planes, and isolation structures.
  
Experience packaging RF front\-end modules (PAs, LNAs, filters, switches) for mobile or infrastructure applications; familiarity with BAW/SAW filter packaging and acoustic requirements.
  
Exposure to EM\-aware packaging practices and simulation of package interconnect (HFSS, EMX, or integrated APD EM flows).

title: AI Quality Automation Engineer – Assistant Vice President
description:
In this AVP\-level role, you will be responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining automated testing frameworks for AI systems. You will validate model accuracy, data pipelines, and software integrations to ensure high performance, reliability, and ethical compliance across the development lifecycle.
   

  

 You will act as a crucial bridge between data science, software engineering, and quality assurance, working closely with data scientists, ML systems engineers, front\-end engineers, and business leaders. If you are passionate about operationalizing complex models, creating highly reliable automated validation services, and defining the quality lifecycle for data science workflows at an enterprise scale, this role is a perfect fit.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities \& Competencies
   

  

* Quality Framework Architecture: Design, build, and maintain scalable automated testing frameworks specifically tailored for AI/ML systems, including LLMs, RAG pipelines, and traditional ML models.
* Model \& Output Validation: Design and execute automated evaluation pipelines to measure critical metrics such as hallucination rates, context retention, retrieval precision, semantic similarity, and answer relevance (using tools like RAGAs, DsPy).
* Data Pipeline \& ETL Auditing: Validate the quality, integrity, and schema compliance of data pipelines and ETL processes (PySpark, Hive, Kafka, Parquet, Iceberg) to ensure clean data flows into AI models.
* CI/CD Integration: Integrate automated AI quality gates into enterprise CI/CD pipelines (using Tekton, Harness, UDeploy, Jenkins) to enable continuous testing and prevent regressions.
* Risk Stewardship \& Compliance: Lead adversarial testing (Red Teaming) to identify vulnerabilities like prompt injection, jailbreaking, and data leakage. Validate real\-time safety guardrails to ensure compliance with ethical AI guidelines, corporate policies, and regulatory standards.
* Operational Excellence \& Observability: Implement monitoring and observability solutions (using MLFlow, Dagster, Vertex AI, SageMaker) to detect model drift, performance degradation, and latency bottlenecks in production.
* Stakeholder Engagement: Demonstrate exceptional communication and diplomacy skills, effectively engaging with cross\-functional stakeholders to articulate quality risks, negotiate solutions, and align on quality benchmarks.


**Required Skills \& Technical Qualifications**
* Experience: 5\-8 years of professional experience implementing data\-intensive solutions or test automation frameworks using agile methodologies, with at least 2\-3 years of direct experience validating AI/ML, Generative AI, or data\-intensive systems.
* Programming Languages:
+ Primary: Python, Shell Scripting, Jupyter Notebook Scripting
+ Secondary: Java

* Machine Learning \& AI Evaluation Frameworks:
+ Core ML: Scikit\-learn, Keras, TensorFlow, PyTorch, spaCy, NLTK
+ Advanced NLP \& GenAI Evaluation: RAGAs, DsPy, Hugging Face Transformers, RASA, Large Language Models (LLM)

* MLOps \& ML Lifecycle Management:
+ Platforms: MLFlow, Dagster, Google Cloud Vertex AI, Amazon SageMaker

* Database Management Systems:
+ Relational: Oracle, MySQL, PostgreSQL
+ NoSQL: MongoDB

* Infrastructure \& DevOps:
+ CI/CD \& DevOps Tooling: UDeploy, Harness, Tekton, Jenkins, Maven
+ Version Control: Git, Subversion (SVN)
+ Containerization \& Orchestration: Docker, OpenShift, Amazon ECS

* Data Engineering \& Processing:
+ Messaging \& Asynchronous Communication: Kafka, RabbitMQ
+ ETL \& Data Warehousing: Sqoop, PySpark, Hive, Hadoop, HDFS
+ File Formats: Avro, Parquet, Iceberg
+ Job Scheduling \& Orchestration: Autosys, Cron

* Web Technologies:
+ Web Frameworks: FastAPI, Flask
+ Web Servers \& Reverse Proxies: NGINX

title: Senior QA Automation Engineer
description:
Company Overview
   


 Jetbro is a technology consulting and systems integration firm that builds reliable, scalable digital systems for organizations where technology is central to everyday operations. We work across infrastructure, enterprise software, and product development, focusing on systems that are stable, predictable, and built to operate under real\-world pressure.
   





 This role is part of Jetbro’s engagement with Safal, where we are building and evolving an enterprise SaaS platform used to manage procurement workflows, approvals, and business operations.
   





 Quality assurance at Safal is not about simply running test cases. It is about deeply understanding business workflows, ensuring system reliability, and building automated testing systems that help the product evolve safely and confidently.
   




 About the Role
   


 We are looking for a Senior QA Automation Engineer with 3–5 years of experience who can combine structured manual testing with strong automation capabilities.
   





 The Safal platform includes multi\-role procurement workflows, approval chains, and enterprise\-level system logic. The QA engineer must be able to understand these workflows deeply and validate that the system behaves correctly across multiple roles, conditions, and edge cases.
   





 This role requires someone who is comfortable working with developers, writing structured documentation, and gradually automating QA processes.
   





 We are particularly looking for candidates who actively use modern automation tools and AI\-assisted workflows to improve QA productivity, automate documentation, generate test cases, and build strong test coverage systems.
   




 Key Responsibilities
   

* Write structured test cases for product features and workflows
* Build and maintain automation test suites using Playwright, Selenium, or similar frameworks
* Perform exploratory testing to identify edge cases and unexpected behavior
* Conduct regression testing across product releases
* Test APIs and backend services using tools such as Postman
* Validate multi\-role workflows, permissions, and approval logic
* Ensure data integrity across workflows and system actions
* Collaborate with developers during issue identification and resolution
* Contribute to maintaining test automation pipelines alongside engineering teams
* Generate structured test documentation including test cases, test plans, and coverage reports
* Use automation and AI tools to accelerate QA workflows and documentation
* Ensure releases meet quality standards before deployment


 Requirements
   

  

 Mandatory Requirements
   

* 3–5 years of experience in software quality assurance
* Strong experience in test automation using Playwright, Selenium, or similar tools
* Experience testing APIs using tools such as Postman
* Experience writing structured test cases and test documentation
* Strong understanding of regression testing and exploratory testing
* Ability to understand complex business workflows and validate system behavior
* Experience validating role\-based systems and workflow logic
* Ability to generate structured test coverage reports
* Experience working closely with engineering teams during development cycles
* Familiarity with modern AI tools for improving QA productivity and documentation


 Good to Have
   

* Experience with Python\-based automation frameworks
* Experience working with enterprise SaaS platforms
* Exposure to CI/CD pipelines and automated testing environments
* Experience validating database consistency and backend workflows
* Familiarity with procurement or workflow\-driven enterprise applications


 What we care about
   

* Deep workflow understanding over superficial testing
* Automation mindset over repetitive manual execution
* Clear documentation over informal test notes
* Curiosity and investigation over checklist testing
* Continuous improvement of QA systems using automation and AI



 This role is suited for someone who sees QA not as the final step in development, but as a core part of building reliable enterprise systems.
   

  

  

  




 Benefits
   

  

 What we Offer
   

* A chance to work on a greenfield project and influence architectural decisions.
* Competitive salary and benefits.
* Career growth opportunities in a fast\-growing SaaS company.
* A collaborative and innovative team culture.

**13 \- 15 years of experience in Testing**
**Educational Qualification:** 
 Graduation (Accurate educational details should capture)
   

  

**Job Summary**
 We are seeking an experienced Manager\-Test Automation with 13\-15 years of experience in Software Testing, Test Automation, and Quality Assurance Engineering. This role requires a strong blend of technical leadership, testing practice management, solutioning expertise, and client engagement experience to drive quality transformation across complex technology programs. The ideal candidate will be responsible for shaping QA and automation strategies, leading testing teams, supporting RFP responses, presales and solutioning initiatives, and driving the adoption of modern quality engineering practices, including CI/CD, Continuous Testing, and AI\-enabled testing. Experience in Digital Commerce, Retail, or other large\-scale customer\-facing platforms is highly desirable.
   

  

**Roles And Responsibilities**
* Define and lead enterprise and programme\-level Quality Assurance strategies aligned with business objectives, technology architecture, delivery models, and risk. Assess existing testing practices and establish QA transformation roadmaps, target operating models, governance frameworks, engineering standards, and measurable quality outcomes.
* Design scalable, maintainable, and fit\-for\-purpose test automation architectures covering UI, API, integration, component, contract, and end\-to\-end testing. Define automation frameworks, reusable components, test\-data strategies, reporting, environment requirements, maintenance approaches, and technology selection based on application architecture, project requirements, scalability, maintainability, and overall QA strategy.
* Define and implement CI/CD\-integrated Quality Assurance and continuous testing strategies that provide fast, reliable, and actionable feedback throughout the software delivery lifecycle. Establish appropriate test execution strategies across pull requests, builds, deployments, integration and staging environments, regression cycles, and production validation.
* Address and optimise the practical engineering challenges associated with continuous testing, including pipeline efficiency, test reliability, execution time, environment readiness, test\-data management, dependencies, parallelisation, selective test execution, quality gates, and pipeline stability. Establish practices such as test impact analysis, risk\-based test selection, mocking, tagging, and other optimisation techniques to improve feedback time and pipeline reliability.
* Define and monitor QA and CI/CD metrics including automation coverage, execution time, test reliability, flakiness, pipeline stability, defect leakage, release confidence, and other relevant engineering and business outcomes.
* Define and lead Performance Testing strategies for critical applications, services, and customer journeys, covering workload modelling, test planning, scripting, execution, scalability, capacity assessment, performance monitoring, bottleneck identification, detailed test\-result analysis, performance optimisation, and performance regression.
* Lead detailed analysis of Performance Test results by correlating application, infrastructure, and monitoring metrics to identify performance bottlenecks, capacity constraints, resource utilisation issues, and system\-level degradation. Translate findings into actionable recommendations for performance optimisation, scalability, capacity planning, and engineering improvements.
* Define and implement API, Contract, and Component Testing strategies, establishing the appropriate balance across component, contract, API, integration, UI, end\-to\-end, and performance testing based on application architecture, business risk, and delivery requirements.
* Define test planning and test case design approaches across programmes, ensuring appropriate test scope, scenarios, coverage, traceability, risk\-based prioritisation, test data, environment requirements, entry/exit criteria, and execution strategies aligned with business and technical requirements.
* Partner with Development, DevOps, Architecture, Product, and Platform Engineering teams within and outside the organisation to embed quality throughout the software development and delivery lifecycle and promote shift\-left, continuous testing, and engineering\-led quality practices.
* Lead or significantly contribute to RFP, RFI, RFQ, presales, and client solutioning engagements from a Quality Assurance perspective. Translate client requirements and technology challenges into differentiated QA solutions, including QA strategies, automation architectures, CI/CD and continuous testing approaches, performance strategies, implementation roadmaps, effort estimates, resource models, timelines, assumptions, dependencies, risks, delivery approaches, and expected outcomes. Participate in client discovery sessions, solution workshops, proposal discussions, technical presentations, and solution defence activities.
* Drive the adoption of AI, GenAI, Agentic, and MCP\-based testing across Quality Assurance, identifying and implementing high\-value use cases such as test generation, automation code generation, test maintenance, test\-data generation, failure and defect analysis, intelligent test selection, test optimisation, and test\-result analysis. Lead the evaluation and adoption of AI\-enabled solutions capable of planning, generating, executing, analysing, and adapting testing activities.
* Mentor and develop QA professionals across technical testing, test automation, performance testing, modern testing practices, solutioning, proposals, RFP/RFI/RFQ engagements, and client\-facing activities. Provide technical guidance, knowledge sharing, coaching, and career development support while building strong testing capabilities and technical leadership within the team.
* Act as a trusted Quality Assurance advisor to senior stakeholders and clients, providing technical direction, influencing technology and delivery decisions, communicating risks and recommendations, and aligning QA outcomes with broader business objectives.

title: Lead Test Automation Engineer
description:
**Roboyo AI is a category shaper in Applied AI and Agentic Automation.**

 We help leading enterprises move from automation projects and AI experiments into governed, production\-grade systems that execute real work across workflows, processes, products and services.
 

  
 





 Our heritage is in scaled enterprise automation; our future is Applied AI and Agentic Automation: autonomous agents, AI engineering squads, process orchestration, data and knowledge foundations, and human\-in\-the\-loop governance embedded deeply into how our clients operate.
 

  
 





 We are not here to sell AI theatre. We are here to turn AI into working systems, measurable outcomes and repeatable transformation programs.
 

  
 




  
 



**About the role:**





 You will join our Delivery team as a Testing Lead. In this pivotal role, you will bridge the gap between technical excellence and strategic delivery leadership. You will own the end\-to\-end design, strategy, and execution of robust Test Automation solutions leveraging the UiPath Testing platform across multiple client engagements.
 

  
 





 As a Test Leader, you are a 
 
**hands\-on expert**

You will serve as the primary technical point of contact for clients and internal stakeholders, ensuring quality at scale.

You will serve as the primary technical quality owner, applying deep UiPath Test Suite expertise to architect and execute automated test solutions that drive quality across a large\-scale programme. You will act as the trusted technical bridge between client stakeholders, Functional Business Analysts, and the wider engineering team — ensuring every test scenario is grounded in real banking logic and delivered to the highest automation standard.
 

  
 




**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

  
 




**Technical Leadership \& Architecture**

  
 



* **Test Strategy Ownership:**

 Define and own the end\-to\-end test automation strategy across the engagement — covering scope, framework design, risk\-based test coverage, and quality gates at each delivery milestone.


* **Framework Governance:**

 Architect, govern, and continuously improve reusable automation frameworks leveraging UiPath Test Suite / Test Cloud (Test Manager, Test Automation activities, \+ REFramework). Set non\-negotiable standards for modularity, maintainability, and scalability.


* **Technical Escalation:**

 Act as the final technical escalation point for the team — resolving complex defects, integration failures, tool\-chain issues, and architectural blockers that Testing Engineers cannot resolve independently.


* **Innovation \& Platform Awareness:**

 Stay current with UiPath platform developments — particularly AI\-powered testing, Agentic Automation, and UiPath Test Cloud capabilities — and translate these into improved delivery approaches for clients.



**Delivery \& Quality Management**

  
 



* **End\-to\-End Delivery Ownership:**

 Manage the full test lifecycle from planning through execution, defect management, and technical sign\-off — ensuring quality outcomes are delivered on time, within scope, and aligned with banking regulatory requirements.


* **Risk \& Dependency Management:**

 Proactively identify testing risks, scope creep, and delivery blockers. Implement mitigation plans before issues escalate to client leadership, maintaining a clear risk register throughout the engagement.


* **Banking Domain Quality:**

 Apply a working understanding of core banking workflows — payments, account management, lending, GL, and regulatory reporting — to ensure test coverage reflects real business risk, not just functional requirements.


* **Metrics \& Reporting:**

 Define and track testing KPIs (coverage, defect escape rate, automation ROI, cycle time) and present clear, data\-driven quality status to client stakeholders at regular cadences.



**Hands\-On Testing Delivery**

  
 



* **Requirement Translation:**

 Partner with Functional Business Analysts and client SMEs to ensure business requirements and banking process logic are fully and accurately reflected in test scenarios, acceptance criteria, and traceability matrices.


* **Development:**

  Support in the Design, development, testing, and deployment of end\-to\-end Test Automation workflows leveraging UiPath Test Suite / Test Cloud (Test Manager, Test Automation, Studio).


* **QA:**

  Conduct code reviews, enforce coding standards and maintain design specifications, test reports, and runbooks



**Client \& Stakeholder Management**

  
 



* **Primary Technical Client Point of Contact:**

 Serve as the lead technical representative in client meetings — translating complex testing outcomes, risks, and architectural decisions into language accessible to non\-technical banking stakeholders and programme leadership.


* **Delivery Coordination:**

 Manage delivery across distributed teams, ensuring alignment on priorities, progress, and quality standards between onsite and offshore engineers.



**People \& Team Development**

  
 



* **Mentorship \& Coaching:**

 Line\-manage, coach, and develop L1–L3 Testing engineers. Support performance evaluations and knowledge transfer across the team.


* **Capability Building:**

 Champion internal knowledge sharing — running technical workshops, code review sessions, and lessons\-learned reviews to continuously raise the bar for the team.



**MUST\-HAVE QUALIFICATIONS**

  
 



* **Experience:**

 8–12 years of total IT experience, with a minimum of 3\+ years in a technical lead or test automation lead role managing delivery teams on enterprise engagements.


* **UiPath Test Suite Mastery:**

 5\+ years of hands\-on UiPath experience, with deep proficiency across Studio, Orchestrator, Test Manager, and Test Automation activities. Not just conceptual — you have built and governed production\-grade frameworks.


* **Framework Architecture:**

 Proven ability to design and enforce scalable automation architectures (REFramework, modular patterns) across multi\-stream, multi\-team engagements.


* **Delivery Accountability:**

 Experience managing end\-to\-end quality delivery with direct accountability for timelines, scope, escalations, and client satisfaction — not just individual contribution.


* **Stakeholder Communication:**

 Ability to present technical quality outcomes clearly to non\-technical banking executives and programme leaders. Confident running client governance meetings.


* **Agile Delivery:**

 Strong track record operating in Agile/Scrum or SAFe frameworks within large IT programmes, including working alongside BAs, developers, and business SMEs.


* **Certification:**

 UiPath Certified Professional — Advanced RPA Developer (UiARD) and UiPath Test Automation Specialist




  
 




**UiPath Test Suite Capabilities**

  
 



* Define and govern the usage of UiPath Object Repository to ensure reusable, maintainable, and standardized UI element management across automation projects.


* Configure and manage projects, requirements, test cases, test sets, and traceability within UiPath Test Manager.


* Define and manage test execution strategies, including test sets, execution schedules, and release\-specific test cycles.

**NICE\-TO\-HAVE QUALIFICATIONS**

description:
Systems engineering is a cross\-functional engineering discipline centred on an approach, mindset, and process. All activities that consider both the business and the technical needs of the customers with the goal of providing a quality product that meets the users needs. The discipline that executes a robust process of design, creation, and optimization of systems, consisting of identification and quantification of system requirements, creation of alternate system design concepts, performance of design trade studies, selection and implementation of the best designs and verification that the design is properly integrated and executed. Process that proceeds from concept to production to operation.
  

Impacts departmental operations and responsible for planning/execution. The role has some autonomy but is focused on execution of activities within an operating discipline covered by standard functional practices and procedures.
  

Some judgment may be required but this is typically with guidance.
  

  

The role will work within defined parameters to make decisions, apply concepts to issues of moderate complexity, and resolve issues through immediate action or short\-term planning. You will be part of a team that defines the network configuration of an HVDC control system as part of a project delivery team.
**Job Description**
===================


**Roles and Responsibilities**


* Lead the configuration of IEC61850 IED’s via vendor specific tools and System Configuration Tools for complete system integration.
* Lead the generation of Substation Configuration description Language (SCL) files for system integration.
* Knowledge of interlocking principles used in substation automation systems and their implementation on IEC61850 IED’s.

	+ Define the main IO Lists of the control system
	+ Analyze signal interfaces and ensure compatibility with the control system
* Lead in collaboration with NPI teams, the configuration of Remote Terminal Units (RTU), Bay Controllers (BCU) and Merging Units for signal acquisition in digital substation environments.
* Lead the design of LAN networks/Communication Architectures and configuration of industrial ethernet switches/routers and satellite clocks
* Follow the departments standard design practices, engineering reviews and guidelines.
* Define Control Panel requirements and produce detailed design documentation for the control system using standard design blocks under the guidance of lead engineers. This may include
	+ Panel Electrical Schematics (using Engineering Base tool)
	+ Wire/Cable Schedules
	+ Routine Test specification
	+ General Assembly drawings
	+ Bill of Materials
* Oversee the testing and FAT witnessing of the Control System.
* Prepare and present technical information for Substation Control Systems to internal and external customers.
* Assist site activities relevant to the installation and commissioning of the control system.
* Share engineering information and promote open dialogue.
* Assure proper documentation of technical data generated for the assigned projects and/or tasks consistent with engineering policies and procedures.

**Required Qualifications**


* Degree in Electronics/Electrical engineering or related field.
* Strong background in configuring Substation Bay Controllers/Merging Units/ IEC61850 IED’s
* Experience in Control Panel design (preferably as used in substation/power plant environments)
* Strong background in Distributed Control Systems / Substation Automation

description:
**Job Description**
 Job Summary
   

  

 Omnissa helps organisations deliver and manage secure digital workspaces. Horizon is our virtual desktop and application platform; our Digital Employee Experience (DEX) products give IT and employees visibility into the quality of that experience and provides monitoring and analytics across that stack.
   

  

 We are looking for a skilled Automation Engineer with 3 to 8 years of experience to own interoperability testing between DEX and Horizon along with second \& third\-party integrations. You will design and automate tests that span these products, catch integration issues before they reach customers, and keep that coverage current as Horizon, DEX, and Monitoring solutions evolve.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on role. You will play a key role in developing scalable and efficient automation frameworks, driving automation strategy, and collaborating with developers and product teams working across. You will write Python test automation, own GitHub Actions and Jenkins pipelines, and partner with development teams across Horizon, DEX and other second and third\-party integrations. As part of a modern engineering workflow, you will use AI\-assisted tools to improve productivity in test development and debugging, while maintaining high standards for reliability, determinism, and long\-term maintainability.
   

  

 Core Responsibilities
   

  

* Define and drive the automation testing approach for Horizon and DEX interoperability, aligned with product and program needs
* Identify areas for automation and prioritise work based on risk, complexity, and business value
* Design, build, and maintain automated interoperability, integration, and end\-to\-end tests across Horizon and DEX, primarily in Python
* Plan and execute compatibility testing across current and previously supported product versions
* Partner with feature teams from the design phase so new Horizon and DEX work is testable, and automated coverage is in place before it ships into the integrated stack
* Build and maintain reusable, scalable test frameworks and shared libraries across supported platforms (Windows, Linux, and other supported clients)
* Standardise processes, tools, and frameworks for automated testing, CI/CD, and quality gates
* Design, implement, and maintain CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions and Jenkins), including pipeline templates, so component, integration, and end\-to\-end stages are automated, stable, and properly integrated
* Implement and refine quality gates and reporting dashboards; track coverage, execution stability, and pipeline health
* Implement and maintain scalable test infrastructure (on\-premises, virtualised, and cloud) so environments stay stable, accessible, and usable for automated runs
* Extend coverage across supported deployment platforms and real\-world topologies, including hypervisors and gateway or proxy network paths
* Work closely with developers so automation is integrated early and tests catch issues at unit, integration, functional, and UI levels where applicable
* Review test suites for consistency, maintainability, and best practices; refactor scripts and optimise execution time as the suite grows
* Investigate failures that span Horizon and DEX and drive them to root cause with engineering
* Engage cross\-functionally on end\-to\-end and interoperability scenarios to improve automation
* Provide documentation and support so developers can understand and, where appropriate, self\-manage test environments
* Continuously evaluate new tools and technologies to improve automation efficiency and reliability
* Leverage AI\-assisted tools to accelerate test scaffolding, mock generation, refactoring, and debugging, and apply engineering judgment to review, validate, and harden the output for reliability, security, and maintainability


**Qualifications**
**Required**
* 3 to 8 years of experience in test automation for enterprise and/or cloud\-hosted platforms (or equivalent experience).
* Strong Python skills for test automation (frameworks such as pytest); additional languages (Java, Go, PowerShell) are useful.
* Hands\-on experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions and/or Jenkins (or equivalent: Azure DevOps, GitLab CI).
* Experience owning automated tests end to end — not only manual test execution.
* Experience with upgrade testing and backward compatibility (mixed\-version environments, upgrade paths, agent/client coexistence).
* Experience testing cloud deployment and lifecycle scenarios (onboarding, configuration, upgrades), not only API\-level functional tests.
* Hands\-on experience using a major public cloud (Azure preferred) to create and tear down test environments.
* Ability to debug issues across multiple layers (on\-premises components, cloud service, gateway/edge, network, endpoint) and communicate findings clearly in writing.


**Preferred**
* Experience with Omnissa Horizon Suite of products or similar end user computing products/solutions.
* Experience with monitoring solutions or telemetry products.
* Familiarity working with Hypervisors and Cloud platforms (vSphere, Azure, AWS or other clouds).
* Infrastructure\-as\-code or environment automation (Terraform, Ansible, or similar).
* Experience extending an automation framework across new clouds or topologies rather than rewriting it each time.
