title: The Core Engineering-L2-Bengaluru-Vice President-Software Engineering
description:
****JOB DESCRIPTION****
 The Core Engineering
   

  

 The Core Engineering Builds And Operates The Platforms, Applications, Data Solutions, Models, And Analytics That Power Critical Processes For The Core Divisions Of The Firm (e.g., Risk, Responsible For The Risk Profile Of Firm Activities; Controllers, Responsible For The Financial Control And Reporting Obligations; Compliance, Responsible For The Firm’s Compliance, Regulatory, And Reputational Risks; Corporate Treasury, Responsible For The Firm’s Liquidity, Funding, Balance Sheet, Etc.; And Human Capital Management, Responsible For Attracting, Developing, And Managing a Global Workforce). A Centralized Engineering Structure In Support Of The Core Enables a Common Platform Model And Operating Framework That Promotes Consistent Governance And Scalable Solutions, Leveraging Cloud, AI, And Machine Learning For Innovation And Efficiency. The Core Engineering’s 2,000\+ Engineers And Strats Deliver Engineering, Data, Analytics, And Quantitative Capabilities Within Six Business Units:
   

  

* Metrics \& Analytics Platforms: responsible for the measurement and management of the firm’s risk, capital, and liquidity for The Core functions
* The Core Strats: responsible for the development and implementation of models and other quantitative methodologies, including the accuracy and attribution of modeled metrics
* Financials \& Reporting: responsible for facilitating the production of the firm’s financials and a wide range of reporting functions
* Non\-Financial Risk \& Controls: responsible for non\-financial risk and control processes
* Enterprise Platforms: responsible for platforms and applications that support critical operational processes across The Core such as payments, people processes, and procurement
* Shared Services: responsible for driving the adoption of consistent engineering strategy, including data platforms, cloud, and AI enablement, as well as the management of technology risk


****What We Do****
 At Goldman Sachs, we connect people, capital, and ideas to help solve problems for our clients. We are a leading global financial services firm providing investment banking, securities and investment management services to a substantial and diversified client base that includes corporations, financial institutions, governments, and individuals.
   

  

 The Core is responsible for financial control and regulatory obligations of the firm. They safeguard the assets of the firm through an independent scrutiny of the financial information and ensure accurate reporting to internal and external consumers. They provide critical metrics and related analysis to the firm’s and divisions’ leadership to navigate the evolving business strategy, including incumbent and strategic initiatives. Controllers play an important role in the changing landscape of the firm, including its new business ventures and acquisitions, and ensure that these new initiatives are in line with the regulatory expectations as well as controlled in terms of their incorporation into the firm
   

  

 Engineers in The Core help ensure the firm meets all of its financial control and reporting obligations. Working in small and nimble teams, we build critical and complex software to calculate P\&L, measure and monitor the firm’s capital, balance sheet and liquidity metrics, and regulatory filings across the globe.
   

  

**Our Impact**
 The Core Engineering is responsible for designing and implementing solutions to manage firm’s profit and loss (P\&L), measure and monitor the firm’s capital, balance sheet and liquidity metrics, and regulatory obligations. Our global agile teams (based across Americas, EMEA \& Asia) develop and manage the platforms, calculation engines, and analytical tools that controllers, risk management, and deal\-making teams use to project, monitor and report externally to regulators for both regular business activity and under stress scenarios.
   

  

**Your Impact**
 Our team of engineers builds solutions to the most complex problems. We develop cutting\-edge software and platforms that form the core of our key business and enable transactions to move in milliseconds. We provide real\-time access to critical deal information and process billions of data points each day to inform firm\-wide market insights and strategies. Team members have the opportunity to work at the forefront of technology innovation alongside industry leaders and make significant contributions to the field. This position provides a unique opportunity to gain subject matter expertise in both technology and finance, and to directly engage with colleagues and senior management from across the business, risk, finance, and technology.
   

  

**Why join the team**
* Tool \& Technologies: You’ll program in Java and model data using Pure/Legend – a data management and data governance open source platform that we will teach you. Other technologies in use in our space: RESTful services, Maven/Gradle, Apache Spark, BigData, HTML 5, AngularJs/ReactJs, IntelliJ, Gitlab, Jira, AWS solutions, AI platforms, Java, Python, RESTful services, Maven/Gradle, Apache Spark, BigData, ReactJs/NextJs, IntelliJ/VSCode, Gitlab, Kubernates/Terraform.
* Cloud Technologies: You’ll be involved in building the next generation of finance systems onto the cloud platforms, one of the key strategy for the division to in which you’ll get exposure to technologies like AWS S3,Snowflake, EMR etc.
* Autonomy: You’ll have significant autonomy in designing and writing solutions to help our stakeholders deliver for the firm’s clients.
* Creativity: You’ll be encouraged to suggest improvements to products and to propose ways, in which we can add value for our stakeholders.
* Interpersonal Communication: You’ll engage with data producers and consumers across all areas of the business to understand their requirements and to propose solutions tailored to their needs.
* Training: Your manager will support your professional development, allowing you time for training at work, helping you learn and grow within the organization, and providing opportunities for increasing responsibility.


****Responsibilities****
* In an Agile environment manage end\-to\-end systems development cycle from requirements analysis to coding, testing, UAT, implementation and maintenance
* Develop high level/detailed technical designs, testing strategies, and implementation plans
* Work in a dynamic, fast\-paced environment that provides exposure to all areas of Finance
* Understand and respond to business needs, facilitating and developing process workflow, data requirements, and specifications required to support implementation
* Build strong relationships with business partners
* Identify opportunities for cross\-divisional collaboration and reuse of common solutions
* Familiarity with LLMs, AI\-powered automations, prompt engineering concepts.


****Skills \& Experience We Are Looking For****
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science or related technical discipline
* Hands\-on software development experience preferably in Java, C/C\+\+, Python, or Scala, exposure to RDBMS and NoSQL datastores
* Strong programming and problem\-solving skills
* A clear understanding of data structures, algorithms, software design and core programming concepts
* Strong full\-stack technical design and development skills and experience
* Comfortable with multi\-tasking, managing multiple stakeholders and working as part of a team
* Excellent communication skills including experience speaking to technical \& business audiences and working globally
* Interest in finance


**About Goldman Sachs**
 At Goldman Sachs, we commit our people, capital and ideas to help our clients, shareholders and the communities we serve to grow. Founded in 1869, we are a leading global investment banking, securities and investment management firm. Headquartered in New York, we maintain offices around the world.
   

  

 We believe who you are makes you better at what you do. We're committed to fostering and advancing diversity and inclusion in our own workplace and beyond by ensuring every individual within our firm has a number of opportunities to grow professionally and personally, from our training and development opportunities and firmwide networks to benefits, wellness and personal finance offerings and mindfulness programs. Learn more about our culture, benefits, and people at GS.com/careers.

title: Lead/Senior SQA Analyst
description:
**Job Description**
**Our Mission:**
 We aim to be the leading provider of content management software and expertise, helping clients create, manage, publish, and deliver high\-value content.
   

  

**About Us**
 Contiem, Inc. is a global provider of software and services to assist clients in creating, managing, and delivering high\-value content \- technical documentation, eLearning, online help, visualizations, training materials, etc. We continuously challenge the status quo and empower organizations by delivering effective content solutions and services that help clients achieve their business objectives.
   

  

 Contiem headquarters is located in Annapolis, MD, with additional locations in the US and internationally in Sutton, UK, Chennai, India, and Sydney, Australia. Our elite team of subject matter experts works closely with clients to assess, optimize, and transform their content objectives and operations. Our global team allows us to support clients in 40 countries, including many of the world's largest companies and iconic brands, from various industries such as Government, Aerospace, Publishing, Consumer Products, Healthcare, Industrial, Technology, and Financial Services.
   

  

**Position Summary**
 Contiem is seeking a highly skilled and experienced Lead/Senior SQA Analyst to join our team and support testing for our Web, Desktop, and mobile applications. As a Senior SQA Analyst, you will play a critical role in ensuring the quality, reliability, and usability of our documentation tools. Your primary responsibility will be to design, execute, and maintain testing strategies and test cases to validate the functionality and performance of our software applications.
   

  

**Essential Duties \& Responsibilities**
**Quality Ownership \& Technical Leadership**
* Own end\-to\-end quality of releases through comprehensive test planning, execution, and risk assessment.
* Define and drive test strategies, quality standards, risk\-based testing approaches, and release readiness criteria across multiple product areas.
* Act as a technical escalation point; mentor colleagues on test case design, automation frameworks, and QA best practices.
* Collaborate with Product Management, Engineering, and Professional Services teams to influence product quality decisions.
* Conduct root cause analysis, track defect metrics, and drive continuous process improvements.
* Participate in release retrospectives, providing actionable testing insights to improve product quality.
* Champion quality advocacy across teams, ensuring adherence to standards and compliance requirements.


**Test Strategy \& Coverage**
* Analyze requirements and user stories to identify gaps, ambiguities, and risks; design targeted test plans accordingly.
* Execute manual and automated tests across web, Windows desktop, mobile (iOS/Android), APIs, databases, and XML content.
* Validate XML against schemas/DTDs (e.g., S1000D, DITA, custom) to ensure product compliance.
* Perform accessibility testing (WCAG \& EAA), performance testing (JMeter), functional, regression, and exploratory testing.
* Ensure test coverage across integration, system, and user acceptance testing phases.


**Automation \& CI/CD Excellence**
* Architect and optimize scalable automation frameworks like Playwright and Selenium.
* Implement Power Automate flows to streamline testing workflows.
* Integrate and maintain automation within Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines for continuous quality validation.
* Maintain test data management strategies to support automation and regression testing.
* Assist in expanding automated coverage across UI, API, workflow, and data validation layers.
* Develop automation approaches for XML validation, publishing verification, and content quality checks.
* Analyze automation effectiveness and continuously improve test coverage.


**Functional \& Workflow Testing**
* Design and execute comprehensive test plans, test cases, and test strategies for enterprise content management solutions.
* Validate complex XML based structured authoring, review, approval, and publishing workflows.
* Test automated workflows, including content creation, reuse, versioning, branching, localization, metadata management, and publication processes.
* Validate workflow orchestration across multiple integrated systems and services.
* Ensure content integrity throughout the content lifecycle.


**XML and Publishing Validation**
* Perform validation of XML\-based content processing pipelines.
* Verify XML structures (e.g., DITA maps, topics, etc.), metadata, key references, conrefs, and content reuse mechanisms.
* Validate XML transformations and publishing workflows.
* Conduct output fidelity testing by validating that rendered outputs accurately reflect source XML structure, metadata, conditional processing rules, content reuse mechanisms, and publishing business rules.
* Verify content accuracy across PDF, HTML, WebHelp, and other publishing formats.
* Troubleshoot content rendering issues and identify root causes across transformation pipelines.


**Data Layer Testing**
* Test both relational and NoSQL data architectures.
* Validate data persistence, retrieval, indexing, and content storage processes.
* Perform scale and performance testing against our content databases .
* Develop and execute XQuery\-based validation scripts to verify content integrity and business rules.
* Validate database indexing, search relevance, faceted search behavior, metadata retrieval, taxonomy relationships, and content discoverability across large repositories.
* Ensure data consistency across systems and environments.


**API and Integration Testing**
* Design and execute API testing for REST, GraphML, MCP and SOAP services.
* Validate API and Application integrations with authoring tools, publishing engines, translation management systems, identity providers, content delivery platforms, and downstream applications.
* Test webhook\-based integrations and event\-driven workflows.
* Verify message processing, asynchronous workflows, and system\-to\-system communication.
* Perform end\-to\-end validation across integrated platforms.
* Ensure reliability, scalability, and fault tolerance of integration points.


**Performance and Reliability Testing**
* Validate system performance under realistic content processing workloads.
* Test scalability of publishing pipelines and content repositories.
* Identify bottlenecks across application, database, and integration layers.
* Collaborate with engineering teams to improve system reliability and performance.


**Collaboration \& Execution**
* Partner closely with global developers, technical writers, product managers, and QA teams.
* Document results and issues in Jira with detailed repro steps, severity levels, and acceptance criteria.
* Support multiple projects simultaneously while maintaining sprint velocity and meeting deadlines.
* Contribute to cross\-functional initiatives such as DevOps, release management, and quality governance.


**Experience And Skills**
**Mandatory Requirements \& Qualifications** 
 :
   

  

* Excellent English language (written and spoken) skills.
* Strong experience with enterprise XML based Component Content Management Systems (CCMS), including structured content authoring, workflow management, content reuse, localization, and publishing processes.
* Solid understanding of XML content architectures and structured content management.
* Strong understanding of XML technologies and XML\-based publishing pipelines.
* Experience validating publishing outputs against source XML content.
* Hands\-on experience testing XML/NoSQL database platforms, with the ability to develop and execute XQuery\-based validation scripts.
* Experience testing modern APIs.
* Experience testing asynchronous, event\-driven, and webhook\-based workflows.
* Strong SQL skills and experience validating relational database systems.
* Expertise in Playwright (JS/TS), JMeter, Azure DevOps, and Jira.
* Minimum of 10 years’ experience in SQA, specifically testing XML based systems. .
* Proven experience defining enterprise QA strategy, establishing testing standards, and driving quality initiatives across multiple teams.
* Demonstrated ability to influence product, engineering, and architectural decisions through quality leadership.
* Experience mentoring QA engineers and leading quality efforts without direct supervision.
* Track record of improving release quality, automation maturity, and testing efficiency at an organizational level.
* Deep understanding of SDLC/STLC with proven Agile/Scrum experience.
* Strong skills in test data creation, maintenance, and management.
* Ability to manage multiple projects independently in a fast\-paced environment.
* Education: MCA / Bachelor’s in Engineering (Computer Science or equivalent).
* Excellent analytical, problem\-solving, and communication skills.


**Preferred Skills \& Qualifications**
* Experience with Power Automate for workflow automation.
* Strong API and database testing expertise (REST, SOAP, SQL, MarkLogic, NoSQL).
* Accessibility testing knowledge (WCAG \& EAA compliance).
* Proficiency with Git and version control systems.
* Experience working with structured content publishing ecosystems, including localization, translation management, or content delivery platforms.
* Exposure to cloud\-based testing environments (AWS/Azure).
* Familiarity with containerized environments (Docker/Kubernetes) for test execution.
* Knowledge of security testing fundamentals (OWASP).

**Global Business Services**
 Global Business Services delivers Technology and Operations capabilities to Lines of Business and Staff Support Functions of Bank of America through a centrally managed, globally integrated delivery model and globally resilient operations.

**Process Overview**
 Data Infrastructure \& Strategic Initiatives team is responsible for all the automation aspects of testing processes, ensuring quality of data and independent testing of corporate \& business level process and regulatory controls by providing seamless access to the appropriate data \& platforms required to execute the associated portfolio of tests.
   

  

 A test is defined in the Independent Testing Enterprise Policy as “An independent point\-in\-time examination of one or more processes, controls, policies and procedures or data sources utilized for managing risk to assess the effectiveness of the control environment. A test is focused on answering a specific objective and has a pre\-defined pass/fail criteria.” Compliance testing may include activities such as automated surveillance and transaction level testing and may be performed onsite. Please note: This is not an application/software testing or application/software development role.
   

  

**Job Description**
 As an SME, drive sustainable automation in EIT (Enterprise Independent Testing) test design, development, and implementation using a modern infrastructure and thoughtfully\-designed solutions. Additionally, train/mentor the Test Automation team and help with creating dashboards for the reporting purposes.
   

  

**Responsibilities:**
* Developing testing automation that provides timely, useful, and actionable independent insight on the operational health of Bank of America’s processes.

* The processes to be assessed span across multiple Products, Regulations and Enterprise Processes. The outputs of the methodologies will be used to drive process improvements and timely detection and reporting of errors.

* Collaborate with key stakeholders across the Bank to understand modeling and testing business processes and requirements
* Perform debugging and code reviews to ensure quality of code.
* Ensure accuracy and quality development and hold validation session with the stakeholders to get a sign\-off .
* Ensure adherence to the SLA’s / Metrics – productivity, turnaround\-time and accuracy.
* Communicate regularly with management and other support colleagues.

* Drive projects independently and ensure timely deliverables.
* Train/Mentor the team in case of any issues

title: Senior Application QA
description:
**Roboyo AI is a category shaper in Applied AI and Agentic Automation.**

 We help leading enterprises move from automation projects and AI experiments into governed, production\-grade systems that execute real work across workflows, processes, products and services.
 

  
 





 Our heritage is in scaled enterprise automation; our future is Applied AI and Agentic Automation: autonomous agents, AI engineering squads, process orchestration, data and knowledge foundations, and human\-in\-the\-loop governance embedded deeply into how our clients operate.
 

  
 





 We are not here to sell AI theatre. We are here to turn AI into working systems, measurable outcomes and repeatable transformation programs.
 

  
 




  
 



**About the role:** 





 We are seeking an experienced and hands\-on 
 
**Senior Application QA**

  to join our growing Quality Engineering team supporting a major UK Financial Services client.
 

  
 





 This role is responsible for ensuring the quality of enterprise applications developed using the Appian platform through a combination of manual testing, automation, quality engineering practices and collaboration across the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC).
 

  
 





 As a Senior QA, you will work closely with Product Owners, Business Analysts, Developers, DevOps Engineers and Business Stakeholders to deliver robust, reliable and high\-quality software. You will contribute to the design and execution of testing strategies, build and maintain automation frameworks, participate in release activities, and help continuously improve our overall quality engineering capability.
 

  
 





 This is a highly hands\-on role requiring excellent technical skills, strong analytical thinking and a proactive approach to quality.
 

  
 




  
 



**Key Responsibilities**






 Quality Engineering \& Test Strategy
 


  
 



* Contribute to the definition and continuous improvement of QA strategy, testing standards and quality engineering practices.


* Promote Shift\-Left testing by participating in requirements analysis, backlog refinement and solution design sessions.


* Review business and technical requirements to ensure they are testable and complete.


* Identify quality risks early and recommend mitigation strategies.


* Support the establishment and maintenance of quality gates throughout the delivery lifecycle.




  
 


 Manual Testing
 


  
 



* Design, prepare and execute comprehensive manual test cases and test scenarios.


* Perform:


* Functional Testing


* Integration Testing


* System Testing


* End\-to\-End Testing


* Regression Testing


* User Acceptance Testing (UAT) support


* Exploratory Testing


* Smoke and Sanity Testing


* Validate business processes, workflows and application behaviour.


* Execute testing across multiple environments and browsers where applicable.


* Ensure all testing evidence is accurately recorded.


* environments.





 API \& Integration Testing
 


  
 



* Validate RESTful APIs and system integrations.


* Perform request and response validation.


* Verify authentication, authorisation and error handling.


* Support testing of integrations between Appian and third\-party platforms.
* Analyse logs and API responses to support troubleshooting and defect investigation.





 Test Planning \& Delivery
 


  
 



* Participate in Sprint Planning, backlog refinement and estimation sessions.


* Prepare test plans, test scenarios and execution schedules.


* Estimate testing effort for new functionality.


* Maintain full traceability between requirements, test cases and defects.


* Support delivery planning across multiple releases.





 Defect Management
 


  
 



* Identify, document and manage software defects throughout their lifecycle.


* Perform root cause analysis alongside development teams.


* Validate defect fixes and regression impacts.


* Ensure defects contain sufficient evidence for efficient investigation.


* Monitor defect trends and recommend process improvements.





 CI/CD \& DevOps
 


  
 



* Integrate automated testing into CI/CD pipelines.


* Support continuous testing practices.


* Execute automated smoke tests following deployments.


* Support release validation activities.


* Help improve deployment quality through automation.





 Production \& Release Support
 


  
 



* Participate in release readiness activities.


* Perform post\-deployment validation.


* Support investigation of production incidents.


* Assist with root cause analysis and hotfix validation.


* Support production release sign\-off where appropriate.





 Test Data \& Environment Management
 


  
 



* Prepare and maintain appropriate test data.


* Coordinate environment readiness for testing activities.


* Support environment troubleshooting.


* Ensure data integrity throughout testing.





 Non\-Functional Testing Support
 


  
 





 Support and contribute to:
 

  
 



* Performance Testing


* Load Testing


* Accessibility Testing


* Compatibility Testing


* Security Testing




 Working alongside specialist teams where required.
 

  
 






 Agile Delivery
 


  
 



* Actively participate in Agile ceremonies.


* Collaborate with cross\-functional delivery teams.


* Provide regular updates on testing progress and quality risks.


* Promote quality ownership across the delivery team.





 Continuous Improvement
 


  
 



* Recommend improvements to testing processes, tools and frameworks.


* Contribute to QA standards and documentation.


* Mentor junior QA engineers.


* Share knowledge and best practices across the team.


* Promote a quality\-first engineering culture.



**Required Skills \& Experience**

title: Agentic AI Evaluation Engineer
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**EY\- Assurance – Senior – Digital**
**Role** 
 :
 **GenAI / Agentic AI Evaluation Engineer (Quality, Safety \& Reliability)**
**Position Details**
 As part of EY GDS Assurance Digital, you will help design, build, and scale a standardized evaluation capability, focused on evaluating GenAI, RAG\-based, and Agentic AI solutions before deployment.
   

  

 This role sits at the intersection of AI evaluation engineering, Responsible AI, and GenAI security/red teaming. The primary objective is to ensure GenAI/agentic systems are safe, reliable, robust, and fit\-for\-purpose, by designing evaluation strategies, building repeatable test harnesses, and generating auditable evidence that supports go/no\-go decisions.
   

  

 You will work with global stakeholders (product teams, solution architects, risk \& compliance, and assurance leadership) to define evaluation requirements, request test datasets from product teams, execute rigorous evaluations (functional \+ non\-functional), and recommend mitigations and controls to reduce risk.
   

  

 This is a core full\-time role that requires a hands\-on AI Development mindset, strong evaluation mindset, and the ability to translate risk concerns into practical testing strategies and measurable acceptance criteria.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Define and operationalize evaluation strategies for GenAI systems across use cases like Q\&A assistants, summarization, extraction, drafting, agentic systems, and multi\-step workflows.
* Translate business use\-cases into a structured evaluation plan: scope, assumptions, success criteria, datasets, metrics, red\-team scenarios, thresholds, and reporting requirements.
* Drive standardization: reusable evaluation templates, test case libraries, scoring rubrics, and reporting formats across product teams.
* Design structured dataset requirements for product teams and ensure coverage across:
+ Core user journeys and primary business intents
+ Edge cases (rare prompts, ambiguous queries, incomplete context)
+ Adversarial cases (malicious prompts, jailbreak attempts, prompt injections)
+ Bias \& fairness cases (sensitive demographic proxies, protected attributes, stereotyping patterns)

* Define guidance for dataset sufficiency and statistical coverage (e.g., minimum samples, distribution balance, scenario matrices, stratification by intent/risk).
* Build reusable evaluation pipelines for:
+ Answer quality (correctness, relevance, completeness, clarity)
+ Grounding \& faithfulness (RAG\-specific: faithfulness, context precision/recall, hallucination rate, citation quality)
+ Agentic behavior (tool\-call accuracy, tool misuse, goal completion, step correctness, unnecessary actions, loop detection, safety of tool outputs)
+ Operational quality (latency, cost/token budget, throughput, stability, retries, failure recovery)

* Combine LLM\-as\-judge and human evaluation in a calibrated way (rubric design, sampling plans, agreement checks).
* Implement automated evaluation harnesses in Python (preferred), enabling:
+ batch runs on scenario suites
+ configurable metric definitions
+ reproducible runs with run IDs and artifacts
+ storage of traces and outputs for auditability

* Execute structured red teaming aligned to OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, covering (examples):
+ Prompt injection (direct \+ indirect) and tool hijacking
+ Sensitive data disclosure / PII leakage
+ Insecure output handling (downstream injection)
+ Training data leakage / memorization probes
+ Model denial\-of\-service / denial\-of\-wallet patterns

* Integrate evals into development lifecycle: pre\-release regression gates, CI checks, benchmark comparisons across model versions/prompts/tools/retrievers.
* Perform adversarial testing for agentic workflows:
+ tool misuse / over\-permissioned tool access
+ unauthorized action execution
+ exfiltration via tools/connectors
+ prompt injection via retrieved documents (RAG poisoning)

* Recommend mitigations: input validation, retrieval filtering, tool sandboxing, least\-privilege permissions, guardrails, policy prompting, refusal logic, output encoding, monitoring alerts.
* Produce high\-quality evaluation reports that are auditable and decision\-ready, including:
+ methodology, datasets, metrics, thresholds
+ quantitative results
+ qualitative results
+ risk assessment summary and recommended control actions

* Present findings to stakeholders in a crisp, risk\-informed manner; clearly explain residual risk, limitations, and rationale for go/no\-go.


**Key Requirements/Skills \& Qualification:**
* Excellent academic background, including at a minimum a bachelor’s or a master’s degree in data science, Statistics, Engineering, Operational Research, or other related field with strong focus on modern data architectures, processes, and environments.
* 4–7\+ years of relevant experience in one or more areas:
+ ML/AI/GenAI/Agentic engineering (NLP/LLMs), evaluation engineering, applied research
+ security testing / red teaming
+ building and designing evaluation harness that ensures safety, reliability and robustness.

* Strong hands\-on Python for building evaluation harnesses (data processing, metric computation, orchestration, reporting pipelines).
* Practical understanding of GenAI system architectures: RAG, embeddings/vector search, prompt orchestration, tool calling, multi\-agent systems, memory, routing.
* Experience designing metrics and evaluation methods (rubrics, automated scoring, sampling strategy, regression design).
* Familiarity with LLM risks and mitigations, especially for enterprise contexts (data leakage, hallucinations, prompt injection, unsafe content, bias).
* Security / Red Teaming Skills (Strong Preference)
* Understanding of OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications and how to translate it into test cases and controls.
* Experience with adversarial testing approaches: jailbreak prompts, injection patterns, tool misuse scenarios, retrieval poisoning patterns.
* Familiarity with secure\-by\-design practices for LLM apps: least privilege, safe tool invocation, output encoding/validation, monitoring.
* Evaluation frameworks and tooling: RAGAS, DeepEval, LangSmith, Phoenix/Arize, custom eval harnesses.
* Experimentation practices: A/B testing mindset, baseline comparisons, statistical rigor for sample sizes.
* Observability/tracing: structured logging, OpenTelemetry, Langfuse\-style traces, dashboards.
* Basic DevOps practices: Git, CI/CD, containerization (Docker), reproducible environments.
* Strong written communication to produce clear evaluation plans and reports for technical \+ non\-technical stakeholders.
* Ability to challenge assumptions constructively (“effective challenge”) and influence engineering teams toward remediation.
* Comfort operating in ambiguity with fast\-evolving GenAI tooling and risk landscape.


**Preferred / Nice\-to\-Have**
* Experience in Assurance/Finance/Regulatory environments (model validation, risk acceptance workflows, audit evidence mindset).
* Familiarity with responsible AI frameworks (NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001, EU AI Act concepts).
* Experience evaluating multilingual systems or domain\-heavy enterprise assistants.
* Hands\-on with Azure ecosystem (Azure OpenAI, AI Search, Function Apps, App Insights, Key Vault).


**Additional skills requirements:**
* Excellent written, oral, presentation and facilitation skills
* Ability to coordinate multiple projects and initiatives simultaneously through effective prioritization, organization, flexibility, and self\-discipline.
* Must have demonstrated project management experience.
* Knowledge of firm’s reporting tools and processes.
* Proactive, organized, and self\-sufficient with ability to priorities and multitask.
* Analyses complex or unusual problems and can deliver insightful and pragmatic solutions.
* Ability to quickly and easily create/ gather/ analyze data from a variety of sources.
* A robust and resilient disposition able to encourage discipline in team behaviors


**What We Look For**
* A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience, and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast\-moving environment
* An opportunity to be a part of market\-leading, multi\-disciplinary team of 7200 \+ professionals, in the only integrated global assurance business worldwide.
* Opportunities to work with EY GDS Assurance practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries


**What Working At EY Offers**
 At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from startups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
   

  

 You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees, and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
   

  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Lead Testing Services Consultant
description:
**What Makes Us, Us**
 Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn and pursue outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say Hello to SimCorp!
   

  

 At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values — caring, customer success\-driven, collaborative, curious, and courageous. Our people\-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered.
   

  

 If you like
   

  

**what we’re saying, keep reading!**
**WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US**
 The Lead Testing Services Consultant at SimCorp, provides leadership in the planning, execution, and optimization of testing services to ensure the delivery of high\-quality solutions. With typically 7\+ years of experience in testing or quality assurance, this role works independently to manage complex testing projects, drive process improvements, and mentor junior team members. The Lead Consultant collaborates with cross\-functional teams, ensures that testing activities meet organizational goals, and contributes to the overall success of service delivery
   

  

**What You Will Be Responsible For**
* Lead the design and execution of comprehensive test plans, ensuring high standards of quality and performance for SimCorp solutions
* Collaborate with stakeholders to define testing requirements, align on project goals, and ensure full test coverage
* Analyze and resolve complex testing issues, implementing effective solutions in a timely manner
* Optimize testing processes and adopt best practices to improve efficiency and reduce the time to delivery
* Mentor and guide junior consultants, enhancing skill development and promoting high\-quality testing standards
* Monitor and analyze testing metrics to assess performance and identify areas for continuous improvement
* Develop and maintain detailed documentation for test plans, cases, and results, ensuring thorough records of testing efforts
* Provide advanced insights on testing strategies, tools, and technologies to ensure the most effective solutions are being used


**WHAT WE VALUE:**
* Managing testing projects to ensure solutions meet quality and performance standards
* Collaborating with development, QA, and operations teams to integrate testing into the overall service delivery process
* Implementing initiatives to introduce automated testing tools and frameworks to enhance testing efficiency
* Conducting root cause analyses for recurring testing issues and ensuring long\-term solutions are in place
* Engaging with clients and stakeholders to communicate testing progress, results, and potential risks
* Facilitating training sessions and knowledge sharing to promote best practices in testing within the team
* Monitoring trends and advancements in testing technologies to ensure the adoption of up\-to\-date tools
* Managing escalations and ensuring timely resolution of complex testing challenges


**Benefits**
 Attractive salary, bonus scheme, and pension are essential for any work agreement. However, in SimCorp we believe we can offer more. Therefore, in addition to the traditional benefit scheme, we provide a good work\-life balance: flexible working hours and a hybrid model. Simcorp follows a global hybrid policy, asking employees to work from the office two days each week while allowing remote work on other days.
   

  

 Simcorp does offer opportunities for professional development: there is never just only one route \- we offer an individual approach to professional development to support the direction you want to take.
   

  

**NEXT STEPS**
 Please send us your application in English via our career site as soon as possible, we process incoming applications continually
 **. Please note that only applications sent through our system will be processed.** 
 At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur in the recruitment process. To uphold fairness and equal opportunities for all applicants, we kindly ask you to exclude personal data such as photo, age, or any non\-professional information from your application. Thank you for aiding us in our endeavor to mitigate biases in our recruitment process.
   

  

 For any questions you are welcome to contact
 **Swati Pal (Swati.pal@simcorp.com)** 
 , Talent Acquisition Partner. If you are interested in being a part of SimCorp but are not sure this role is suitable, submit your CV anyway. SimCorp is on an exciting growth journey, and our Talent Acquisition Team is ready to assist you discover the right role for you. The approximate time to consider your CV is three weeks.
   

  

 We are eager to continually improve our talent acquisition process and make everyone’s experience positive and valuable. Therefore, during the process we will ask you to provide your feedback, which is highly appreciated.
   

  

**WHO WE ARE?**
 For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become the world’s leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are 3,000\+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, educations, professional experiences, ages, and backgrounds.
   

  

 SimCorp is an independent subsidiary of the Deutsche Börse Group. Following the recent merger with Axioma, we leverage the combined strength of our brands to provide an industry\-leading, full, front\-to\-back offering for our clients.
   

  

 SimCorp is an equal opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, without regard to race, gender, age, disability, or any other protected status under applicable law. We are committed to building a culture where diverse perspectives and expertise are integrated into our everyday work. We believe in the continual growth and development of our employees, so that we can provide best\-in\-class solutions to our clients.

title: Sr. SQE Performance Testing
description:
**Join the team as our new Senior Software Quality Engineer \- Performance Testing**
**Hyderabad, India \| Software Quality CoE**
 We are seeking a highly skilled and proactive Senior SQE \- Performance Testing to lead and own the end\-to\-end performance engineering lifecycle. The ideal candidate will contribute to defining the performance testing strategy, execute large\-scale load tests, and deliver actionable insights through robust reporting and analytics. This role will be part of the Software Quality CoE, and it demands strong technical expertise, critical thinking, and the ability to make data\-driven decisions.
   

  

 Additionally, this role requires leveraging modern AI/LLM tools to enhance productivity in automation, performance scripting, test design, and result analysis.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
**Performance Testing Strategy \& Ownership**
* Drive the overall performance testing strategy aligned with business and product goals.
* Own the end\-to\-end performance testing lifecycle, including planning, scripting, execution, monitoring, and reporting.


**Test Design \& Execution**
* Design and implement scalable load, stress, endurance, and spike test scenarios.
* Develop and maintain performance test frameworks and reusable assets.
* Execute tests to validate system scalability, reliability, and stability under load.


**Analysis \& Reporting**
* Analyze performance bottlenecks across application, database, and infrastructure layers.
* Deliver detailed performance reports, dashboards, and analytics with actionable recommendations.


**Collaboration \& Continuous Integration**
* Collaborate with development, DevOps, and architecture teams to resolve performance issues.
* Integrate performance tests into CI/CD pipelines for continuous performance validation.
* Drive performance optimization initiatives and ensure SLAs/SLOs are met.


**What It Takes**
**Technical**
* 5 to 8 years of hands\-on experience in Performance Engineering.
* Strong expertise in any of the performance testing tools (code as a test) such as Gatling, K6, Locust, or similar.
* Solid understanding of performance testing methodologies, workload modeling, and capacity planning.
* Hands\-on experience with monitoring \& observability tools (e.g., Grafana, Prometheus, Dynatrace, Datadog, AppDynamics, New Relic, or similar).
* Strong exposure to CI/CD tools (e.g., Jenkins, Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, etc.).
* Experience analyzing system metrics (CPU, memory, I/O, network, database performance).
* Proficiency in any scripting/programming language (Java, Python, JavaScript, etc.).
* Exposure to cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP) and containerized systems (Docker, Kubernetes).


**Leadership \& Collaboration**
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to present performance insights to stakeholders.
* Ability to take ownership and make data\-driven decisions in high\-pressure scenarios.
* A team player who can challenge constructively and drive quality excellence.


**Mindset**
* A strong quality mindset with attention to detail and deep curiosity to identify system limits.
* Hands\-on, proactive, and continuously learning.


**Nice to Have**
* Experience in PLM (Product Lifecycle Management) or Digital Manufacturing domains.
* Experience in API performance testing and microservices architecture.
* Knowledge of shift\-left performance testing and performance engineering practices.

title: Supervisor, Applications Delivery
description:
**Job Description**
 The person in this role is responsible for leading the design, delivery, implementation, and ongoing support of high\-quality application solutions. At lead/manager level, the role is accountable not only for technical execution, but also for delivery ownership, team coordination, stakeholder alignment, quality governance, operational stability, and continuous improvement across the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC).
   

  

 The person in this role works closely with business stakeholders, architects, project managers, vendors, and cross\-functional delivery teams to translate business priorities into scalable, secure, maintainable, and business\-aligned technology solutions. The role is expected to provide technical leadership, guide team members, manage risks and dependencies, and ensure successful delivery outcomes.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Delivery Leadership, Requirements Analysis \& Estimation**
* Lead requirement analysis discussions with business stakeholders, product owners, architects, and delivery teams.
* Translate business, functional, and non\-functional requirements into solution scope, technical approach, delivery plan, and implementation priorities.
* Own or review effort estimation, delivery planning, resource requirements, and execution timelines for assigned initiatives.
* Identify delivery risks, dependencies, assumptions, and constraints, and drive mitigation plans with stakeholders.
* Ensure requirement documents, user stories, solution notes, and technical specifications are complete, clear, and aligned with agreed scope.


**Solution Design**
* Provide technical leadership in converting enterprise architecture and business needs into detailed solution designs and implementation plans.
* Review and approve design artifacts, workflows, integration approaches, technical specifications, and solution documentation.
* Evaluate design alternatives and guide the team toward scalable, secure, high\-performing, maintainable, and cost\-effective solutions.
* Ensure solution designs comply with enterprise architecture standards, security requirements, data governance expectations, and engineering best practices.
* Lead technical discussions and design reviews with architects, vendors, project teams, and support teams.


**Application Development**
* Lead and guide application development, enhancement, configuration, integration, and maintenance activities.
* Review key technical deliverables to ensure quality, maintainability, performance, security, and alignment with agreed standards.
* Provide technical direction to developers and support team members, including code review guidance, design clarification, and issue resolution support.
* Drive reuse of components, utilities, frameworks, and automation capabilities to improve delivery efficiency and consistency.
* Balance hands\-on technical contribution with oversight of team delivery, ensuring work is completed on time and with expected quality.


**Testing \& Quality Assurance**
* Define and oversee testing strategy, test coverage, quality checkpoints, and defect management for assigned solutions.
* Ensure unit, integration, system, regression, performance, and user acceptance testing activities are planned and executed effectively.
* Review high\-impact defects, support root cause analysis, and ensure corrective actions are implemented before production release.
* Promote test automation, continuous quality improvement, and proactive quality assurance practices across the delivery team.
* Ensure solutions meet functional, non\-functional, compliance, and operational readiness expectations before deployment.


**Architecture \& Technical Governance**
* Lead or actively govern application architecture, technical design, and solution review activities for assigned applications or projects.
* Ensure delivery teams follow architectural guidelines, technology standards, security policies, coding standards, and documentation expectations.
* Participate in governance forums and provide clear recommendations on solution risks, trade\-offs, dependencies, and mitigation options.
* Drive technical decision\-making in alignment with enterprise architecture, business priorities, operational impact, and long\-term maintainability.


**Release, Deployment \& Implementation**
* Own or coordinate release planning, environment readiness, deployment preparation, and implementation activities.
* Manage release risks, change approvals, production validation, rollback planning, and go\-live readiness with project and support teams.
* Coordinate application rollouts, stakeholder communication, hypercare planning, and post\-deployment stabilization.
* Ensure project is completed with proper documentation, monitoring, support handover, and minimal operational risk.


**Production Support \& Maintenance**
* Lead production support coordination for assigned applications, including incident triage, escalation, stakeholder communication, and service restoration.
* Review critical incidents, drive root cause analysis, and ensure corrective and preventive actions are implemented.
* Monitor application stability, performance, SLA adherence, operational risks, and recurring issue patterns.
* Coordinate with infrastructure, vendors, business users, and support teams to resolve issues within agreed timelines.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives to reduce recurring incidents, improve support efficiency, and strengthen operational resilience.


**Client \& Stakeholder Management**
* Act as a primary point of contact for business stakeholders, customers, vendors, project managers, and support teams for assigned applications or delivery scope.
* Facilitate effective communication between business and IT teams, ensuring expectations, priorities, risks, and decisions are clearly understood.
* Provide timely, accurate, and management\-ready updates on project progress, production issues, risks, dependencies, and delivery outcomes.
* Lead stakeholder workshops, solution walkthroughs, demonstrations, implementation discussions, and operational readiness reviews.
* Build trusted relationships by demonstrating ownership, responsiveness, business understanding, technical credibility, and accountability.


**People Management \& Team Leadership**
* Lead, guide, mentor, and support developers, analysts, and support team members across project and operational activities.
* Allocate work, monitor progress, remove blockers, and ensure team deliverables meet agreed scope, timeline, and quality standards.
* Identify capability gaps, provide coaching, support knowledge transfer, and recommend training or development actions.
* Promote accountability, collaboration, ownership, and continuous improvement within the team.
* Coordinate with internal teams and vendor resources to ensure effective delivery performance and service continuity.


**Knowledge Management \& Organizational Learning**
* Own and maintain technical documentation, solution design records, support guides, runbooks, lessons learned, and reusable delivery assets.
* Establish knowledge\-sharing practices across project, development, and support teams to reduce dependency on individuals.
* Leverage lessons learned from previous projects and production issues to improve delivery effectiveness, solution quality, and operational stability.
* Conduct knowledge transfer sessions, mentor team members, and ensure transition readiness for support and maintenance teams.
* Promote continuous learning, technical capability development, and standardization across applications and technology domains.


**Transition \& Service Readiness**
* Own transition planning and service readiness for new or enhanced applications moving into production support.
* Ensure operational documentation, support guides, monitoring requirements, escalation paths, and handover materials are complete.
* Lead knowledge transfer sessions for support, maintenance, operations, and vendor teams.
* Confirm service readiness before production transition, including support model, SLA expectations, issue ownership, and operational acceptance criteria.


**Qualifications**
**Technical Skills**
* Programming in MS Visual C\#, Dot Net Framework
* Programming in RESTful API
* Coding SQL for Sql Server


**Software Engineering Processes**
* Strong working knowledge of SDLC methodologies, including Agile, Waterfall, DevOps, and hybrid delivery models.
* Ability to lead delivery planning, sprint or milestone tracking, dependency management, issue resolution, and delivery governance.
* Experience establishing or enforcing engineering practices, documentation standards, quality gates, and release readiness controls.


**Design Knowledge**
* Strong understanding of architecture principles, integration patterns, design methodologies, design patterns, and anti\-patterns.
* Ability to review architectural requirements and guide teams in developing scalable, secure, reliable, and maintainable technical designs.
* Experience assessing technical trade\-offs, long\-term maintainability, operational impact, and business value when recommending solutions.


**Requirements Engineering**
* Strong experience in requirements elicitation, analysis, prioritization, documentation, traceability, and stakeholder validation.
* Ability to translate business requirements into solution scope, technical approach, delivery roadmap, and operational support model.
* Experience managing requirement changes, business expectations, scope control, and impact assessment across project delivery phases.


**Configuration \& Release Management**
* Strong knowledge of source control, configuration management, environment management, release governance, and deployment processes.
* Experience coordinating CI/CD, build automation, deployment validation, version control, and rollback planning.
* Ability to manage release dependencies, approvals, production readiness, and post\-release stabilization activities.


**Build \& Testing Practices**
* Strong understanding of build tools, development frameworks, automation techniques, and quality engineering practices.
* Experience defining test strategy, reviewing test coverage, supporting test automation, and managing defect resolution.
* Ability to ensure software quality through structured testing, quality checkpoints, and production readiness validation.


**Behavioral Competencies**
**Analytical Thinking**
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, troubleshooting, and decision\-making capabilities.
* Ability to evaluate technical, operational, financial, and business impacts from multiple sources before recommending actions.
* Capable of assessing alternatives, facilitating alignment, and driving practical solutions under time, cost, and operational constraints.


**Communication**
* Excellent verbal, written, presentation, and stakeholder communication skills.
* Ability to communicate technical or complex topics clearly in business terms for management, business users, vendors, and technical teams.
* Able to prepare clear status updates, escalation notes, decision papers, meeting summaries, and management\-ready communications.


**Planning \& Organization**
* Ability to manage multiple projects, priorities, resources, and operational demands in a dynamic environment.
* Proactively identifies risks, dependencies, constraints, and execution challenges, and drives mitigation with relevant stakeholders.
* Effective in planning, tracking, organizing, and coordinating deliverables across project phases, support activities, vendors, and cross\-functional teams.


**Stakeholder Collaboration**
* Works effectively with senior stakeholders, cross\-functional teams, vendors, business users, and technical teams.
* Demonstrates ownership, accountability, customer focus, business understanding, and delivery discipline.
* Builds trust through transparency, responsiveness, sound judgment, and consistent follow\-through on commitments.


 Supports a culture of collaboration, continuous improvement, knowledge sharing, and team development.
   

  

**Working Experience**
* Over 8 years of relevant IT experience, including experience in application delivery, technical leadership, stakeholder management, production support, vendor coordination and team management. Prior lead or manager\-level experience is preferred.

**Requirements (including Experience, Skills And Additional Qualifications)**

**Technical Skills Requirements**

* Strong experience with Power Apps, Power Automate, and the broader Power Platform.
* Proficiency in web development technologies, including React, TypeScript, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.

* Lead the technical design sessions, architecting solutions that fulfill business requirements while aligning with EY's technology standards and best practices.

* Excellent problem\-solving, analytical, and communication skills.
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced, collaborative environment and manage multiple projects simultaneously.
* Strong understanding of software development lifecycle (SDLC) and Agile methodologies.

* Microsoft certifications in Power Platform and/or SharePoint.
* Experience with Microsoft Graph API.
* Knowledge of SharePoint PnP (Patterns and Practices).

* Ability to work within a multi\-disciplinary team structure, but also independently
* Demonstrates analytical and systematic approach to problem solving

title: Senior Software Development Engineer
description:
**About Beacon Platform By CWAN**
 Beacon is a cloud\-native, cross\-asset risk analytics and quantitative development platform used by top\-tier asset managers and banks. It provides a transparent, extensible environment for building, deploying and scaling valuation models, pricing libraries and risk analytics across asset classes — including derivatives, structured products and fixed income. It combines pre\-built financial applications with a flexible developer infrastructure that lets quants and model developers write custom pricing and valuation logic, run scenario analysis, and integrate models directly into front\-office and risk workflows.
   

  

 The role
   

  

* You will own the reliability of Clearwater's risk and analytics applications in engineering terms — designing and building the automation, tooling and operational architecture that keeps the overnight and intraday pipelines correct and on time for asset managers and insurers who need to see their portfolios each morning.
* This is a senior engineering role on the application layer. The distinction that matters at this level: you are expected to retire classes of failure, not instances of them. When the same problem appears for the third time, we want the engineer who stops patching it and builds the thing that makes it impossible to fail. That work competes for time with the model and feature changes the quant and risk teams are asking for, so you will also need to argue for it in their terms — what the recurring failure is costing them now, and what fixing it properly buys them. Cloud fluency matters because the applications run on AWS and you need to operate them competently there, but you will not be provisioning the infrastructure beneath them.
* You will be based in Mumbai alongside the market data team — a group with front\-office training who partner on the genuinely hard analytics questions, not only on data plumbing. That adjacency is the point of the placement: you will sit with the quant, risk and market data teams and be expected to learn what the systems actually compute. When a curve build fails or an end\-of\-day risk run finishes late, we want engineers who can reason about which clients are affected and what the number means.
* The team is part of a globally distributed platform organisation spanning Mumbai, Tokyo and the US, with US\-based coverage for the London close, so every major market cutoff falls inside a staffed window. You will join and help shape a follow\-the\-sun on\-call rotation covering the end\-of\-day cycles of multiple regions. We are explicit about this because the three\-region model is what keeps it sustainable — there is no permanent night shift.
* You will have real ownership of the services you support and direct influence over how reliability is engineered into them. You will report to the support lead in Mumbai.


 What you'll do
   

  

 Design and build the tooling layer
   

  

* Own the diagnostic tooling strategy — including AI\-assisted tooling — so that establishing whether an issue is infrastructure or market data, and which clients it touches, takes seconds rather than a manual trawl through logs and jobs. Tooling, not documentation alone, is how we intend to get response times down.
* Write and review production\-quality Python that eliminates toil: runbook automation, health checks, self\-service diagnostics and remediation used across the team.
* Design automated recovery and self\-healing for analytics jobs, so a single failed task does not become a missed client deliverable.
* Set the observability standard — design monitoring and alerting around business outcomes (late valuations, missing risk measures, stale prices) rather than host and container metrics, and drive alert noise down so pages are actionable and rare.


 Own production and lead incidents
   

  

* Own incident response for client\-impacting issues: command the incident, mitigate, communicate, and run blameless postmortems that end in fixes rather than findings.
* Investigate at the application level — logs, stack traces, job histories and the code itself — to establish root cause, then fix it or hand the development team a diagnosis precise enough to act on.
* Track service commitments and recurring pain: report on timeliness and failure trends, and push through the fixes that retire repeat issues.
* Set the boundary for first\-line infrastructure work — stale hosts, memory pressure, connectivity failures, host loss — so routine cases are remediated locally and deeper platform work escalates cleanly.


 Harden the batch and end\-of\-day architecture
   

  

* Own and harden large\-scale batch and EOD processing: job orchestration, dependency management, retries, idempotency, backfills and safe reruns.
* Keep the overnight window on schedule — find where time is going across stages and drive the fixes with the development teams.


 Own the data and market data interface
   

  

* Support the reference data, market data and timeseries stores behind pricing and risk — schema and index design, replication, retention and query performance in NoSQL and timeseries systems.
* Operate data quality and reconciliation controls with the market data team: completeness checks, stale\-data and anomaly alerting, vendor feed failure handling.
* Debug data\-shaped production problems — a missing fixing, a bad identifier mapping, a holiday calendar difference, a failed download job, a partial vendor file — traced through to the affected downstream analytics.
* Act as a single escalation path with the market data team on front\-office\-facing issues, sharing triage and root cause rather than passing tickets between functions.


 Lead and influence
   

  

* Partner with quant developers and risk engineers to make reliability a design input rather than a post\-launch concern.
* Mentor engineers on incident triage, investigation technique and on\-call practice, and set the standards for automation and operational readiness.
* Contribute to production readiness reviews for new services and client onboardings.
* Support client escalations on risk and analytics output, and be the person client\-facing teams want in the room during an incident.
* Document architecture, runbooks and failure modes.


 What you'll bring
   

  

**Required**
* 7\+ years in software engineering for a business\-critical platform, with real ownership of services.
* Strong Python, plus shell. You must be comfortable reading and debugging application code to find root cause — this role is not runbook execution.
* Demonstrated troubleshooting depth — working from a vague client symptom through logs, job histories, data and code to a precise diagnosis.
* Hands\-on experience operating batch and scheduled workloads at scale, including workflow orchestration (Airflow, Prefect, Step Functions or equivalent).
* Solid grounding in distributed systems — you can reason about partial failure, retries, idempotency, consistency, and queue and backpressure behaviour under load.
* Working knowledge of AWS — enough to operate applications confidently (compute, S3, IAM, CloudWatch, basic networking) and to tell an infrastructure problem from an application one.
* Practical NoSQL experience (MongoDB, DynamoDB, Cassandra or similar): data modelling, indexing, replication and performance troubleshooting.
* Observability in practice — Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, OpenTelemetry or equivalent — and sensible alert design.
* On\-call experience with structured escalation and postmortem writing, and the judgement to lead an incident rather than only participate in one.
* A general understanding of financial systems and genuine appetite to learn the business. You should be able to hold a conversation about what a valuation or a risk number is for, and be willing to go deeper.
* Clear written and verbal communication, and the ability to work effectively in a globally distributed team.
* Degree (B.Tech / M.Tech / MCA / MSc) in computer science, engineering or a related field.


**Preferred**
* Experience with timeseries data at scale — storage and partitioning strategies, retention, and query patterns for large historical datasets.
* Experience supporting trading systems, order management systems, risk management systems or market data platforms.
* Familiarity with financial data concepts — instrument reference data, curves and fixings, corporate actions, EOD valuation cycles, VaR and sensitivities.
* Kubernetes and containerised workloads in production, from an operations perspective.
* Infrastructure as code and CI/CD — Terraform, Docker, GitHub Actions or GitLab CI — enough to make and review changes when the work calls for it.
* Streaming and event\-driven infrastructure (Kafka, Kinesis, MSK) and distributed compute (Spark, EMR, Dask, Ray).
* MongoDB Atlas, Redis / ElastiCache, or managed timeseries and analytical stores (Timestream, ClickHouse, Redshift).
* Working in a regulated financial environment — change management, access controls, audit evidence and client\-facing SLAs.
* Fluency with AI\-assisted development and operations tooling — using LLM\-based agents and assistants to build diagnostics, automate investigation and accelerate delivery.
* Experience mentoring engineers and setting operational standards across a team.


 What will make you stand out
   

  

* A track record of turning a fragile, hand\-held process into a stable service with measurably less manual intervention.
* Experience designing automated recovery, failover and monitoring specifically for analytics or compute\-heavy batch jobs.
* Tooling you built that measurably shortened time\-to\-diagnosis — and a view on where AI\-assisted tooling genuinely helps in an operations context and where it does not.
* The ability to translate a technical failure into client impact, and to be the person client\-facing teams want in the room during an incident.
* Curiosity about the domain: engineers who ask what the model is doing and why the number matters build far better reliability into these systems.

**Responsibilities**
* Lead User Acceptance Testing initiatives for trading platform products, translating complex business requirements into structured test strategies and ensuring seamless rollout to production.
* Design, develop, and maintain automated test scripts and scenarios using Java and Cucumber (BDD), improving test coverage and reducing time\-to\-market for critical system releases.
* Monitor software products and development processes for conformance to quality standards, identify risks and implement corrective actions to maintain compliance across the software development lifecycle.
* Conduct root cause analyses on quality failures, document findings with precision, and independently recommend process improvements that elevate team\-wide quality outcomes.
* Analyze complex trade data — including order types and execution flows — to validate system behavior and ensure alignment with FIX protocol and electronic trading regulatory requirements.
* Coordinate test strategy development and execution across project teams, global stakeholders, and third\-party vendors, ensuring consistent delivery against timelines and quality benchmarks.
* Gather, maintain, and report on quality metrics to provide leadership and project teams with clear visibility into testing progress, defect trends, and risk posture.
* Mentor and coach junior quality analysts, sharing technical expertise and contributing to the team's overall development.


**Required Qualifications \& Skills**
* 10 or more years of experience in an IT Quality or software quality assurance role, with demonstrated ownership across the full testing lifecycle.
* Hands\-on experience testing trading platforms, with a solid understanding of Futures and Options products, order types, and electronic trading processes.
* Proficiency in test automation using Java and Behavior\-Driven Development frameworks, specifically Cucumber, with the ability to write, modify, and execute complex automated test scripts.
* Working knowledge of CI/CD pipelines, container environments (ECS), and version control using GitHub, enabling integration of quality practices into modern delivery workflows.
* Good understanding of the FIX protocol, regulatory obligations for electronic trading, and the ability to validate system behavior against these standards.
* Ability to write complex queries and work with reporting tools to analyses large volumes of trade and system data effectively.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to coordinate across project teams, vendors, and global counterparts to align on quality outcomes.


**Beneficial Skills \& Qualifications**
* Project management experience, with the ability to plan, track, and communicate quality workstreams within fast\-paced, time\-sensitive delivery programmes.
* Experience defining and documenting business requirements, bridging the gap between technology teams and business stakeholders to ensure test coverage reflects real\-world use cases.
* Prior involvement in vendor management, including coordinating quality activities and testing accountability across third\-party technology providers.


**Education:**
* Bachelor’s/University degree or equivalent experience

 NXP’s Wireless Connectivity group is building the next generation of wireless chipsets for Automotive, Gaming, IoT, Industrial and Smart\-Home devices.
 



 These chipsets will define ultra\-low power, high performance and low latency benchmarks for products that rely on Wi\-Fi, BT/BLE and 802\.15\.4

description:
**About SaveIN** 
 : SaveIN is a Y\-Combinator\-backed fintech company on a mission to make financial products accessible and affordable for every Indian. We offer Buy Now Pay Later (BNPL) and no\-cost EMI solutions through a growing network of Banks, NBFCs, and lending partners, enabling consumers to fund healthcare, education, and everyday needs without financial stress.
 



  





**About the Role** 
 : SaveIN is looking for a Senior QA Engineer with a strong automation focus to help us scale test coverage across our lending and payments platform. You'll work closely with engineering, product, and compliance teams to ensure the reliability, security, and correctness of systems that handle real money movement and sensitive customer data.
 



  





**Employment Type** 
 : Full\-Time
 



**Working Days:** 
 5 days a week
 



**Mode of Work:** 
 On\-Site
 



**Experience Required:** 
 3\-5 years
 



**Reporting To** 
 : CTO
 



  





**Responsibilities:** 



* Design, build, and maintain automated test suites (API, UI, and regression) integrated into CI/CD pipelines.
* Own the test strategy for critical customer journeys, including onboarding, credit decisioning, disbursement, and repayment/collections.
* Build and maintain automation frameworks for testing integrations with bank partners (HDFC, ICICI, IDFC First) and bureau/KYC providers.
* Identify gaps in test coverage and proactively build automated regression suites to reduce manual QA dependency.
* Collaborate with developers to "shift testing left" by embedding test gates into CI/CD alongside SAST/security checks.
* Perform API contract testing, load/performance testing, and data validation for financial transactions.
* Write clear, reproducible bug reports and work with engineering to drive root\-cause fixes.
* Contribute to the test data management strategy, especially around PII/DPDP\-compliant sandbox data.
* Mentor junior QA engineers and help formalize QA processes, test documentation, and release sign\-off criteria.
* Participate in production incident reviews to identify testing gaps that could have caught issues earlier.



  





**Requirements:** 



* 3\-5 years of experience in QA/SDET roles with a strong hands\-on automation focus.
* Proficiency with automation frameworks (e.g., Selenium, Playwright, Cypress) and API testing tools (e.g., Postman, RestAssured, Karate).
* Solid understanding of CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Jenkins) and integrating automated tests.
* Working knowledge of SQL for data validation and backend testing.
* Experience testing REST APIs, webhooks, and third\-party integrations.
* Basic scripting ability (Java/Python/JavaScript) for writing and maintaining test scripts.
* Understanding of the software testing lifecycle, including test planning, traceability, regression, and exploratory testing.
* Prior experience in fintech, banking, or lending products is a strong plus (understanding of KYC, credit underwriting, or payment flows).
* Familiarity with performance testing tools (e.g., JMeter, k6\) is a plus.
* Exposure to security testing basics (e.g., OWASP Top 10\) is a plus, given the regulated environment.



  





**Nice to Have:** 



* Experience testing systems with multiple bank/NBFC integrations.
* Familiarity with compliance\-driven QA (e.g., audit trails, RBI/data protection considerations).
* Interest in AI\-assisted testing tools/agentic QA workflows, as this is a growing focus area for our team.

title: Technical Lead
description:
This is a hands\-on engineering role. You will write
 **production code every day** 
 , and you will lead by building the hardest parts yourself.
 



 It is
 **not a management role** 
 . There is no team to administer, no appraisal cycle, no delivery meetings in place of engineering. If you have moved away from daily coding, this role will not suit you.
 



  





**Our Primary tech stack:** 



* React
* React Native
* Python
* Salesforce
* Cloud\-native, across all major clouds
* An agentic layer running through all of it
* Whatever else the client needs



  





**What you will own:** 



* **The build.** 
 Production code every week, on the parts that matter most. Design, write, review, ship.
* **Agentic systems.** 
 LLM\-driven features running in production for clients. Agents, tool calling, retrieval, evaluation, and the cost and latency behind each choice.
* **The technical standard.** 
 Design and code reviews for two or three engineers working alongside you.
* **Delivery.** 
 Scope, estimate, sequence and commitment date. When a date is at risk you raise it before it moves.
* **Technical discussions with clients.** 
 Requirements, trade\-offs, and what is possible by when.



  





**Requirements:** 



* 6–8 years in software engineering, hands\-on throughout
* Python, with production depth
* React, and React Native for mobile
* Cloud in production on AWS, Azure or GCP, deployed and operated by you
* Production code written in the last 90 days
* An LLM or agent feature you have built and shipped to production
* Experience leading engineers technically, through reviews, standards and design decisions
* Delivery ownership: you have carried a date and answered for it
* Able to work hybrid from Coimbatore



  





**Preferred:** 



* Both startup and large\-organisation experience
* Daily use of AI engineering tools such as Claude, Cursor or Copilot, with a clear view of where they help and where they mislead
* You follow the field closely and form views by building with new models and tooling rather than reading about them
* Salesforce
* Client\-facing experience, in India or abroad



  





**Process:** 




 Screening call, technical discussion, delivery and leadership conversation, offer. We aim to close within two weeks of first contact.
