title: Sr. Technical Test Engineer 3
description:
**Job Title: Senior Technical Test Engineer \- Sr. Analyst \- ACS SONG**
**Management Level: Level 10 \- Sr. Analyst**
**Location: Kochi**
**Must Have Skills: Web automation (Playwright/JavaScript), API automation (Playwright/Karate \- JavaScript)**
**Good to have skills: AI\-assisted testing tools (Copilot, ChatGPT, etc.)**
**Experience: 3\-5 years of experience is required**
**Educational Qualification: Graduation (Accurate educational details should capture)**
**Job Summary**
 At Accenture Song, delivering top\-notch solutions means ensuring development outcomes align with expectations. While manual testing is still important, there's an increasing focus on automating various testing types \- functional, regression, visual, performance, and compatibility. As a Senior Technical Test Engineer, you'll take a leading role in our test automation initiatives, helping to drive quality across the board.
   

  

**Roles And Responsibilities**
* Design, develop, execute, and maintain automated test scripts for both UI and API testing.
* Create and execute comprehensive test plans, test cases, and test scripts based on business requirements and acceptance criteria.
* Build, maintain, and enhance reusable automation frameworks using industry best practices.
* Collaborate with Product Owners, Business Analysts, Developers, and QA team members to understand requirements and translate them into effective test scenarios.
* Analyze, troubleshoot, and resolve automation, environment, and test execution issues.
* Review automation scripts and test execution results to ensure adherence to automation standards and best practices.
* Leverage AI\-assisted tools and workflows to improve requirement analysis, test design, automation development, and overall QA productivity.
* Participate actively in Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, backlog refinement, daily stand\-ups, reviews, and retrospectives.
* Document defects, test execution results, and project status updates clearly and concisely.
* Drive continuous improvements in automation practices, testing processes, and overall software quality.
* Communicate effectively with cross\-functional teams and stakeholders.
* Demonstrate professionalism, ownership, and a proactive attitude towards delivering high\-quality software.

 Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
   

  

 Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000\+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.

The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high\-quality, value\-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.

Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
   

  

 Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 As a Senior in EY GDS Tech Ops practice, you will design, build, and deploy intelligent systems that streamline business and IT Operational processes by integrating Artificial Intelligence (LLMs, NLP, Vision) with automation tools (RPA, APIs). You will identify opportunities, build and operationalize AI, and automation solutions, and ensuring alignment with EY’s quality standards and client expectations. This role requires a senior developer with experience in building, deploying and managing AI \& automation solution in managed services engagements.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Responsible for decision\-making, optimizing processes, resource management, and overseeing team management as needed for task execution.
* Accountable for allocating personnel, supervising team members, assigning tasks, ensuring that the team has the necessary tools and support to succeed in their roles and optimizing and evaluating their performance to meet organizational goals.
* Design and develop AI\-powered automation workflows

* Identify, analyse, and automate repetitive tasks across the life cycle of operations and engineer.
* Write custom scripts (mostly Python) to connect disparate platforms and build automation logic.
* Monitor, maintain, and debug automated workflows to ensure reliability and high performance.
* Create technical documentation and best\-practice guidelines for deployed automation solutions.
* Collaborate with AI Platform team to identify, integrate and manage AI and point solutions into the AI Platforms.
* Collaborate with AI, Automation, Operations, Engineering, and business stakeholders to identify, build, and operationalize AI and automation solutions.
* Drive adoption of AI, automation, tools and accelerators across engagements and practices.
* Support business development efforts involving automation \& AI solution including proposals, presentations, and client workshops.
* Ensure compliance with EY’s risk management and security standards.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Strong knowledge of Python and experience with API integration.
* Familiarity with RPA tools like UiPath, Power Automate, or Automation Anywhere.
* Ability to analyse complex processes and design automated solutions.
* Experience building AI and automation solutions \& tools in managed services engagements is a plus.
* Understanding of ITSM, and ITIL methodologies is a plus.
* Excellent communication and ability to collaborate with cross\-functional teams to identify automation opportunities.


**To qualify for the role, you must have**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or related field.
* 5\+ years of overall experience, with at least 2 years in developing, implementing and managing AI \& automation solutions and tools.
* Experience with LLMs, RAG architecture, NLP frameworks, AI Ops, low\-code tools and scripting languages (Python, JavaScript/TypeScript)


**What we look for:**
* Enthusiastic learners with a passion for Python and experience with API integration \& RPA tools like UiPath, Power Automate
* Problem solvers with a proactive approach to troubleshooting and optimization.
* Team players who can collaborate effectively in a remote or hybrid work environment.
* Detail\-oriented professionals with strong documentation skills.


**What We Offer You**
 At EY, we’ll develop you with future\-focused skills and equip you with world\-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams.
   

  

* Our Commitment: As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
* Professional Development: From entry\-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
* People and Culture: In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
* Benefits: Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting\-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
* How to Apply: If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user\-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.

title: Engineering Lead - AI
description:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
   

  

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
   

  

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.
   

  

**EY Job Description**
**Job Title: Engineering Lead – AI**
**Job Rank (must note a single rank only for each job description): Associate Director**
**Function: EY Technology – Enterprise Technology**
**Scope (indicate either “global/cross\-border” or “local/country”):Global**
**Sub Function: EY Technology \| CBS Technology \| Intelligent Automation**
**Reports to (Job Title): Service Delivery Lead: AI \& Automation**
**Job Summary:**
 The Engineering Lead is responsible for hands\-on engineering delivery of enterprise AI/ML/GenAI and automation solutions, coding standards, design patterns, ensuring production\-grade security, scalability, reliability, and supportability. It is not a solution advisory, PoC, or platform administration role. Success is measured by the quality, reliability, scalability, and operability of AI systems in production.
   

  

 Operating as a player–coach, the Engineering Lead works alongside AI Engineers to design and build ML Models, LLM pipelines and agentic workflows, while also setting engineering standards, coaching teams, and ensuring delivery.
   

  

**The ideal candidate will possess:**
* Extensive, hands\-on software engineering experience, with a proven track record of building and operating complex systems in production environments.
* Strong executive communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear, business\-relevant outcomes.
* Ability to independently design and code across multiple technical components, while guiding and elevating the work of senior engineers.
* Deep technical expertise across the full stack, including cloud\-native architectures, distributed systems, and data\-intensive platforms.
* Strong command of non\-functional requirements, including reliability, availability, scalability, performance, and cost optimization, and the ability to make sound technology and architecture decisions as systems evolve over time.
* Demonstrated experience delivering production\-grade Generative AI and Agentic AI solutions, including:
* LLM\-powered applications and services
* Agentic workflows and orchestration frameworks
* Model integration, evaluation, and lifecycle management
* MLOps / LLMOps pipelines and operational practices
* Proven experience partnering with Data Science and AI Research teams to operationalize models and AI capabilities at enterprise scale.
* Ability to drive the design and delivery of AI\-first architectures, including LLM\-powered services, agentic workflows, orchestration layers, and human\-in\-the\-loop systems.
* Experience building robust data and software foundations that enable advanced analytics, real\-time AI inference, and intelligent decisioning at scale.


**Essential Functions of the Job:**
* Engineering Ownership \& Delivery Accountability
+ Own end\-to\-end technical delivery of AI and GenAI solutions—from design through production and BAU support.
+ Act as the technical authority for the build team, accountable for:
- Code quality and engineering standards
- Security, privacy, and compliance
- Reliability, scalability, performance, and cost
- Operational readiness and supportability

+ Make hard engineering trade\-offs balancing latency, accuracy, cost, reliability, and scale.
+ Own production systems post go\-live, including incident analysis, performance tuning, and architectural evolution.


* Hands\-on GenAI \& AI Systems Engineering
* 
+ Collaborate with solution architecture on design and own build production\-grade GenAI systems, including:
- Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines
- Agentic workflows and tool\-based orchestration
- Prompt pipelines, routing, and integration layers
- Human\-in\-the\-loop and safety guardrails

+ Work shoulder\-to\-shoulder with AI Engineers and Data Scientists to:
- Productionize models and LLM pipelines
- Implement evaluation, monitoring, and observability
- Optimize inference cost, performance, and reliability

+ Ensure experimental AI capabilities are engineered into real systems, not isolated prototypes.


* Architecture \& Engineering Standards
+ Define and enforce reference architectures and engineering standards for AI and GenAI systems.
+ Drive consistent adoption of:
- Clean and modular architecture patterns
- Reusable components and shared frameworks
- CI/CD, DevOps, and cloud\-native practices

+ Partner with architecture, platform, security, and data teams while retaining final accountability for build quality.


* AI Platform Engineering \& MLOps / LLMOps
+ Build and evolve AI platforms that support:
- Model lifecycle management
- LLMOps / MLOps pipelines
- Evaluation, monitoring, and drift detection
- Secure access, auditability, and governance

+ Ensure AI systems meet enterprise non\-functional requirements over time, not just at launch.


* Team Leadership \& Capability Building
+ Lead and grow a team of senior engineers within the AI \& Automation build function.
+ Coach engineers on:
- Backend and distributed systems engineering
- GenAI application design and implementation
- Writing maintainable, testable, production\-quality code

+ Set a strong engineering culture focused on ownership, rigor, and continuous improvement.
+ Support hiring and skills development aligned to future AI engineering needs.


* Stakeholder \& Cross\-Functional Collaboration
+ Partner closely with:
- AI/ML Engineering and Data Science teams
- Platform, security, and operations teams
- Architecture and governance forums

+ Translate business and functional requirements into robust technical designs.
+ Act as a senior technical voice in design authorities and delivery governance.


**Engineering Expectations (Non Negotiable)**
* Has built and operated complex, distributed backend systems in production.
* Comfortable debugging production incidents involving AI/LLM pipelines.
* Writes, reviews, and maintains production\-quality code, not just prototypes.
* Understands failure modes of AI systems and designs for resilience.
* Takes ownership for systems after go\-live, including reliability and cost optimization.


**Analytical/Decision Making Responsibilities:**
 This role is critical to ensuring the enterprise’s AI ambition translates into
 **real, reliable, and scalable systems** 
 —not just innovation theater. You will define how AI is built, shipped, and operated across the organization.
   

  

**Knowledge and Skills Requirements:**
**Core Engineering Skills**
* Strong hands\-on experience in Python, Java, C\#, or similar backend languages.
* Proven experience building API\-driven, cloud\-native systems.
* Strong understanding of distributed systems, scalability, and reliability patterns.


**GenAI / AI Engineering (Essential)**
* Hands\-on experience building LLM\-powered applications, including:
+ RAG pipelines
+ Agentic or tool\-augmented workflows
+ Prompt orchestration and integration layers

* Experience with:
+ Vector databases and embeddings
+ LLM evaluation, observability, and monitoring
+ Guardrails, safety, and cost controls

* Experience operationalizing AI models at scale in enterprise environments.


**Nice to Have (Not Core Identity)**
* Experience integrating AI services into enterprise automation platforms (e.g., Power Platform, ServiceNow).
* Familiarity with Azure AI services and data platforms.


**Detailed Responsibilities:**
* Solution Development: Design, develop, and implement automation solutions using Microsoft Power Platform (Power Automate, Power Apps) and ServiceNow. Create custom workflows, forms, and applications to automate business processes and enhance user experience.
* Integration Management: Integrate Microsoft and ServiceNow platforms with other enterprise applications using APIs, web services, and middleware. Ensure seamless data flow between systems and maintain data integrity across integrated applications.
* Testing and Quality Assurance: Conduct thorough testing of automation solutions to ensure functionality, performance, and compliance with business requirements. Implement best practices for code quality, documentation, and version control.
* Observability and Maintenance: Monitor the performance of automation solutions and troubleshoot issues as they arise. Perform regular maintenance and updates to ensure optimal functionality and security of automation applications.
* Documentation: Create and maintain comprehensive documentation for automation solutions, including design specifications, user guides, and technical manuals. Document processes, workflows, and integration points for future reference and knowledge transfer.
* User Training and Support: Provide training and support to end\-users and team members on automation tools and processes.Develop training materials and conduct workshops to facilitate user adoption of automation solutions.
* Collaboration and Stakeholder Engagement: Work closely with cross\-functional teams, including business analysts, project managers, and IT staff, to ensure alignment on automation initiatives. Engage with stakeholders to gather feedback and make necessary adjustments to automation solutions.
* Performance Metrics and Reporting: Define and track key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure the effectiveness of automation solutions. Generate reports and dashboards to communicate the impact of automation on business processes and operational efficiency.
* Continuous Improvement: Stay updated on the latest trends and advancements in automation, AI, and relevant technologies.Identify areas for continuous improvement and propose enhancements to existing automation solutions.
* Governance and Compliance: Ensure that automation solutions adhere to organizational policies, governance frameworks, and compliance requirements. Participate in risk assessments and audits related to automation initiatives.
* Innovation and Research: Explore and evaluate new technologies, tools, and methodologies to enhance automation capabilities. Conduct research on industry best practices and competitor strategies to inform decision\-making and innovation.
* Change Management: Analyze the impact of automation on organizational processes and culture, making recommendations for change management strategies. Assist in developing communication plans to inform stakeholders about automation initiatives and their benefits.


**Other Requirements:**
* Familiarity with Python practices and tools.
* Strong communication, stakeholder management and influence
* Strong leadership and conflict resolution capability
* Leading virtual teams


**Job Requirements:**
**Education:**
* A degree in Computer Science / Engineering or a related discipline; or equivalent work experience


**Experience:**
* 10\+ years in a Global IT environment working with multiple disciplines to deliver projects in line with customer needs
* 3\+ Years Global delivery or transformation preferably in large scale infrastructure programs
* 3\+ Years in a global operations environment


**Certification Requirements:**
* Relevant certifications in MS Power Platform and ServiceNow RPA
* Python Certification
* Azure AI Services
* Azure Data Services


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.

title: Sr. Technical Test Engineer
description:
**Job Title: Senior Technical Test Engineer \- Sr. Analyst \- ACS SONG**
**Management Level: Level 10 \- Sr. Analyst**
**Location: Kochi**
**Must Have Skills: Web automation (Playwright/JavaScript), API automation (Playwright/Karate \- JavaScript)**
**Good to have skills: AI\-assisted testing tools (Copilot, ChatGPT, etc.)**
**Experience: 3\-5 years of experience is required**
**Educational Qualification: Graduation (Accurate educational details should capture)**
**Job Summary**
 At Accenture Song, delivering top\-notch solutions means ensuring development outcomes align with expectations. While manual testing is still important, there's an increasing focus on automating various testing types \- functional, regression, visual, performance, and compatibility. As a Senior Technical Test Engineer, you'll take a leading role in our test automation initiatives, helping to drive quality across the board.
   

  

**Roles And Responsibilities**
* Design, develop, execute, and maintain automated test scripts for both UI and API testing.
* Create and execute comprehensive test plans, test cases, and test scripts based on business requirements and acceptance criteria.
* Build, maintain, and enhance reusable automation frameworks using industry best practices.
* Collaborate with Product Owners, Business Analysts, Developers, and QA team members to understand requirements and translate them into effective test scenarios.
* Analyze, troubleshoot, and resolve automation, environment, and test execution issues.
* Review automation scripts and test execution results to ensure adherence to automation standards and best practices.
* Leverage AI\-assisted tools and workflows to improve requirement analysis, test design, automation development, and overall QA productivity.
* Participate actively in Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, backlog refinement, daily stand\-ups, reviews, and retrospectives.
* Document defects, test execution results, and project status updates clearly and concisely.
* Drive continuous improvements in automation practices, testing processes, and overall software quality.
* Communicate effectively with cross\-functional teams and stakeholders.
* Demonstrate professionalism, ownership, and a proactive attitude towards delivering high\-quality software.

description:
**Job Title: Technical Test Lead \- Specialist \- ACS Song**
**Management Level: Level 9 \- Specialist**
**Location: Kochi**
**Must Have Skills: Web \& API Automation, Java and/or JavaScript/TypeScript**
**Good to have skills: CI/CD (Azure DevOps / GitLab CI / Jenkins), AI\-assisted testing tools**
**Experience: 5\-8 years of experience is required**
**Educational Qualification: Graduation (Accurate educational details should capture)**
**Job Summary**
 At Accenture Song, delivering high\-quality software solutions is a core value. As a Technical Test Lead, you will be responsible for overseeing end\-to\-end testing strategies, driving test automation initiatives, and mentoring the QA team. Your leadership will help ensure quality standards across all aspects of the SDLC—from planning to delivery. You will work closely with development, DevOps, and business teams to align QA efforts with overall project goals.
   

  

**Roles \& Responsibilities**
* Define and own the overall automation testing strategy, ensuring alignment with project and product goals.
* Identify areas suitable for automation, perform ROI analysis, and prioritize test cases for automation.
* Design, develop, and maintain scalable, reusable automation frameworks for both UI and API testing using industry best practices (e.g., Hybrid, BDD, POM).
* Lead the creation of comprehensive automation test plans outlining objectives, scope, tools, timelines, risks, and mitigation strategies aligned with business goals.
* Develop, execute, and maintain automated test suites for web applications, REST APIs, and backend services.
* Review automation code, test scripts, and execution results to ensure quality, maintainability, and adherence to automation standards and best practices.
* Collaborate with Product Owners, Business Analysts, Developers, and other stakeholders to understand requirements and translate them into effective test scenarios and automation solutions.
* Integrate automation suites into CI/CD pipelines and ensure reliable execution as part of the continuous delivery process.
* Identify, troubleshoot, and resolve automation framework, environment, configuration, and test data issues to improve execution stability and reliability.
* Provide technical leadership and mentorship to QA engineers by establishing automation standards, coding practices, and testing best practices.
* Monitor automation coverage, execution trends, defect metrics, and overall quality KPIs, providing regular status updates to stakeholders.
* Drive continuous improvement in testing processes, automation frameworks, tooling, and overall quality engineering practices.
* Participate in sprint planning, backlog refinement, daily stand\-ups, and retrospectives as part of Agile teams.
* Evaluate and recommend new testing tools, frameworks, AI\-assisted solutions, and engineering practices to continuously enhance the QA automation capability.
* Leverage AI\-assisted tools and workflows to improve requirement analysis, test design, automation development, defect analysis, and overall QA productivity.

title: Senior Manager - Testing
description:
**Job Title – Senior Manager – Testing \- ACS Song**
**Management Level:** 
**Level** 
**6 – Senior Manager**
**Location:** 
**Kochi**
**Must have skills:** 
**RFP / Test Proposal Experience / Solutioning \& Presales**
**Good to have skills:** 
**Experience in Digital Commerce**
**Experience:** 
**15\+ years of experience in Testing**
**Educational Qualification:** 
 Graduation (Accurate educational details should capture)
   

  

**Job Summary**
 We are seeking an experienced Senior Manager Testing with 15 years of experience in Software Testing, Test Automation, and Quality Assurance Engineering. The ideal candidate will be responsible for shaping QA and automation strategies, leading testing teams, supporting RFP responses, presales and solutioning initiatives, and driving the adoption of modern quality engineering practices, including CI/CD, Continuous Testing, and AI\-enabled testing. This role requires a strong blend of technical leadership, testing practice management, solutioning expertise, and client engagement experience to drive quality transformation across complex technology programs. Experience in Digital Commerce, Retail, or other large\-scale customer\-facing platforms is highly desirable.
   

  

**Roles And Responsibilities**
* Define and lead enterprise and programme\-level Quality Assurance strategies aligned with business objectives, technology architecture, delivery models, and risk. Assess existing testing practices and establish QA transformation roadmaps, target operating models, governance frameworks, engineering standards, and measurable quality outcomes.
* Design scalable, maintainable, and fit\-for\-purpose test automation architectures covering UI, API, integration, component, contract, and end\-to\-end testing. Define automation frameworks, reusable components, test\-data strategies, reporting, environment requirements, maintenance approaches, and technology selection based on application architecture, project requirements, scalability, maintainability, and overall QA strategy.
* Define and implement CI/CD\-integrated Quality Assurance and continuous testing strategies that provide fast, reliable, and actionable feedback throughout the software delivery lifecycle. Establish appropriate test execution strategies across pull requests, builds, deployments, integration and staging environments, regression cycles, and production validation.
* Address and optimise the practical engineering challenges associated with continuous testing, including pipeline efficiency, test reliability, execution time, environment readiness, test\-data management, dependencies, parallelisation, selective test execution, quality gates, and pipeline stability. Establish practices such as test impact analysis, risk\-based test selection, mocking, tagging, and other optimisation techniques to improve feedback time and pipeline reliability.
* Define and monitor QA and CI/CD metrics including automation coverage, execution time, test reliability, flakiness, pipeline stability, defect leakage, release confidence, and other relevant engineering and business outcomes.
* Define and lead Performance Testing strategies for critical applications, services, and customer journeys, covering workload modelling, test planning, scripting, execution, scalability, capacity assessment, performance monitoring, bottleneck identification, detailed test\-result analysis, performance optimisation, and performance regression.
* Lead detailed analysis of Performance Test results by correlating application, infrastructure, and monitoring metrics to identify performance bottlenecks, capacity constraints, resource utilisation issues, and system\-level degradation. Translate findings into actionable recommendations for performance optimisation, scalability, capacity planning, and engineering improvements.
* Define and implement API, Contract, and Component Testing strategies, establishing the appropriate balance across component, contract, API, integration, UI, end\-to\-end, and performance testing based on application architecture, business risk, and delivery requirements.
* Define test planning and test case design approaches across programmes, ensuring appropriate test scope, scenarios, coverage, traceability, risk\-based prioritisation, test data, environment requirements, entry/exit criteria, and execution strategies aligned with business and technical requirements.
* Partner with Development, DevOps, Architecture, Product, and Platform Engineering teams within and outside the organisation to embed quality throughout the software development and delivery lifecycle and promote shift\-left, continuous testing, and engineering\-led quality practices.
* Lead or significantly contribute to RFP, RFI, RFQ, presales, and client solutioning engagements from a Quality Assurance perspective. Translate client requirements and technology challenges into differentiated QA solutions, including QA strategies, automation architectures, CI/CD and continuous testing approaches, performance strategies, implementation roadmaps, effort estimates, resource models, timelines, assumptions, dependencies, risks, delivery approaches, and expected outcomes. Participate in client discovery sessions, solution workshops, proposal discussions, technical presentations, and solution defence activities.
* Drive the adoption of AI, GenAI, Agentic, and MCP\-based testing across Quality Assurance, identifying and implementing high\-value use cases such as test generation, automation code generation, test maintenance, test\-data generation, failure and defect analysis, intelligent test selection, test optimisation, and test\-result analysis. title: QA Automation Engineer
description:
**About India Running** 




  





 India Running is a leading marketplace for running events in India, building a growing community of runners and fitness enthusiasts. We enable participants to discover and register for organized runs while providing race organizers with technology and services to manage events effectively.
 



  





 Our platform combines event management, marketing and digital promotions, photo discovery, timing analytics, and other tools to create seamless experiences for both runners and organizers.
 



 We are focused on transforming the running ecosystem in India and creating memorable experiences for the running community.
 



  





**About the Role** 




  





 We are looking for a QA Automation Engineer who will take ownership of product quality across our web applications, APIs, and backend services.
 



 The ideal candidate should have strong hands\-on experience in test automation, API testing, SQL/PostgreSQL, and a strong understanding of the V\-Model of SDLC. The QA will be involved throughout the development lifecycle, from requirement analysis and test planning to automation, execution, release validation, and production support.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**Requirement \& Test Planning** 




  




* Review business requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and technical specifications.
* Identify functional gaps, ambiguities, dependencies, and edge cases early in the development lifecycle.
* Follow a V\-Model / shift\-left approach, ensuring testing activities are planned alongside development activities.
* Prepare test scenarios, test cases, test data, and acceptance criteria.
* Maintain traceability between requirements and test cases.



  





**Functional \& Integration Testing** 




  




* Perform functional, regression, integration, system, exploratory, and end\-to\-end testing.
* Validate critical business workflows across frontend, backend, APIs, databases, and third\-party integrations.
* Design and execute comprehensive test scenarios covering positive, negative, boundary, and edge cases.
* Perform cross\-browser and responsive testing where applicable.



  





**Test Automation** 




  




* Design, develop, and maintain automated test suites for web applications and APIs.
* Automate critical business workflows and regression scenarios.
* Work with automation frameworks such as Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, or similar.
* Write clean, maintainable, and reusable automation scripts.
* Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines.
* Analyze automation failures and identify whether the issue is related to the application, test, test data, or environment.
* Continuously improve automation coverage and reliability.

* Perform functional and integration testing of REST APIs.
* Develop automated API tests where appropriate.
* Validate service\-to\-service communication and backend workflows.
* Use tools such as Postman for API testing and debugging.
* Validate application behavior across different backend services.



  





**Database Testing** 




  




* Use PostgreSQL and SQL for backend data validation.
* Write SQL queries to validate data created or modified through application workflows.
* Verify database state before and after API/UI operations.
* Investigate data inconsistencies and assist developers in troubleshooting backend issues.



  





**Defect \& Release Management** 




  




* Identify, reproduce, document, and track defects with clear steps and supporting information.
* Work closely with developers to investigate and resolve issues.
* Perform regression testing after defect fixes.
* Ensure significant production defects are covered by appropriate regression or automation tests.
* Participate in release testing and provide QA sign\-off based on defined acceptance criteria and test results.
* Perform post\-release validation of critical workflows.



  





**Required Skills \& Experience** 




  




* 3–6 years of experience in software QA/testing.
* Strong hands\-on experience in test automation.
* Experience with Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, or similar automation frameworks.
* Strong programming/scripting knowledge in JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, Java, or similar.
* Good understanding of the V\-Model of SDLC and shift\-left testing practices.
* Strong experience in functional, integration, regression, API, and end\-to\-end testing.
* Good knowledge of REST APIs and API testing.
* Strong working knowledge of SQL and PostgreSQL.
* Experience with bug tracking and test management tools.



  





**Good to Have** 




  




* Experience with Playwright and TypeScript.
* Experience building or maintaining an automation framework from scratch.
* Experience with API automation.
* Experience integrating automated tests with CI/CD pipelines.
* Experience testing Node.js/backend services.
* Familiarity with monitoring and error\-tracking tools such as Sentry.
* Experience with performance or load testing.



  





**What We Expect** 




  




* Ownership of product quality throughout the complete SDLC.
* A shift\-left mindset — identifying quality issues during requirements and design rather than waiting until development is complete.
* Ability to understand business requirements as well as technical implementation.
* Ability to determine which scenarios should be automated and which require manual/exploratory testing.
* Strong focus on test coverage, maintainability, and preventing regressions.
* Ability to independently investigate issues across UI, APIs, backend services, and PostgreSQL.
* Strong collaboration with Product, Engineering, and other stakeholders.
* Clear communication and documentation of defects, test results, and release risks.

title: AI Architect
description:
**Job Description**
**Shape ZenseAI.QI and ZenseAI.AssureAI**
* Architect and evolve the platform suite across both engines: the 18\-agent ZenseAI.QI stack (DeepSpeci, CaseGeni, Auto\-PlayPilot, DataGeni, Secure\-Xi, Perf\-Xi, Insights360, RIA and Accessibility Intelligence) and the four\-pillar ZenseAI.AssureAI framework (Data Quality, Model Evaluation, Trustworthiness, and Scalability \& Security).
* Design and refine the archetype\-specific assurance lifecycles for Classical ML, Generative AI and Agentic AI, including the signature eight\-axis agentic trajectory scorecard graded on every run.
* Keep the platforms LLM\-agnostic and deployable on any client stack — on\-prem, cloud or hybrid — as model\-mixing and constant provider churn become the market norm.
* Own technical roadmap decisions for accelerators such as the Agentic Foundry (a 25\-blueprint reference matrix) and the curated, swap\-ready tooling ecosystem around each archetype.


**Lead Evaluation\-Driven Development**
* Build and govern eval suites — ground\-truth Q\&A sets, LLM\-as\-judge rubrics, frozen baselines — that gate every release rather than validate it after the fact.
* Own trajectory grading, red/purple/blue\-team probes and safety attestations for agentic and generative systems, and drift monitoring and fairness audits for classical ML.
* Translate evaluation results into release decisions: eval\-threshold gates, red\-team severity floors, canary and shadow deployments, and rollback rehearsals.
* Bring evaluation\-driven development practice into client engagements — showing, not just telling, how a live harness beats a one\-time audit.


**Own Presales and Client Proposals**
* Respond to RFPs, RFIs and client proposals across both engines, translating client requirements into a defensible solution architecture and commercial structure.
* Architect engagements across the full ladder — AI QA Assessment, AI QA Transformation, Managed AI QA — and fast\-starts such as the LLM Health Check, Agent Stress Test and Compliance Sprint.
* Build estimates, staffing plans and technical win themes that hold up under client and internal scrutiny, across client\-managed, risk\-reward and Zensar\-managed commercial models.


**Present and Articulate Value to Clients**
* Present the ZenseAI.QI and ZenseAI.AssureAI value proposition directly to client stakeholders — from QA Directors and Heads of AI/ML Engineering to CTOs, Chief Risk Officers and Chief AI Officers — adapting the narrative to each audience.
* Lead client workshops and technical walkthroughs, including guiding a CIO through the Agentic Foundry in a single session.
* Build and deliver executive trust scorecards and portfolio risk heat maps that make the assurance story board\-ready.


**Represent Zensar in Client Captives for Sales**
* Present live in client captive sessions and sales pursuits as the senior technical voice for Quality Intelligence, alongside account and sales leadership.
* Run and narrate proof\-of\-concept demonstrations that turn a client's stated risk into a small, credible proof — the practice's proof\-first approach to closing.

 We are seeking a
 **Lead Infrastructure Engineer** 
 to help design, automate, and operate our next‑generation hybrid cloud and Kubernetes platforms. This role is ideal for an engineer who thrives on solving infrastructure challenges with automation and enjoys building reusable, self‑service capabilities that improve platform reliability and developer experience.
   

  

 In this hands‑on role, you will contribute to the development of scalable infrastructure patterns, modernize compute from VMs to containers, and enable GitOps‑driven delivery across environments. You will partner closely with platform, security, and application engineering teams to build solutions that are secure, consistent, and easy for developers to consume.
   

  

 This is a technical leadership position focused on engineering excellence, reusable patterns, and the evolution of our Kubernetes‑centered platform ecosystem.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Platform Engineering \& Architecture Contribution**
* Build and maintain Kubernetes platforms, including cluster operations, add‑ons, curated Helm charts, and deployment standards.
* Develop reusable infrastructure modules and templates using Terraform, Ansible, or similar IaC tools.
* Support hybrid cloud infrastructure (Azure or GCP) following established architectural guidelines.
* Contribute to workload migration initiatives from virtual machines to containerized environments.
* Implement declarative, API‑driven infrastructure patterns aligned with GitOps workflows.


**Operational Excellence**
* Automate provisioning, configuration, and platform lifecycle tasks to reduce manual operations and improve stability.
* Leverage observability tooling (Prometheus, Grafana, logs, tracing) to improve performance monitoring and incident response.
* Participate in on‑call rotations, root‑cause analysis, and reliability‑focused improvements.
* Maintain cluster security, RBAC, policy enforcement, and compliance controls in collaboration with security teams.


**GitOps, Automation \& Engineering Enablement**
* Design and implement GitOps workflows using tools such as ArgoCD or RHACM.
* Build and maintain self‑service platform capabilities (APIs, templates, automation pipelines) to reduce friction for development teams.
* Integrate infrastructure automation with CI/CD systems (GitHub Actions, Tekton, etc.).
* Provide guidance and onboarding support to teams adopting Kubernetes, including documentation, templates, and golden paths.


**Collaboration \& Mentorship**
* Mentor junior engineers and contribute to knowledge‑sharing across the engineering organization.
* Participate in code reviews, architecture discussions, and cross‑team collaboration.
* Work closely with networking, security, and application teams to deliver compliant and scalable solutions.


**Required Qualifications**
 Drawing from both the Kubernetes‑focused nature of this role and alignment with the Lead DevOps job level:
   

  

* 5\+ years of experience in infrastructure, platform engineering, or DevOps roles (or equivalent via education, training, or military experience).
* 2\+ years of hands‑on Kubernetes experience (cluster operations, deployment tooling, troubleshooting).
* 3\+ years of experience with IaC tools such as Terraform, Ansible, or Tekton.
* 3\+ years working with GitOps principles and tools (ArgoCD, GitHub Actions, RHACM).
* Experience with container orchestration, hybrid cloud platforms (Azure, GCP), and Linux systems.
* Proficiency in scripting (Python, Bash, PowerShell).
* Experience designing or consuming RESTful APIs and integrating automation into platform workflows.
* Solid understanding of networking fundamentals, security best practices, and compliance considerations.

 MantaRay NM is a cutting\-edge network management platform that empowers telecommunications providers to efficiently operate, optimize, and assure their complex network infrastructures. It offers advanced automation, analytics, and fault management capabilities, crucial for delivering high\-performance and reliable services in today's dynamic digital landscape.
   

  

 As a Test Engineer, you will independently own test automation, continuous integration, and regression for specific feature areas, ensuring high\-quality product verification. Your responsibilities will include building and maintaining pipelines, test environments, and release verification processes, covering feature, system, deployment, upgrade, security, and release testing. You will leverage Agentic AI tools to accelerate test design and automation, and coach junior engineers on best practices in Robot Framework, Python, CI, and test reliability. This role requires expertise in cloud\-native software testing on containerized platforms, utilizing Docker, Kubernetes, and Helm.
   

  

**How You Will Contribute And What You Will Learn**
 As a Test Engineer you will:
   

  

* Independently own test automation, CI and regression for a feature area
* Build and maintain pipelines, environments and release verification
* Cover feature, system, deployment, upgrade, security and release testing
* Use Agentic AI tools to accelerate test design and automation
* Coach juniors on Robot Framework, Python, CI and test reliability


**Key Skills And Experience**
 Must\-Have Skills:
   

  

* A Graduate / Master degree in Engineering or equivalent with 5\+years of experience in SW/telecom product verification and test automation using Robot Framework, Python, and Bash for scripting and test environment setup.
* Proficiency in cloud\-native software development on containerized platforms, including Docker and Kubernetes/OpenShift.
* Strong foundation in core development and CI/CD tools such as Linux, Git, and GitLab CI/Jenkins for pipelines and automated test execution.
* Experience with REST APIs, microservices, and leveraging Agentic AI/AI\-assisted development tools.


 Good\-to\-Have Skills:
   

  

* Familiarity with Helm for deployment and orchestration.
* Comprehensive experience across various testing types, including feature, entity, system, deployment, and upgrade testing.

description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Role Summary**
**Job Description – QA Automation Engineer**
 We are seeking a dedicated QA Automation Engineer responsible for ensuring software quality through automated testing, integration testing, regression testing, and release validation. while also supporting manual testing activities as needed to ensure comprehensive test coverage and high\-quality software releases.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Design, develop, and maintain automated tests using modern automation frameworks.
* Create and execute SIT, Regression Testing, and End\-to\-End Testing.
* Develop reusable automation components and test frameworks.
* Validate application functionality, integrations, APIs, and data flows.
* Support release cycles through comprehensive test planning and execution.
* Create and maintain test plans, test cases, and test data.
* Identify, document, and track software defects through resolution.
* Collaborate with development, business, and product teams to ensure quality objectives are met.
* Perform exploratory and manual testing when automation is not applicable.
* Participate in requirement reviews and provide testability feedback.
* Analyse test results and provide quality metrics and reports.


**Technical Skills \& Tools (Required)**
* Playwright, C\# /.NET, JavaScript / TypeScript, REST API Testing \& Postman, SQL and Database Validation, Git Version Control, Azure DevOps


**Engineering Practices**
* Test Strategy and Planning, System Integration Testing (SIT), Regression Testing, Defect Lifecycle Management, Release Validation, Agile/Scrum Methodologies, Continuous Quality Improvement


**Experience**
* 5\- 10 years of experience in Software Testing and Test Automation.
* Strong hands\-on experience building and maintaining automation frameworks.
* Experience with API, Integration, Regression, and End\-to\-End Testing.
* Experience testing modern web applications, preferably React\-based applications.
* Experience supporting Agile delivery and frequent release cycles.


**Nice to Have**
* Exposure to Performance Testing, React.js, Python \& Django, Security Testing, Accessibility Testing, Test Management Tools, Experience testing enterprise\-scale applications


**Ideal Candidate Profile**
* A highly motivated QA Automation Engineer with strong automation expertise and a quality\-first mindset. The candidate should be capable of independently driving automation strategy, framework development, API and integration testing, regression testing, and release validation, while also contributing to manual and exploratory testing activities when required. The ideal candidate will collaborate effectively with cross\-functional teams to deliver high\-quality software releases.

description:
**How You'll Help Us Keep Climbing (Overview \& Key Responsibilities)**
**Role Summary**
 Developer responsible for developing and maintaining highly reliable, secure, scalable, and cost\-efficient cloud\-based applications supporting Aircraft Weight and Balance solutions within the Operations and Customer Center (OCC) domain.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Develop and maintain full\-stack cloud applications on AWS, leveraging AI\-powered capabilities to address business needs and enhance operational efficiency.
* Ensure solutions meet key non\-functional requirements, including reliability, scalability, performance, security, maintainability, and cost optimization.
* Collaborate in production support activities, including monitoring, troubleshooting, and resolving incidents as part of an on\-call rotation to maintain high service availability.


**What You Need To Succeed (Minimum Qualifications)**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* 3\+ years of experience developing and supporting distributed cloud applications on AWS.
* Strong proficiency in Java development, including JVM performance tuning, troubleshooting, and optimization in high\-throughput production environments.
* Hands\-on experience building applications using Spring Boot/Quarkus, Microservices architecture, and RESTful and/or GraphQL APIs.
* Experience working with relational database technologies.
* Strong knowledge of AWS services, including EC2, Lambda, S3, SQS, SNS, RDS, CloudFormation, and Code Pipeline.
* Understanding of cloud security principles, secure coding practices, and networking concepts in distributed cloud environments.
* Proficiency with source control and DevOps practices, including Git, CI/CD pipelines
* Experience working within Agile development methodologies and cross\-functional product teams.
* Familiarity with event\-driven architecture and messaging technologies such as Kafka/EMS.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to effectively collaborate across technical and business teams.
* Demonstrated ability to learn new technologies quickly, adapt to changing priorities, and maintain a strong customer\-focused mindset.
* Commitment to fostering an inclusive workplace while upholding the highest standards of safety, security, and compliance.
* Strong appreciation for design thinking, software craftsmanship, and engineering best practices that promote code quality, maintainability, and long\-term scalability.
* Demonstrated experience using AWS AI/ML services such as Amazon SageMaker, Bedrock, and AgentCore
* Demonstrated experience using AI\-assisted development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Claude, Kiro) to accomplish tasks such as generating and reviewing code, writing and maintaining tests, creating documentation, and debugging, while exercising sound judgment to validate and take ownership of AI\-generated output
* Understanding of prompt engineering, AI workflows, and/or model integration patterns


**Behavioral Competencies**
* Ability to produce high quality results, work in a collaborative environment by embracing diverse perspectives and with a solution\-based approach.
* Adapt communication clearly and concisely based on team dynamics and expresses thoughts \& ideas effectively.
* Ability to engage effectively with peers and stakeholders to build trust and reliable working relationships.
* Ability to understand business processes, implement innovative solutions, guide juniors on continuous improvement by constantly updating oneself on current technology \& trends.
* Inquisitive to understand customer and business expectations while creating value addition on technical solutions.


**What Will Give You a Competitive Edge (Preferred Qualifications)**
* Experience working in an airline technology environment
* AWS Solution Developer Certifications


**About The Company**
 What started as a humble, little aerial crop\-dusting operation called Huff Daland Dusters in 1924 has now grown into the U.S. global airline leader in safety, innovation, reliability, and customer experience. Headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia, Delta Air Lines is known for its operational excellence and award\-winning customer service.
   

  

 Powered by our employees worldwide, Delta has led the airline industry in operational excellence for a decade while maintaining our reputation for award\-winning customer service. With our mission of connecting the people and cultures of the globe, Delta strives to foster understanding across a diverse world and serve as a force for social good.
   

  

 In 2026, Delta Air Lines continued to earn global recognition for its performance, culture and operational excellence. Delta was named to Glassdoor’s 2026 Top 100 Best Places to Work list for the ninth time, standing as the only airline recognized. Delta also secured the 11th spot on Fortune’s World’s Most Admired Companies list, marking its 13th consecutive year earning this distinction. Delta was also recognized by Cirium as the top on\-time airline in North America for the fifth consecutive year, underscoring its unwavering commitment to reliability and customer experience.
   

  

**About The Delta Technology Hub (DTH), Bangalore**
 The DTH is one of Delta Air Lines' investments in world\-class business capabilities and technology aimed at transforming how Delta Air Lines operates and provides world\-class travel experiences to its customers through innovation and cutting\-edge methodologies. By continuously reimagining processes and driving technology\-led transformation, the Delta Technology Hub plays a pivotal role in Scripting The Future Of Aviation. The organization is certified by the Great Place to Work Institute (India). The Delta Technology Hub was a finalist for the iVolunteer Awards 2024/2025 in the "Leader in Employee Volunteering" category. This nomination highlights our remarkable volunteering initiatives and the outstanding practices we implement to encourage and support our employee volunteering program.
   

  

 For more information, please visit www.deltatechhub.com
   

  

**Why join?**
* Technology is a key enabler of the differentiated services that Delta provides. At the DTH, you get the opportunity to work on projects with a significant impact on business outcomes and customer experience.
* Deepen your knowledge by taking part in multifaceted learning and development programs –exposure to extensive internal and partner repositories, institutional affiliations, and industry SIG (Special Interest Groups) partnerships.
* Immerse yourself in an employee\-centric culture.
* Develop deep and broad business acumen on airline operations while retaining focus on cutting\-edge technology driven solutions.
* Avail a full range of benefits that support you and your family: Medical Insurance, Transportation to and from the DTH office, Complementary Cafeteria Meals, Special Travel opportunities and Travel Privileges, Car Lease Program, Paid time off, Parental Benefits and National Pension Scheme.

title: Engineering Lead - AI
description:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
   

  

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
   

  

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.
   

  

**EY Job Description**
**Job Title: Engineering Lead – AI**
**Job Rank (must note a single rank only for each job description): Associate Director**
**Function: EY Technology – Enterprise Technology**
**Scope (indicate either “global/cross\-border” or “local/country”):Global**
**Sub Function: EY Technology \| CBS Technology \| Intelligent Automation**
**Reports to (Job Title): Service Delivery Lead: AI \& Automation**
**Job Summary:**
 The Engineering Lead is responsible for hands\-on engineering delivery of enterprise AI/ML/GenAI and automation solutions, coding standards, design patterns, ensuring production\-grade security, scalability, reliability, and supportability. It is not a solution advisory, PoC, or platform administration role. Success is measured by the quality, reliability, scalability, and operability of AI systems in production.
   

  

 Operating as a player–coach, the Engineering Lead works alongside AI Engineers to design and build ML Models, LLM pipelines and agentic workflows, while also setting engineering standards, coaching teams, and ensuring delivery.
   

  

**The ideal candidate will possess:**
* Extensive, hands\-on software engineering experience, with a proven track record of building and operating complex systems in production environments.
* Strong executive communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear, business\-relevant outcomes.
* Ability to independently design and code across multiple technical components, while guiding and elevating the work of senior engineers.
* Deep technical expertise across the full stack, including cloud\-native architectures, distributed systems, and data\-intensive platforms.
* Strong command of non\-functional requirements, including reliability, availability, scalability, performance, and cost optimization, and the ability to make sound technology and architecture decisions as systems evolve over time.
* Demonstrated experience delivering production\-grade Generative AI and Agentic AI solutions, including:
* LLM\-powered applications and services
* Agentic workflows and orchestration frameworks
* Model integration, evaluation, and lifecycle management
* MLOps / LLMOps pipelines and operational practices
* Proven experience partnering with Data Science and AI Research teams to operationalize models and AI capabilities at enterprise scale.
* Ability to drive the design and delivery of AI\-first architectures, including LLM\-powered services, agentic workflows, orchestration layers, and human\-in\-the\-loop systems.
* Experience building robust data and software foundations that enable advanced analytics, real\-time AI inference, and intelligent decisioning at scale.


**Essential Functions of the Job:**
* Engineering Ownership \& Delivery Accountability
+ Own end\-to\-end technical delivery of AI and GenAI solutions—from design through production and BAU support.
+ Act as the technical authority for the build team, accountable for:
- Code quality and engineering standards
- Security, privacy, and compliance
- Reliability, scalability, performance, and cost
- Operational readiness and supportability

+ Make hard engineering trade\-offs balancing latency, accuracy, cost, reliability, and scale.
+ Own production systems post go\-live, including incident analysis, performance tuning, and architectural evolution.


* Hands\-on GenAI \& AI Systems Engineering
* 
+ Collaborate with solution architecture on design and own build production\-grade GenAI systems, including:
- Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines
- Agentic workflows and tool\-based orchestration
- Prompt pipelines, routing, and integration layers
- Human\-in\-the\-loop and safety guardrails

+ Work shoulder\-to\-shoulder with AI Engineers and Data Scientists to:
- Productionize models and LLM pipelines
- Implement evaluation, monitoring, and observability
- Optimize inference cost, performance, and reliability

+ Ensure experimental AI capabilities are engineered into real systems, not isolated prototypes.


* Architecture \& Engineering Standards
+ Define and enforce reference architectures and engineering standards for AI and GenAI systems.
+ Drive consistent adoption of:
- Clean and modular architecture patterns
- Reusable components and shared frameworks
- CI/CD, DevOps, and cloud\-native practices

+ Partner with architecture, platform, security, and data teams while retaining final accountability for build quality.


* AI Platform Engineering \& MLOps / LLMOps
+ Build and evolve AI platforms that support:
- Model lifecycle management
- LLMOps / MLOps pipelines
- Evaluation, monitoring, and drift detection
- Secure access, auditability, and governance

+ Ensure AI systems meet enterprise non\-functional requirements over time, not just at launch.


* Team Leadership \& Capability Building
+ Lead and grow a team of senior engineers within the AI \& Automation build function.
+ Coach engineers on:
- Backend and distributed systems engineering
- GenAI application design and implementation
- Writing maintainable, testable, production\-quality code

+ Set a strong engineering culture focused on ownership, rigor, and continuous improvement.
+ Support hiring and skills development aligned to future AI engineering needs.


* Stakeholder \& Cross\-Functional Collaboration
+ Partner closely with:
- AI/ML Engineering and Data Science teams
- Platform, security, and operations teams
- Architecture and governance forums

+ Translate business and functional requirements into robust technical designs.
+ Act as a senior technical voice in design authorities and delivery governance.


**Engineering Expectations (Non Negotiable)**
* Has built and operated complex, distributed backend systems in production.
* Comfortable debugging production incidents involving AI/LLM pipelines.
* Writes, reviews, and maintains production\-quality code, not just prototypes.
* Understands failure modes of AI systems and designs for resilience.
* Takes ownership for systems after go\-live, including reliability and cost optimization.


**Analytical/Decision Making Responsibilities:**
 This role is critical to ensuring the enterprise’s AI ambition translates into
 **real, reliable, and scalable systems** 
 —not just innovation theater. You will define how AI is built, shipped, and operated across the organization.
   

  

**Knowledge and Skills Requirements:**
**Core Engineering Skills**
* Strong hands\-on experience in Python, Java, C\#, or similar backend languages.
* Proven experience building API\-driven, cloud\-native systems.
* Strong understanding of distributed systems, scalability, and reliability patterns.


**GenAI / AI Engineering (Essential)**
* Hands\-on experience building LLM\-powered applications, including:
+ RAG pipelines
+ Agentic or tool\-augmented workflows
+ Prompt orchestration and integration layers

* Experience with:
+ Vector databases and embeddings
+ LLM evaluation, observability, and monitoring
+ Guardrails, safety, and cost controls

* Experience operationalizing AI models at scale in enterprise environments.


**Nice to Have (Not Core Identity)**
* Experience integrating AI services into enterprise automation platforms (e.g., Power Platform, ServiceNow).
* Familiarity with Azure AI services and data platforms.


**Detailed Responsibilities:**
* Solution Development: Design, develop, and implement automation solutions using Microsoft Power Platform (Power Automate, Power Apps) and ServiceNow. Create custom workflows, forms, and applications to automate business processes and enhance user experience.
* Integration Management: Integrate Microsoft and ServiceNow platforms with other enterprise applications using APIs, web services, and middleware. Ensure seamless data flow between systems and maintain data integrity across integrated applications.
* Testing and Quality Assurance: Conduct thorough testing of automation solutions to ensure functionality, performance, and compliance with business requirements. Implement best practices for code quality, documentation, and version control.
* Observability and Maintenance: Monitor the performance of automation solutions and troubleshoot issues as they arise. Perform regular maintenance and updates to ensure optimal functionality and security of automation applications.
* Documentation: Create and maintain comprehensive documentation for automation solutions, including design specifications, user guides, and technical manuals. Document processes, workflows, and integration points for future reference and knowledge transfer.
* User Training and Support: Provide training and support to end\-users and team members on automation tools and processes.Develop training materials and conduct workshops to facilitate user adoption of automation solutions.
* Collaboration and Stakeholder Engagement: Work closely with cross\-functional teams, including business analysts, project managers, and IT staff, to ensure alignment on automation initiatives. Engage with stakeholders to gather feedback and make necessary adjustments to automation solutions.
* Performance Metrics and Reporting: Define and track key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure the effectiveness of automation solutions. Generate reports and dashboards to communicate the impact of automation on business processes and operational efficiency.
* Continuous Improvement: Stay updated on the latest trends and advancements in automation, AI, and relevant technologies.Identify areas for continuous improvement and propose enhancements to existing automation solutions.
* Governance and Compliance: Ensure that automation solutions adhere to organizational policies, governance frameworks, and compliance requirements. Participate in risk assessments and audits related to automation initiatives.
* Innovation and Research: Explore and evaluate new technologies, tools, and methodologies to enhance automation capabilities. Conduct research on industry best practices and competitor strategies to inform decision\-making and innovation.
* Change Management: Analyze the impact of automation on organizational processes and culture, making recommendations for change management strategies. Assist in developing communication plans to inform stakeholders about automation initiatives and their benefits.


**Other Requirements:**
* Familiarity with Python practices and tools.
* Strong communication, stakeholder management and influence
* Strong leadership and conflict resolution capability
* Leading virtual teams


**Job Requirements:**
**Education:**
* A degree in Computer Science / Engineering or a related discipline; or equivalent work experience


**Experience:**
* 10\+ years in a Global IT environment working with multiple disciplines to deliver projects in line with customer needs
* 3\+ Years Global delivery or transformation preferably in large scale infrastructure programs
* 3\+ Years in a global operations environment


**Certification Requirements:**
* Relevant certifications in MS Power Platform and ServiceNow RPA
* Python Certification
* Azure AI Services
* Azure Data Services


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.
   

  

 EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi\-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

 You will be part of the Enterprise Product \& Platform Engineering (EPPE) organization, responsible for providing centralized, independent infrastructure testing and quality assurance services. This role focuses on driving infrastructure testing delivery, governance, and coordination across projects, ensuring improved system stability, compliance, and release readiness.
   

  

 The Lead Business Systems Analyst will act as a delivery lead/project coordinator for infrastructure testing, managing backlog execution, prioritization, stakeholder communication, and reporting.
   

  

**Your Primary Responsibilities**
 Infrastructure Testing Delivery \& Coordination
   

  

* Lead end\-to\-end infrastructure testing delivery across multiple concurrent programs and releases
* Coordinate testing activities aligned with application and infrastructure release plans
* Act as the primary liaison between Infrastructure Engineering, Application Teams, and Test teams
* Ensure test readiness across environments (build validation, baseline validation, integration readiness)
* Track and manage dependencies, risks, and testing milestones


 Agile Delivery \& Work Management
   

  

* Drive JIRA\-based Agile delivery (Scrum/Kanban) including backlog refinement, sprint planning, and prioritization
* Manage and monitor story progress, defect tracking, and test execution status
* Ensure clear definition of acceptance criteria, test scope, and Definition of Done (DoD)
* Facilitate daily stand\-ups, sprint reviews, and stakeholder updates
* Optimize workflow efficiency and reduce delivery bottlenecks


 Resource Planning \& Workload Management
   

  

* Plan and allocate resources based on priority, complexity, and delivery timelines
* Monitor utilization across onshore/offshore teams
* Balance competing priorities across multiple initiatives
* Identify capacity gaps and escalate proactively


 Metrics, Reporting \& Leadership Communication
   

  

* Prepare executive\-level dashboards, metrics, and status reports
* Provide insights on: \- Test coverage
* Automation progress
* Defects and quality trends
* Delivery risks and timelines
* Present program updates to Director\-level and senior stakeholders
* Drive data\-driven decision\-making using tools such as Power BI / dashboards


 Process, Governance \& Continuous Improvement
   

  

* Ensure adherence to EPPE testing standards, governance, and audit requirements
* Identify process gaps and drive improvements through automation and standardization
* Implement controls for traceability, test coverage, and compliance validation
* Support audit readiness and documentation standards


 Stakeholder Management
   

  

* Collaborate with Product Management, Infrastructure Engineering, Application Development teams
* Communicate risks, blockers, and status clearly and proactively
* Influence outcomes without direct authority


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or related discipline (or equivalent experience)


 Talents Needed for Success
   

  

* 8\+ years of experience in Business Systems Analysis, Infrastructure Testing, or Delivery/Program Coordination roles
* Familiarity with tools such as ServiceNow, Power BI, automation pipelines
* Strong experience in Agile delivery models (Scrum/Kanban)
* Hands\-on experience with JIRA (backlog, workflows, reporting)
* Experience working in infrastructure or platform environments (cloud/on\-prem)
* Strong understanding of risk, compliance, and audit expectations
* Proactively identifies and mitigates delivery risks
* Good understanding of the role of automation in various SDLCs (e.g. agile, scrum, waterfall) and mentor, train and coach resources.
* Ability to work on multiple work streams concurrently in a fast\-paced environment with extreme multi\-tasking and context switching.

**About India Running** 




  





 India Running is a leading marketplace for running events in India, building a growing community of runners and fitness enthusiasts. We enable participants to discover and register for organized runs while providing race organizers with technology and services to manage events effectively.
 



  





 Our platform combines event management, marketing and digital promotions, photo discovery, timing analytics, and other tools to create seamless experiences for both runners and organizers.
 



 We are focused on transforming the running ecosystem in India and creating memorable experiences for the running community.
 



  





**About the Role** 




  





 We are looking for a QA Automation Engineer who will take ownership of product quality across our web applications, APIs, and backend services.
 



 The ideal candidate should have strong hands\-on experience in test automation, API testing, SQL/PostgreSQL, and a strong understanding of the V\-Model of SDLC. The QA will be involved throughout the development lifecycle, from requirement analysis and test planning to automation, execution, release validation, and production support.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**Requirement \& Test Planning** 




  




* Review business requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and technical specifications.
* Identify functional gaps, ambiguities, dependencies, and edge cases early in the development lifecycle.
* Follow a V\-Model / shift\-left approach, ensuring testing activities are planned alongside development activities.
* Prepare test scenarios, test cases, test data, and acceptance criteria.
* Maintain traceability between requirements and test cases.



  





**Functional \& Integration Testing** 




  




* Perform functional, regression, integration, system, exploratory, and end\-to\-end testing.
* Validate critical business workflows across frontend, backend, APIs, databases, and third\-party integrations.
* Design and execute comprehensive test scenarios covering positive, negative, boundary, and edge cases.
* Perform cross\-browser and responsive testing where applicable.



  





**Test Automation** 




  




* Design, develop, and maintain automated test suites for web applications and APIs.
* Automate critical business workflows and regression scenarios.
* Work with automation frameworks such as Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, or similar.
* Write clean, maintainable, and reusable automation scripts.
* Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines.
* Analyze automation failures and identify whether the issue is related to the application, test, test data, or environment.
* Continuously improve automation coverage and reliability.



  





**API \& Backend Testing** 




  




* Perform functional and integration testing of REST APIs.
* Develop automated API tests where appropriate.
* Validate service\-to\-service communication and backend workflows.
* Use tools such as Postman for API testing and debugging.
* Validate application behavior across different backend services.



  





**Database Testing** 




  




* Use PostgreSQL and SQL for backend data validation.
* Write SQL queries to validate data created or modified through application workflows.
* Verify database state before and after API/UI operations.
* Investigate data inconsistencies and assist developers in troubleshooting backend issues.



  





**Defect \& Release Management** 




  




* Identify, reproduce, document, and track defects with clear steps and supporting information.
* Work closely with developers to investigate and resolve issues.
* Perform regression testing after defect fixes.
* Ensure significant production defects are covered by appropriate regression or automation tests.
* Participate in release testing and provide QA sign\-off based on defined acceptance criteria and test results.
* Perform post\-release validation of critical workflows.



  





**Required Skills \& Experience** 




  




* 3–6 years of experience in software QA/testing.
* Strong hands\-on experience in test automation.
* Experience with Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, or similar automation frameworks.
* Strong programming/scripting knowledge in JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, Java, or similar.
* Good understanding of the V\-Model of SDLC and shift\-left testing practices.
* Strong experience in functional, integration, regression, API, and end\-to\-end testing.
* Good knowledge of REST APIs and API testing.
* Strong working knowledge of SQL and PostgreSQL.
* Experience with bug tracking and test management tools.



  





**Good to Have** 




  




* Experience with Playwright and TypeScript.
* Experience building or maintaining an automation framework from scratch.
* Experience with API automation.
* Experience integrating automated tests with CI/CD pipelines.
* Experience testing Node.js/backend services.
* Familiarity with monitoring and error\-tracking tools such as Sentry.
* Experience with performance or load testing.



  





**What We Expect** 




  




* Ownership of product quality throughout the complete SDLC.
* A shift\-left mindset — identifying quality issues during requirements and design rather than waiting until development is complete.
* Ability to understand business requirements as well as technical implementation.
* Ability to determine which scenarios should be automated and which require manual/exploratory testing.
* Strong focus on test coverage, maintainability, and preventing regressions.
* Ability to independently investigate issues across UI, APIs, backend services, and PostgreSQL.
* Strong collaboration with Product, Engineering, and other stakeholders.
* Clear communication and documentation of defects, test results, and release risks.

**Salesforce And Chatbot Testing Capabilities**
